summary: A Rego Herbam ritual (Level 45) that compels all magical and potentially mobile trees within a woodland to gather to hold meetings and summon ancient powers; trees remain animated for a month.

label: Calling the Council of Trees
summary: A Hermetic ritual many magi believe to be of druidical origin, though House Merinita claims it for their Founder.

label: Calling the Odious Drought
summary: A Perdo Aquam Ritual spell (Level 50) with an Auram requisite that causes a drought over the surrounding area, drying streams and rivers.

label: Calm the Motion of the Heart
aliases: Calm the Motion of the Heart
summary: A spell that removes one emotion from the target until it appears again naturally, such as making an angry person stop being angry.

label: Calming Touch
summary: A power of the angel Nasir (3 points, Animal/Mentem) that, by touching the target, calms their fears and reassures them in the face of dangerous terrain.

label: Calorific Stone
summary: A Level 10 Alteration Reagent that, when dropped into water, makes the water boil within seconds; a single dose can affect a bathtub of water.

label: Caltis of Tremere
summary: A young Tremere magus among the members recruited to Nigrasaxa.

label: Calum
summary: A lapsed priest among Waddenzee's covenfolk who provides a heretical form of spiritual sustenance to the pirates.

label: Camargue Delta
summary: The wild and inhospitable delta where the Rhone ends, home to a ghostly horse that keeps a larder of up to 100 wicked children.

label: Cambrian Mountains
summary: The mountain range in Wales where Aneirin's tomb lies and across which his spirit wanders, helping those who further his ideals and punishing those who oppose them.

label: Cambridge
summary: A medium-sized port town on the edge of the Fens with a young university and an unusual number of natural magicians, owing to the influence of Schola Pythagoranis.

label: Cambunian Mountains
summary: Mountains on the northern border of Thessaly where the Daughters of Erictho dwell in cliffside caves near Faerie regiones.

label: Canterbury
summary: Capital of Kent and metropolitan see of the English church; site of Becket's martyrdom and his shrine, the fourth main pilgrimage site in Europe.

label: Capo
summary: A game-defined merchant role: the leader of a merchant company who sets grand strategy, appoints factors, and engages in politics; characters must take the Capo Social Status Virtue.

label: Caprea
summary: A visiting Bjornaer maga who is a current guest at Crintera, working on a bestiary to present at the next Tribunal. She accidentally blinded the familiar of a visiting Jerbiton magus, Carolus.

label: Cardiff
summary: The most important town in Wales, in a country with few towns and a largely barter-based economy.

label: Cardinal Robert Caurçon
summary: The cardinal who discovered the heresy of David of Dinant in 1215 after reading his book Quaternuli.

label: Careless Sorcerer
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw: the magus is slapdash with magical power and must roll two more botch dice than normal when casting spells.

label: Careless with (Ability)
summary: A Minor General Flaw: the character is reckless with a particular Ability, treating any rolled zero as a botch when using it.

label: Carles
summary: A stone circle of forty-two stones about thirty meters across, surrounded by a bank, containing three round barrows and a rectangle of stones called the Porter's Lodge said to become a guarded house on certain nights.

label: Carmine
summary: A maga of House Flambeau, wife of the Primus of Jerbiton, who prefers Creo Ignem effects and uses a ruby necklace and coral brooch as a ceremonial casting kit.

label: Carolinus
summary: Charlemagne's mage-smith, several of whose apprentices were adopted by the Founder Jerbiton.

label: Carolus
summary: A scatterbrained young magus of Oculus Septentrionalis posing as an eccentric scholar; his raven familiar was blinded by Caprea of Bjornaer at Crintera after being mistaken for a spy.

label: Carouse
summary: A General Ability for enjoying oneself without adverse effects, such as consuming alcohol without passing out and gaining friends among the lower classes.

label: Carthusians
summary: A strictly cloistered monastic order, the extreme example of monastic insularity.

label: Cascade of Rocks
summary: A Perdo Terram (PeTe 40) spell that can do great damage only if an opponent is on a steep hillside or cliff base, used by the School of Vilano; bypasses Magic Resistance.

label: Castile
summary: A region of Mythic Europe with distinctive inheritance customs, including an example of a bride continuing to rule her own land except for her dowry, and where a widow may guard her son's lands.

label: Casting Tablet
summary: A variant Laboratory Text containing fixed instructions for casting a particular spell, usable by magi who have not learned the spell but dangerous and inflexible.

label: Casting Tools
summary: Tools that Verditius magi must use to cast Formulaic and Ritual spells; they can be enchanted via an Inner House Mystery and become permanent Arcane Connections.

label: Casting Total
summary: The total (Stamina + Form + Technique + Aura + stress die) determining whether a spell is cast, used notably when casting from a Casting Tablet.

label: Castra Solis
summary: The domus magna of House Flambeau in the Provençal Tribunal, a modest manor-house covenant founded by Kaeso atop a cave once sacred to Mithras, south of Bordeaux.

label: Castratus
summary: A Minor General Flaw: the character was castrated before puberty, suffering -3 social rolls in Latin culture; only available to characters born with testicles.

label: Castrum Antiquum
summary: Covenant founded in 852 in the ruins of a Roman fort on Hadrian's Wall; vanished without trace around 1030/1; home of Agricola of Tytalus.

label: Cataplasm of Mandrake
summary: A Theriac of Level 5, Potency Moderate, a secret of the School of Salerno using mandrake and hyoscyamus; it numbs a body part and reduces Wound and Disease Penalties by 3.

label: Catapult of the Mighty Winds
summary: A Cr(Re)Au 30 spell that uses strong winds to hurl an object on an arched trajectory; once airborne the projectile's motion is natural and bypasses Magic Resistance, doing about +10 damage.

label: Cataracts
summary: A Minor Curse (Perdo Corpus effect) clouding the victim's eyes white and penalizing vision-based rolls and reading advancement by -3.

label: Cathars
summary: A heresy spreading in southern France (Languedoc) against which Brother Julian preaches and which the Church combats through the faculties of theology.

label: Cathedral of Chartres
summary: A cathedral nearing completion in 1220 where the Dreux and Capetian families compete to fund the most beautiful south-transept window.

label: Cathedral of St. Pierre in Beauvais
aliases: Cathedral of St. Pierre in Beauvais
summary: A new-style Gothic cathedral north of Paris standing over 150 feet tall, cited as an example of soaring cathedral architecture.

label: Cathedral School Master
summary: A Major Social Status Virtue for a character who teaches at a cathedral school, requiring scores of 5 in Latin and Artes Liberales and granting 240 experience points.

label: Cato of Bonisagus
summary: A spectral Criamon Primus who was a Bonisagus magus before joining; he believes Criamon magi create the majority of all adulterations.

label: Catulus
summary: A Bjornaer apprentice ('cub'), the common property of the sept during the sleeping years of training.

label: Caudelix the Gaul
summary: A ghostly gladiator (Magic Might 20) of the Trier amphitheater, a burly giant of a man wielding a long-handled great axe.

label: Causabon
summary: A magus of House Bonisagus whose journal records his sense of the forests' primal power and his hope that the three domus magnae might share their secrets.

label: Cautious Sorcerer
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus roll three fewer botch dice when casting spells or working in the laboratory.

label: Cautious with (Ability)
summary: A Minor General Virtue letting a character roll two fewer botch dice for a specific Ability.

label: Cautious with Chirurgy
summary: A Virtue commonly taken by empirici that reduces botch risk when using the Chirurgy Ability.

label: Cautious with Medicine
summary: A Virtue that enhances medical skill, reducing the risk of botches when using the Medicine Ability.

label: Cave of Twisting Shadows
summary: A labyrinthine covenant serving as the domus magna of House Criamon, the largest and perhaps unfinished Great Work, whose structures embody the quest for the Enigma; its ghosts teach the Arts.

label: Cement (Reagent)
summary: A Level 5 alchemical Reagent, a dry powder that when sprinkled over loose earth or sand binds it as solid as granite, covering about three paces to six inches deep.

label: Cercistum
summary: A Primus of House Tremere during the Schism War, quoted observing that the Tytali fought a different battle on the Plain of Wolves than the Tremere pretended to.

label: Ceremonial Magic
summary: A method of increasing spellcasting power using natural correspondences, props, and prepared spaces, with casting time reduced by prepared spaces and the Mystical Choreography Virtue.

label: Ceremonial Spontaneous Magic
summary: A Minor Flaw possessed by all known members of the Mercurian lineage as part of the Mercurian Magic Virtue.

label: Ceres
summary: A goddess one of whose priestesses always serves as a hierophant of the Huntress in the Wood.

label: Certamen
summary: The ritualized magical duel by which magi resolve disputes without resorting to Wizard's War.

label: Chamber of Invisibility
summary: A Perdo Imaginem spell (Level 25) that makes a Group of creatures invisible; any affected character who moves or is touched makes everyone visible, and all still cast shadows.

label: Chamber of Spring Breezes
summary: A Creo Auram spell (Level 5) that creates a breeze of fresh air keeping a room's air breathable even if airtight.

label: Chamber of Summer Breezes
summary: A Creo Auram 10 spell with Ignem requisite creating a continual breeze of fresh, dry, warm air to keep a room's humidity and temperature constant, often cast on armarii and book chests.

label: Champagne
summary: The pre-eminent fair cycle of Mythic Europe and a financial center, comprising fairs at Lagny, Bar-sur-Aube, Provins, and Troyes, guaranteed safe by the counts of Champagne.

label: Chancery
summary: A branch of the royal court headed by the chancellor Richard de Marsh, responsible for issuing documents under the Great Seal and keeping government records such as the Pipe Rolls.

label: Change Size
summary: A Muto Terram effect (MuTe 10) enchanted into Falke's talisman that turns it into a leg-band, triggered by Perceive the Change.

label: Changeling
summary: A story-seed faerie who comes regularly to a market for human food to sustain a stolen human child raised by her group living in nearby woodland.

label: Chaos of the Angry Wave
summary: A Rego Aquam spell (ReAq 20) known by Felicia.

label: Chaos of the Angry Waves
summary: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 30) that causes water to churn wildly in a circular area, overturning small craft and penalizing Swim rolls.

label: Chaotic
summary: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab or its outfittings are in constant flux or motion (-2 Safety, +1 Warping, +2 Muto or Rego).

label: Chaotic Magic
summary: A Major Hermetic Flaw: the magus's spontaneous magic is wild, and if it falls short of or exceeds the desired level by more than one, the storyguide decides the uncontrolled results.

label: Chapel That Cannot Sleep
summary: A chapel raised on an ancient battlefield where mythic death-roads converge, disturbing the sleeping dead near an unfortunate covenant.

label: Chapter House
summary: A small dependent covenant founded at a valuable site far from a covenant's main holding, tending to agitate for independence from its motherhouse.

label: CharacterType (Bjornaer Magus)
summary: A magus of House Bjornaer who possesses a heartbeast and belongs to a clan and sept within the ancestor cult.

label: Characteristic
summary: The eight inborn attributes (Intelligence, Perception, Strength, Stamina, Presence, Communication, Dexterity, Quickness) defining a character's potential.

label: Charge of the Angry Winds
summary: An Auram spell whose effect is duplicated by an air elemental power of the same name, adding the elemental's Strength to Ease Factors for acting within the wind.

label: Charged Item
summary: An enchanted item costing no vis that can be used a limited number of times, gaining one charge per five points the Lab Total exceeds the effect level.

label: Charlemagne
summary: The Frankish ruler who attempted (and failed) to dig a canal linking the Main and Danube, and whose late-eighth-century monetary reforms fixed the pound-of-silver system used in Mythic Europe in 1220.

label: Charlemagne's Empire
summary: The historical Frankish empire whose civilizing forces helped wipe out the Gothic witch-cult tradition.

label: Charlemagne's Loaf
summary: A wondrous loaf of bread whose smallest nibble grants the eater incredible courage, giving a +3 on all Bravery rolls (Craft Level 17).

label: Charles Martel
summary: The Frankish King who repulsed the Moorish army at the Battle of Tours in 732, the historical event that destroyed Flambeau's family estate.

label: Charm
summary: Casting aids made by magi who study Faerie Magic that identify a magical effect through sympathetic magic; they may be objects, performances, or pronouncements, and can boost Penetration and Casting Totals.

label: Charm against Putrefaction
summary: A Creo Corpus spell (Level 10) that prevents decay of a human corpse or severed body part; used by necromancers to preserve revived corpses.

label: Charm Magic
summary: A Minor Folk Inner Mystery (Virtue) allowing a Merinita to incorporate charms into her spells, granting Casting Total and Penetration bonuses through sympathetic magic.

label: Charter Demon
summary: A typical demon with Infernal Might 15 (Mentem) that offers services such as disease relief or merchant bonuses to townsfolk in exchange for tithes or worship under a demonic charter.

label: Charter of the Forest
summary: A charter issued in 1217 alongside the Magna Carta reissue, restricting the king's forest rights and limiting forest officials from imposing penalties of life or limb.

label: Chasidim
summary: German Jewish mystics who developed a cultural and religious renaissance after the First Crusade, emphasizing asceticism, martyrdom, and lifelong penitence.

label: Chaudepysse
summary: A Minor Choleric Disease contracted from unclean women, notoriously difficult to cure, causing painful urination.

label: Chavin of Tytalus
summary: A magus of House Tytalus whose spells all promote or advocate war or violence per his sigil; his version of Voice of the Lake makes the lake sound arrogant.

label: Cheating the Reaper
summary: A Creo Corpus ritual (Level 30) that resolves a major or lesser aging crisis; each application causes Warping.

label: Cheshire
summary: One of the two English palatinates, where the Earl of Chester holds all the authority of the king.

label: Chester
summary: A small walled city and capital of the palatine county of Cheshire where the earl of Chester is the highest authority, with a leather trade and a pagan shrine of Minerva carved into nearby rock.

label: Childbed Fever
summary: A Major Sanguine Disease afflicting women who have just given birth, caused by the childbed fever demon.

label: Childbed Fever Demon
summary: A demon with Might 10 (Corpus) that attempts to enter a woman's body during birth, causing fever and rotting of the reproductive organs; its magical attack can be resisted with Magic Resistance.

label: Chimera
summary: A noble hybrid inner heartbeast combining features of two mundane creatures (such as a griffin, hippogriff, or unicorn), produced by the Mystery of the Chimera.

label: Chiron
summary: The figure who warned Jason that the Argonauts would be lost unless Orpheus accompanied them, a prophecy fulfilled at the sirens' island.

label: Chirurgeon
summary: A practitioner of chirurgy (surgery, bone-setting, phlebotomy, cautery, midwifery), considered a craft; includes barber-surgeons who assist medici in therapeutic procedures.

label: Chirurgy
summary: A healing Ability practiced by chirurgeons; the Surgical Empiricus Flaw restricts the character to a single specialization, halving the score for other applications.

label: Chnoubis the Serpent
summary: A lion-headed serpent Daimon (Magic Might 30, Mentem) summoned for his abilities to scry and ferret out secrets, claiming to be a native of the Nile.

label: Chrétien of Troyes
summary: The most famous trouvère of northern France, whose Arthurian poems concentrate on Arthur and his peers.

label: Christianity
summary: One of the three most important Divine religions in Mythic Europe; many magi are Christians and its relics are most common.

label: Chromatic Flames
summary: A Level 4 alchemical Reagent that, when sprinkled over flames or mixed with fuel, causes them to burn a different hue chosen by the alchemist until extinguished.

label: Church of Saint Cyprian
summary: A church within Valnastium valley whose presence creates a Divine aura up to 6 and has prevented the covenant's Magic aura from developing further.

label: Church of the Holy Sepulcher
aliases: church of the Holy Sepulcher in Jerusalem
summary: A holy site in Jerusalem with an extremely strong Divine aura; casting a spell there incurs the maximum example of botch dice.

label: Church Upbringing
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw: the character was schooled and raised by the Church, leaving him less knowledgeable about society and requiring 25 experience points on Church-related Academic Abilities.

label: Cian
summary: One of the five great Welsh poets believed by the Order to have left Daimons behind after death.

label: Cindrallon
summary: A Flambeau apprentice made a full maga after only seven years for single-handedly slaying a renounced magus in a Wizard's March using a spear.

label: Circle of Beast Warding
summary: A Rego Animal spell (Level 5) in which the caster inscribes a circle that no normal beast will cross.

label: Circle of Encompassing Flame
summary: A Creo Ignem (CrIg 35) fire spell known by the Flambeau template magus.

label: Circle of Encompassing Flames
summary: A Creo Ignem spell (Level 35) that creates a 6-foot-high circle of flames dealing +20 damage to anyone moving through; with a Rego requisite the circle can shrink or grow as the caster concentrates.

label: Circle of Time
summary: House Criamon's core belief that time runs forever in identical cycles, an unguarded prison from which they seek to escape with all humanity.

label: Circling Winds of Protection
summary: A Creo Auram spell (Level 20) with a Rego requisite that surrounds the caster with fast-circling winds that obscure and penalize attacks against them.

label: Circular Ward Against Demons
summary: A Rego Vim spell (R: Touch, D: Ring, T: Circle) that prevents creatures with Infernal Might equal to or less than its level from entering a circle or harming those within; at night it may appear as a silver-hued dome.

label: Circular Winds of Protection
summary: A wind-based spell referenced as a strength level achievable by the Whistle Up the Wind Ability.

label: Circulus Ruber
summary: The oldest covenant in the Hibernian Tribunal, plagued by a Cailleach (an evil faerie hag) that cannot breach its Aegis of the Hearth.

label: Cirion
summary: A magus of House Tremere who declared Wizard War against Pietro of House Diedne of Oakdell covenant in 1004 AD.

label: Cistercian
summary: A monastic tradition that balances its monastic offices with physical or mental labor.

label: Cistercian Order
summary: A monastic order founded by Robert of Molesme at Cîteaux and spread by Bernard of Clairvaux, the white monks who farm sheep in isolated areas and drive out inhabitants of acquired lands.

label: City and Guild
summary: An Ars Magica sourcebook covering craftsmen, guilds, and social statuses, referenced for rules on masons and on Social Status Virtues like Factor.

label: City-Watch
summary: Patrols in large towns that enforce curfew and interrupt crimes in progress, but with no formal investigative function to solve past crimes.

label: Civil and Canon Law
summary: The Academic Ability covering legal knowledge, required at score 3 for the Town Magistrate Virtue and usable to quickly resolve court cases via a Communication roll.

label: Clan Arelie
summary: The 'Remember' clan of House Bjornaer, the most outward-looking and Harmonist (pacifist), preserving stories and teaching of the ancestors.

label: Clan Ilfetu
summary: A clan within House Bjornaer that gives extra ritual training and teaches the Divination method of haemagmomancy (divination by the blood splatters of wounded animals).

label: Clan Maruhs
summary: The 'Strive' clan of House Bjornaer, romantic, passionate Wilderists known for wildness and as poets and heroes.

label: Clan Midusulf
summary: The 'Lead' clan of House Bjornaer, arch-conservative Wilderists most opposed to the Harmonists, with the deepest understanding of the Mystery of the Heartbeast.

label: Clan Mysteries
summary: Minor-Virtue Mysteries unique to each Bjornaer clan, Initiated by elder clan members to help fulfill duties to their ancestors.

label: Clan Sirnas
summary: The 'Protect' clan of House Bjornaer, the most active Harmonist clan and protectors of all Bjornaer magi, which absorbed most ninth-century Merinita defectors.

label: Clan Wilkis
summary: The 'Nourish' clan of House Bjornaer, Harmonists who strengthen the House, enforce Council decisions, and hunt down those who endanger the House.

label: Clarion Call of the War Horse
aliases: Clarion Call of the War Horse
summary: A MuMe 15 Sound-Target spell that heartens anyone hearing the caster's battle cry, granting a +3 bonus to their Brave Personality Trait.

label: Clear Breath of the Consummate Liar
aliases: Clear Breath of the Consummate Liar
summary: A Muto Vim (Mentem) 20 spell invented by Imanitos Mendax that lets him manipulate a Frosty Breath of the Spoken Lie cast on himself to appear truthful or lying as desired.

label: Clear Sight of the Naiad
summary: An Intellego Aquam spell (Level 5) that lets the caster see as clearly through water as through air for a single moment.

label: Clear Thinker
summary: A Virtue that decreases the penalties for reduced Fatigue Levels in debate by one point and is recommended for politically minded Tytalan magi.

label: Clemens
summary: The most senior master of Fengheld of House Tremere, filius of Stentorius, who runs Fengheld's biggest chapter house.

label: Clenching Grasp of the Crushed Heart
aliases: Clenching Grasp of the Crushed Heart
summary: A Perdo Corpus spell (Level 40) that, with a clenching motion of the hand, causes the victim to double over and die at once.

label: Clerk
summary: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a literate professional such as a scribe, accountant, lawyer, or functionary, possibly in minor or holy orders.

label: Cloak of Black Feathers
summary: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 30) with an Animal requisite that transforms the caster into a raven via a cape of raven feathers.

label: Cloak of Mist
summary: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 40) with an Auram requisite that turns the caster into a human-sized cohesive mist able to float and seep through cracks.

label: Cloak of the Duck's Feathers
summary: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 5) that makes water run off an object or creature, protecting it from dampness unless submerged.

label: Close Family Ties
summary: A Minor Story Flaw: the character's family is one of the most important things in their life and supports them even at personal risk, but requires help in return.

label: Closed Mouth of the Nightwalker
summary: A PeMe 40 Spectacle-Target spell that makes anyone who sees the caster instantly forget having done so.

label: Closing the Earth's Gate
summary: A Perdo Aquam spell (Level 25) that dries a single spring permanently so it never flows again.

label: Clouds of Rain and Thunder
summary: A Creo Auram spell (Level 25) that creates a small but severe rainstorm with lightning and winds while the caster concentrates.

label: Clouds of Summer Snow
summary: A Creo Auram spell (Level 25) that creates clouds dropping snow over an area about half a mile across without affecting temperature.

label: Clouds of Thunderous Might
summary: A Rego Auram spell (Level 30) that gathers pre-existing clouds and winds into a small storm under the caster's control while they can see it.

label: Clovis
summary: A Gifted descendant of Merovech who rose to become the first Christian Frankish king and founder of the Merovingian dynasty, whose magical lineage endured after his death.

label: Clumsy
summary: A Minor General Flaw: the character is ungraceful, at -3 on related rolls and rolling an extra botch die on Dexterity actions.

label: Clumsy Magic
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw: the magus has trouble targeting spells, with aiming rolls of 0 automatically botching and -3 to Finesse rolls.

label: Cluniac Order
summary: A group within the Benedictines whose houses depend on the abbey of Cluny in France, placing great emphasis on the opus dei and building splendid churches.

label: Cluny
summary: An abbey in France that heads the Cluniac Order, a group of monasteries spread across Europe, and which is rich and powerful.

label: Clutch
summary: A study group of the Criamon magi within a single Tribunal, originally living as a covenant following a single path; the Cave of Twisting Shadows holds the Central Clutch.

label: Clutch of Ebony Eggs
summary: The Criamon clutch filled with the servants of the Path of Strife, the only clutch with no followers of other paths.

label: Co
summary: Reference to Corpus in spell shorthand (ReCo 65) for the Summoning the Champions effect of the Horn of Champions.

label: Coagulation
summary: A demonic power allowing demons to manufacture a solid body from ambient unformed matter; in Christian lands demons must abandon coagulated form on Holy Saturday.

label: Coat of Flame
summary: A Creo Ignem spell (Level 25) with a Rego requisite that swathes the target in fire dealing +5 damage every round while the spell is in effect; the requisite keeps the fire from spreading.

label: Code of Garus
summary: The written code of chivalric conduct for the milites, devised by Primus Garus and loosely based on Charlemagne's code for his knights.

label: The Code of Hermes
summary: The law of the Order of Hermes, sworn in the Hermetic Oath, forbidding magi from harming one another, dealing with devils, or endangering the Order.

label: Coenobium Rhodanien
summary: A covenant in the Provençal Tribunal notorious for its involvement in Hermetic politics, preventing the foundation of any covenants it does not control over a large area of the tribunal.

label: Coenwulf
summary: A member of the Sept of Orn (Clan Wilkis) trained by Hosvir Goatlegs.

label: Coerce the Spirit of Anger
summary: A ReMe 20 spell that compels a spirit of anger to obey the caster through dramatic threats, with effectiveness determined by a Communication + Leadership roll.

label: Coerce the Spirits of the Night
aliases: Coerce the Spirits of the Night
summary: A spell that makes a ghost obey the caster as long as it can be coerced with threats such as defiling its grave or banishing it to Hell.

label: Coeris
summary: The domus magna of House Tremere in the Transylvanian Tribunal, to which Gifted children identified at the Prague slave market are delivered.

label: Cog
summary: The main clinker-built trade ship of the Atlantic, North Sea, and Baltic, usually carrying 20 tons but sometimes 100 to 140 tons.

label: Coils of Entangling Plants
summary: A Rego Herbam spell (ReHe 20) known by Ioannes Acer with Mastery in Fast Casting.

label: Coils of the Entangling Plants
summary: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 20) that animates grass and small plants in a field to grab and wrap around the people nearest them.

label: Colens Arcanorum
summary: A House Bonisagus office, held by Andrus, jointly responsible for disseminating the House's knowledge and research.

label: Colloqui Cum
summary: A magical power of the Virtuous Hound (Imaginem, 0 points) that lets it speak by creating sounds apparently from its mouth.

label: Cologne
summary: The largest city of the Holy Roman Empire north of the Alps and the most important trading city in Germany, ruled by its powerful archbishop, home to the relics of the Three Magi.

label: Colomen
summary: The leader of the Columbae tradition when it officially joined the Order, who with his wife Gwyndolen adapted their ward-powers to Hermetic magic and spread their spells.

label: Columbae
summary: A tradition of Welsh hedge wizards within House Ex Miscellanea famous for ward-magic (the Warding Ability); they introduced Ring/Circle warding spells to the Order.

label: Comfort of the Drenched Traveler
summary: A Perdo Aquam spell (Level 5) that dries a person and their clothes.

label: Command Animals
summary: A Major Supernatural Tainted Virtue letting a character mentally command mundane animals of a species linked to the tainting demon.

label: Commanding Aura
summary: A Free Supernatural Virtue granted by the pope or the Divine, giving a Church officer a power like Aura of Rightful Authority plus Magic Resistance and Soak scaled by rank.

label: Commanding the Harnessed Beast
summary: A Rego Animal spell (Level 30) that implants a complicated command into an animal, which it carries out to the best of its ability.

label: Common Giant
summary: An enormous ugly man-like magical creature (Magic Might 12, Corpus) about 20 feet tall, found throughout the British Isles; unlike many magical creatures, giants eat, drink, breathe, and age.

label: Common Sense
summary: A Virtue whose effects are granted by Familiarity with the Fae, but only in situations pertaining to faeries.

label: Companion
summary: Noteworthy non-grog, non-magus characters who may be played alongside magi; suggested examples include foresters, merchants, priests, and figures like Torven and David ben David.

label: Companion Animal
summary: A Minor Social Status Flaw (animals only): the character is the Animal Companion of another character and has little control over his own life.

label: Compassionate
summary: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw: the character helps anyone wounded or in trouble and cannot bear to see suffering in others.

label: Comprehend Magic
summary: A Major Supernatural Virtue and Ability (the defining power of the Lineage of Pralix) that lets a character see, analyze, and understand active magics without penalizing Magic Resistance.

label: Compress of Mallow
summary: A Theriac of Level 15, Potency Mild, a cool bandage of mallow and cucumber that soothes burns and heals any Light Wound caused by fire over a week.

label: Compulsion
summary: A Personality Flaw driving a creature toward a behavior; wolves have Compulsion (killing) reflecting their bloodthirsty medieval perception.

label: Compulsion (Lies)
summary: A Flaw compelling Imanitos Mendax to lie.

label: Compulsive Lying
summary: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw: the character finds it hard to tell the truth and embellishes or invents stories whenever he won't be immediately caught.

label: Concentration
summary: An Ability used to maintain concentration on spells and against disruptions such as sneezing; rolled to release individuals from Coils of the Entangling Plants.

label: Conciatta
summary: A brilliant tenth-century theorist of House Bonisagus who extended Hermetic magic to affect the Divine, Faerie, and Infernal realms and famously suffered from The Constant Expression Flaw.

label: Concoction of Litharge and Henbane
summary: A Theriac of Level 15, Potency Strong, a poison combining litharge, henbane, cinnabar and other ingredients that inflicts a Heavy Wound unless the imbiber succeeds at a Stamina roll.

label: Concordia
summary: A short-lived covenant (821–823) in the Lake District that attempted to weld Ex Miscellanea traditions together but fell apart from internal tension.

label: Confidence
summary: A pool of points a character can spend to add +3 per point to a roll after seeing the result; points are awarded for achievements and good roleplaying.

label: Confidence Point
summary: A point a character can spend (for example) to walk away from a situation that would otherwise increase a Verditius magus's Hubris score.

label: Confraternity Member
summary: A Minor Story Flaw marking membership in one of the smaller cults of magi in House Verditius, granting access to a confraternity's unique Inner Mystery.

label: Confraternity of Balento
summary: A confraternity of House Verditius founded by Balento that produces wood-carved devices imbued with fire spells, with members claiming descent from Vulcan.

label: Confraternity of Himinis the Mad
summary: A confraternity of House Verditius founded by Himinis the Mad that produces cursed items and trick devices using the Bind Curse Mystery.

label: Confraternity of Irene the Younger
summary: A confraternity of House Verditius founded by the Byzantine princess Irene that creates magical paintings, statues, and mosaics affecting viewers and surroundings.

label: Confraternity of Roland
summary: A confraternity of House Verditius founded by Roscius that crafts magical swords engraved with an 'R', studying the sword Durendal.

label: Confusion of the Insane Vibrations
summary: A Rego Imaginem spell (Level 30) that makes the target see everything vibrate and hear displaced sounds, imposing -3 on Attack and Defense and extra botch dice.

label: Confusion of the Numbed Will
summary: A spell that confuses a person, who must make an Intelligence roll to take direct action and always strikes last in combat.

label: Conjuration of the Indubitable Cold
summary: A Perdo Ignem spell (Level 25) that cools the air within ten paces below freezing, chilling nonliving things thoroughly and costing living things a Fatigue level while shrinking fires.

label: Conjuration of Wild Thyme
summary: A Creo Herbam 20 Ritual spell that creates ten thousand doses of wild thyme, prepared and dried; a different spell is required for each herb.

label: Conjure the Sturdy Vine
summary: A Creo Herbam spell (Level 5) that grows 10 paces of strong, pliable vine suitable for use as rope from wood or fertile soil.

label: Conjuring the House of God
summary: A ritual Creo Terram spell (Level 45) that creates an unconsecrated church with vaulted ceilings, towers, and stained glass windows.

label: Conjuring the Mystic Tower
summary: A Creo spell that conjures a stone tower, allowing the caster to determine the layout of its chambers; can also be used by a magus to construct a lab building.

label: Conrad of Urach
summary: A cardinal legate present in Montpellier preparing to announce the pope's desired statutes that would make the Bishop of Maguelone the university's sole authority.

label: Constanta the Tessellatrix
summary: A student of the Jerbiton Primus Andru, extremely active in coordinating her fellow antigones.

label: Constantine V
summary: Byzantine Emperor, son of Leo III, against whom the League of Iconophiles was still intriguing at the time of the First Tribunal as monasteries were sacked and icons burned.

label: Constantinople
summary: The great trading city at the gateway between Europe and the Orient, founded as Byzantium in 658 BC and renamed by Emperor Constantine; captured by the Fourth Crusade in 1204 to become the Latin Empire's seat.

label: Consumed Casting Tools
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw, only for Verditius magi: the magus's casting tools are magically consumed after use, taking an hour to remake.

label: Contagion
summary: A natural principle (pars pro toto) by which substances acquire second qualities through association or contact, underlying Arcane Connections.

label: Continence
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw: the character does not engage in sexual activity, due to a vow of celibacy or personal choice.

label: Control Fertility
summary: A Supernatural Ability that enhances or withdraws the vegetative spirits in living things, affecting fertility, milk yield, conception, and disease; the defining Virtue of the Scinnfolk.

label: Converse with Plant and Tree
summary: An Intellego Herbam spell (Level 25) that lets you speak with a plant for one conversation, with detail depending on the plant's type.

label: Convoluted Mind
summary: A Minor General Tainted Virtue giving +3 on Infernal Lore rolls about demons and a common-sense-like warning when dealing with them.

label: Copper Rooster Inn
summary: An inn at Basel maintained by House Mercere, frequented by Redcaps traveling between the Alps, Rhine, and Normandy Tribunals.

label: Cornelius Clemens
summary: The Roman commander of the 8th legion who built the Black Forest Road during the rule of Vespasian, aided by Mercurian priests.

label: Corpse Magic
summary: A Supernatural Ability allowing the character to temporarily revive and command a relatively intact, unburied corpse.

label: Corpus
summary: Form governing the human body.

label: Corrguineach
summary: An Irish tradition of wizards controlling elemental spirits who were enemies of House Diedne and joined House Flambeau to exterminate them; a Hermetic Sahir variant.

label: Corrupt Beast
summary: A compulsory Minor Supernatural Flaw for corrupt beasts granting Infernal Might 5, a sinful Personality Trait at +6, a repellent appearance, and the Tainted with Evil Flaw.

label: Corrupted Abilities
summary: A Minor Supernatural Tainted Flaw: one or more Abilities was taught by a demon, giving +3 for selfish use and -3 for selfless use, with use sensed by Divine Powers.

label: Corrupted Arts
summary: A Minor Hermetic Tainted Flaw: a Hermetic Art was studied from a corrupted source, giving +3 to Casting Total for sinful use and -3 for selfless use; tainted magic appears unholy.

label: Corrupted Spells
summary: A Minor Hermetic Tainted Flaw: at least 30 levels of formulaic spells learned from a corrupted source, giving +3 to Casting and Penetration for sinful use and -3 for selfless use.

label: Corsica
summary: The island where Verditius was born; site of his blood feud and capture, and where the Rings of Verditius were possibly lost.

label: Corvus of Bjornaer
summary: A mature Bjornaer magus of Voluntas with a raven Heartbeast, specializing in Intellego magic and suspected of scrying on other magi.

label: Coryza
summary: A Minor Phlegmatic Disease caused by a cold, damp environment producing an excess of phlegm in the head.

label: Council of Elders
summary: The six-magus governing body of House Bjornaer at Crintera, holding the Seats of the Bear, Wolf, Horse, Stag, Eagle, and Swan, with the Senior Elder holding the casting vote.

label: Council of Four
summary: The ruling council of House Ex Miscellanea representing different facets of the House's interests, instituted by Pralix and re-instated by later Primi.

label: Council of Members
summary: The governing council of a covenant, comprising its probationary and full members, which holds covenant resources in common and decides matters by vote.

label: Council of Tours
summary: A Church council whose decree of 1163 forbade the participation of monks in commercial medical practice and non-monastic university education.

label: Countess Jeanne of Flanders
summary: The current lord of Brugge, married to Fernando of Portugal and living in Lille, who is without an heir.

label: Court coram rege
summary: The highest court of the land, where the king himself sits in judgment wherever he is; only the most important cases reach it and there is no further appeal.

label: Court of Bright Winter
summary: A Seelie faerie court associated with light, snow, cold, and the hunt, found in midwinter among the high hills of the Westerwald; rival to Dark Summer.

label: Court of Dark Summer
summary: An Unseelie faerie court associated with dark, fire, warmth, and agriculture, found in midsummer in the swampy Hunsruck forest west of the Rhine Gorge; rival to Bright Winter.

label: Court of Piepowder
summary: The court that upholds justice during a fair, named from the French for the dusty feet of itinerant tradesmen; it handles trade-related prosecutions under merchant law.

label: Court of the Alder Prince
summary: A faerie court of the seasons, suggested to be sited in the Odenwald, paired with the Willow Maiden's court in the Swabian Forest.

label: Court of the Bees
summary: A faerie court with which the young Spring in the Woods covenant has developed good relations.

label: Covenant
summary: The home and community of a group of magi, the basic social unit of the Order, with its own resources, charter and politics.

label: Covenant Charter
summary: The written constitution of a covenant defining membership, governance, resources, rights, responsibilities, and censure; a sample based on Arae Flaviae is provided.

label: Covenant Lore
summary: An Ability concerning knowledge of a covenant; under the Stuck in Your Ways Flaw the character uses the lower of an Ability and his current Covenant Lore for certain Stress Rolls.

label: Covenant of Calebais
summary: A covenant that fell under mysterious circumstances and has lain undisturbed since, suggested as a place to explore (referenced via the supplement Calebais: The Broken Covenant).

label: Covenant of Crisp Winds
summary: A constantly mobile covenant living on a flotilla of ships that follows a route around the Mediterranean collecting vis and trade goods.

label: Covenant of the Castle of Fees
aliases: Covenant of the Castle of Fees
summary: A covenant where, by Unnatural Law, glass is as durable and hard as iron and used as building material and armament.

label: Covenant of the Monkey's Reed
summary: A covenant on a floating island whose aura, warping to a pattern, is slowly twisting its people and structures into an ancient Egyptian village.

label: Covenant of the Redbreasted Warriors
summary: A fallen covenant whose aura a faerie king is said to hold captive in a wine bottle.

label: Covenant of the Solemn Scholars
summary: A covenant where, by Unnatural Law, children are able to fly until they lose their virginity.

label: Covenant Upbringing
summary: A Flaw (and background) reflecting a character raised within a covenant, granting Latin and Order of Hermes Lore; held by the Scribe, Minstrel, Washer-woman, and Weapons Instructor templates.

label: Coventry
summary: An English town near which the Redcaps' base, Mercer House, is situated.

label: Covet Device
summary: A Personality Trait left in an attuned item that makes its owner crave the device, building up over seasons of ownership.

label: Cow and Calf Oath
summary: An agreement, originating in a Hibernia Tribunal ruling, under which a book purchaser will not sell or freely give copies without the seller's permission.

label: Craft
summary: The skill governing a craftsman's production; a character's Craft Ability score determines Workshop Totals and how many items can be produced in a season.

label: Craft Amulets
summary: The Minor Hermetic Virtue of the Karaites tradition.

label: Craft Automata
summary: A Major Hermetic Virtue and Ability (initial score 1) granted by the Automata Mystery, allowing a character to construct mechanical men and beasts.

label: Craft: Goldsmith
summary: A Craft Ability for goldsmithing whose higher scores represent more precise, time-consuming metalworking methods.

label: Craft Guild Training
summary: A Minor General Virtue granting 50 experience points in Craft, Profession, Bargain, or Guild Organization Lore from above-average apprenticeship.

label: Craft Magic
summary: The Major Non-Hermetic Virtue of the Rusticani that lets a character build spells and enchanted devices through craft work rather than words and gestures.

label: Craft: Mason
summary: A Craft Ability for masonry; Villard de Honnecourt's sketchbook tractatus can be studied as a quality-7 source for it.

label: Craft: Percamenarius
summary: The craft of making parchment; a Perception + Finesse roll substitutes for it to determine the quality of vellum produced by the spell Hide to Parchment.

label: Craft: Poetry
summary: A Craft Ability for writing poems, increased by studying other poets' literature and used to determine a poem's Aesthetic Quality.

label: Craft: Potter
summary: A Craft Ability governing pottery, used by Maker of Textured Vessels and Maker of Water Vessels to determine vessel shapes and bonuses.

label: Crafter's Healing
summary: A Major Supernatural Virtue letting a character magically heal wounds by touching them with the tools of his trade; it grants the Crafter's Healing Ability and is a power Hermetic magi cannot understand.

label: Craftsman
summary: A free Social Status Virtue for a general craftsman practicing a trade not represented by a guild, who may be male or female and live rurally or in town.

label: Cralian of Tremere
summary: A magus of House Tremere whose version of Disguise of the New Visage always produces a visage as unassuming as possible.

label: Cramped
summary: A Minor laboratory Structure Flaw: equipment is packed too close together, hampering all but one specialized activity (-1 General Quality, -1 Upkeep, -2 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

label: Crateuas
summary: The greatest herbalist of antiquity, author of the first pharmacopoeia and herbal, the original Root-Cutter, and ancestor of the Pharmacopoeians.

label: Craving for Travel
summary: A Minor General Flaw: the character suffers loneliness and boredom penalties if he does not expose himself to new experiences, getting worse the longer he stays in one place.

label: Creating an Empty Book From a Filled One
aliases: Creating an Empty Book From a Filled One
summary: A Perdo Animal 3 spell that creates a palimpsest from an existing book by flaking away a thin layer from each page.

label: Creation of an Undeserved Reputation
summary: A CrMe 20 spell that creates a false memory of a person confessing to an enjoyable evening of intercourse with another, damaging reputation.

label: Creation of the Simile
summary: A CrMe 20 spell that creates a new category of thing in the viewer's mind, granting unconscious familiarity with a broad range of its instances.

label: Creative Block
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw: the magus has problems creating new things in the lab, taking -3 to Lab Totals unless using a Laboratory Text or being taught.

label: Creeping Chasm
summary: A Rego Terram spell that creates a chasm running from the caster's feet toward a target, growing wider as it travels.

label: Creeping Oil
summary: A Creo Aquam spell (Level 15) that saturates a porous material with flammable oil which, if ignited, causes fire damage.

label: Cremona
summary: One of the famed southern schools of medicine with access to the corpus of Arabic medical texts, where many Greek and Roman texts were translated from Arabic.

label: Creo
summary: Technique meaning 'I create'. Creates things and brings them to a more perfect state; the Art of healing and creation.

label: Crest of the Earth Wave
summary: A Rego Terram spell that creates a wave in the earth traveling outward, tossing aside those caught in its path for +10 damage.

label: Crintera
summary: The domus magna of House Bjornaer, located on the island of Rügen in the Eastern Marches, organized around six council seats of Elders and divided into six clans. Its turb is the fiercest and most bestial of the Rhine covenants.

label: Cripple the Howling Wolf
summary: A Perdo Animal spell (Level 25) that cleanly breaks one of a target animal's legs, with damage healing as a Medium Wound.

label: Critias
summary: A Sophist and leading member of the Thirty Tyrants of Athens, quoted in the Analects of Tytalus; he held that virtue could be imposed by force and religion was a human invention to control the masses.

label: Cross of Saint Oswald
summary: The wooden cross Saint Oswald raised before battle; its splinters and the moss growing on it have healing powers, as in the cure of the monk Bothelm.

label: Crow's Voice
summary: A Minor Curse (Muto Corpus Animal effect) causing the victim to caw throughout speech, penalizing communication rolls and spell casting by -3.

label: Crucifixo
summary: The current Jerbiton Primus's familiar, a cat of the Black Lineage who is not yet the King of the Cats but may become so when the current king (his mentor) dies.

label: Cruel
summary: A Minor Flaw making a character cruel, taken by the Familiar Cat as a species Flaw.

label: Crystal Custodian
summary: An invested magical item invented by Gudrun Tigurina of Verditius at Durenmar.

label: Cuenca
summary: An Iberian town whose fuero of one thousand clauses, granted by Alfonso VIII of Castile in 1190, regulates inheritance, criminal law, and Christian-Jewish relations.

label: Culhwch Ex Miscellanea
summary: A mature magus at Cad Gadu, Gwrhyr's former apprentice turned bully fond of tormenting mundanes; particularly skilled with Ignem.

label: Cult of Ancestors
summary: House Bjornaer's tradition of revering ancestral spirits and Great Beasts, taught through House Bjornaer Lore alongside the House's Exoteric Mystery.

label: Cult of Diana
summary: A struggling pagan cult of the goddess Diana that absorbed the rites of Vesta and survived the Fall of Rome in the wilderness; Merinita is said to have been one of its high priestesses.

label: Cult of Hephaestus
summary: An ancient Greek Mystery Cult of smiths and artificers founded by the god Hephaestus, ancestral to House Verditius.

label: Cult of Isis
summary: A Roman cult once centered on early Florence, with relics found in the Roman Temple of Isis in a magical regio in the city, occupied by a High Priestess and followers.

label: Cult of Mercury
summary: An ancient cult whose powerful rituals are sought as Hermetic treasures; a fallen temple of Mercury still contains details of some of its rituals, and recovering its lost rituals can be an object of a quest.

label: Cult of Mithras
summary: An ancient Roman mystery cult worshiping the savior-god Mithras; a remnant magical lineage founded by Kaeso forms the Mithraic tradition within House Flambeau.

label: Cult of the Dead
summary: An alleged cult blamed by medieval writers for the rise of the restless dead; its existence, identity, and responsibility are left to the storyguide.

label: Cult of Vulcan
summary: The Roman successor of the Cult of Hephaestus, renamed under the empire, which emphasized destructive fire magic and supplied enchanted items to Caesars and the Cult of Mercury.

label: Cunning
summary: The animal equivalent of Intelligence; Animal spells may affect beasts with Cunning analogous to Mentem affecting human minds.

label: Curse of Circe
summary: A transformation spell that turns a target into a pig; cited as an example whose effect could be modified by experimentation to turn the target into a goat instead.

label: Curse of Slander
summary: A Minor General or Supernatural Flaw: unpleasant rumors about the character spread wherever he stays, building a bad Reputation centered on a section of mundane society.

label: Curse of the Desert
summary: A Perdo Aquam spell that removes virtually all fluid from a target's body, dealing damage that armor does not protect against; the target must drink within minutes or die.

label: Curse of the Evil Humors
summary: A MuAu 25 spell that converts clean air into a noxious cloud of foul humors that can cause malaria (a Medium Wound) on a failed Stamina roll.

label: Curse of the Haunted Forest
summary: A Muto Herbam ritual (Level 60) with a Perdo requisite that turns a normal small forest into a haunted, conscious, and cruel dangerous place.

label: Curse of the Leprous Flesh
summary: A Perdo Corpus spell (Level 25) that inflicts leprosy on the target, causing an Incapacitating Wound and loss of Stamina as the flesh rots.

label: Curse of the Ravenous Swarm
summary: A Creo Animal Ritual spell (Level 50) with a Rego requisite that calls a swarm of locusts or destructive insects to devastate an area's plant life and fields.

label: Curse of the Rhine Gorge
summary: A purported long-term doom causing every covenant and noble dynasty of the Rhine Gorge to fail within roughly seven decades; attributed to one of four supernatural realm causes.

label: Curse of the Rotted Wood
summary: A Perdo Herbam spell (Level 5) that causes a non-living wooden object up to the size of a door to rot and fall apart into dust.

label: Curse of the Unportended Plague
summary: A Perdo Corpus ritual (Level 55) that starts a plague within a city or boundary; its use or transcription is rigorously discouraged by most of the Order of Hermes.

label: Curse of the Unruly Tongue
summary: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 5) that causes the target to stutter and slur words, penalizing communication and spoken spellcasting.

label: Curse of Venus
summary: A Major Story Flaw: the character is attractive to unwanted people and falls in love with inappropriate people in inappropriate circumstances.

label: Curse-Throwing
summary: A Major Supernatural Virtue and Ability allowing a character to cure diseases and remove curses by transferring them to another person; called Sin-Eating in some cultures.

label: Cursed
summary: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab suffers a supernatural curse with appropriate Characteristic penalties.

label: Cursed Guile
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw, the boy-who-cried-wolf curse likely from Infernal influence: three extra botch dice with Guile and rarely being believed even when honest.

label: Custos
summary: A social-status Virtue denoting a trusted covenant servant or guard, taken by the glass-blower, lore-master, and political agent templates.

label: Cybelle
summary: A goddess of the wilderness honored in a True Merinitae Initiation festival held from the 15th to 27th of March, with rites including ritual castration beneath a sacred pine.

label: Cyclic Magic
summary: A Hermetic Virtue/Flaw making a magus's power wax and wane with a cycle; Felicia has Cyclic Magic (Positive) in winter and (Negative) in summer.

label: Cyclic Magic (negative)
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw: the magus's magic is attuned to a cycle of nature and is less potent at specific times, giving -3 to Lab Totals and Casting Scores then.

label: Cyrillus of Argentoratum
summary: A ghostly gladiator (Magic Might 20) of the Trier amphitheater, a wiry retetarius armed with trident and net and wearing a mask of Poseidon.

label: Czech
summary: One of the three legendary founding brothers of the Slavic peoples; ancestor who led his tribe, the Czechs, to settle in Bohemia, and from whom the Premyslid dynasty descends.

label: Dagger of Ice
summary: A Cr(Re)Aq 10 spell that creates and hurls a foot-long icicle inflicting +5 damage if it penetrates Magic Resistance, then shatters.

label: Daimon
summary: Ancient, named individual spirits dwelling deep in the Magic Realm, being the spirits of heroes, ancient pagan deities, or sacred groves; they cannot enter the material world but project Aspects of themselves as agents on Earth.

label: Dama
summary: The Praeco of the Provençal Tribunal, a House Merinita maga born in 993 who fell into Twilight and emerged, and is rumored to lead a Mystery Cult not part of House Merinita.

label: Damaged
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is partially damaged, e.g. from an accident, taking one season to repair (-2 General Quality, -1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

label: Damhadh-Duidas
summary: A Gaelic hedge wizard from the same magical tradition as Damhan-Allaidh who joined Pralix's crusade against the warlock; eponym of the Damhadh-Duidsan tradition.

label: Damhadh-Duidsan
summary: A tradition of House Ex Miscellanea descended from Damhadh-Duidas who carve Ogam runes to curse, wound, and heal; they try to escape their Infernal past, with Giant Blood common.

label: Damhan-Allaidh
summary: A powerful and evil wizard in the British Isles who led organized resistance to the Order in the early ninth century; defeated by Pralix though rumors persist he survived.

label: Damietta
summary: A city whose fall to the Crusaders the previous year resulted in slaves purchased into Levantine and Theban Tribunal covenants.

label: Damp
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is waterlogged or moist, spoiling parchment and ingredients (+1 Upkeep, -1 Health, -1 Aesthetics, +1 Aquam).

label: Dance of the Staves
summary: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 5) that causes a long thin non-living wooden object to lash about wildly and strike its holder for +4 damage.

label: Dance That Heals
summary: A Major Supernatural Virtue from some Sufi traditions granting the ability to dance objects to wholeness, like Path of Walking Backward magi.

label: Danket
summary: Gravis's faerie caricature, a grumpy, stick-thin dwarf with a perpetual scowl contrasting Gravis's sunny disposition.

label: Dankmar
summary: A wilderness Rhine covenant occupied by Aschlaranda and her apprentice Schadrit; recognized as a Rhine covenant in 1067 and later accused Durenmar of faerie molestation.

label: Danu
summary: A faerie elemental spirit of the River Danube, formerly worshiped as a goddess by many peoples before the Romans; her presence remains strong at the river's source.

label: Danube
summary: A river embodied in ancient times as a faerie goddess whose nymphs guard treasure grottos and gateways to Arcadia.

label: Daria la Gris
summary: Co-leader of the Apple Gild and princeps of Triamore, a follower of House Tremere who favors forming the Lotharingian Tribunal; a stern 67-year-old Master.

label: Darius
summary: A magus of House Flambeau with a Warping Score of 6 who, while hunting a Renounced magus, botches a spell, enters Twilight, and gains a Twilight Scar making dead meat he touches seem rotten.

label: Dark Jerbiton
summary: A group associated with the covenant of Oculus Septentrionalis that may be dovetailed with the demonic schemes of Radegast and Gymir.

label: Dark Secret
summary: A Major Story Flaw: the character is haunted by something that would bring shame, rejection, or revenge if discovered, with hints continually arising.

label: Daughters of Erictho
summary: Non-Hermetic Thessalian wizards who did not join the Order, dwelling in the Cambunian Mountains; suspected of diabolism and demon worship.

label: Daughters of Four Fathers
summary: An all-female magical tradition found in north Africa, particularly associated with the Skinchanger (Dove) Virtue.

label: Dauphiné
summary: The domain of Lord Guigues, who commissioned a mechanized magpie automaton.

label: Dav'nalleous
summary: The foe against whom Pralix waged war; her final battle with him was at the site where Cad Gadu was founded.

label: David ben David
summary: A wealthy, devout Jewish merchant of Trier who manages a wine shop above the former covenant of Treverorum; suggested as a companion character.

label: David of Dinant
summary: A heretic Paris master whose pantheistic, infernal teachings were discovered in 1215; author of the Quaternuli describing the Infernal Virtue Incantation, who fled the city.

label: De Lapii
summary: The Branch of Terram in 1220, a Summa on Terram of Level 17 and Quality 14, written by Jeremias filius Guernicus.

label: De Magia Sympathetica
summary: A Tractatus on Magic Theory (Quality 11) by Elaine covering Arcane Connections and sympathetic connections.

label: De Ordinis Hermetici
summary: An encyclopedia by Quaertus of Bonisagus comprising five Quality 9 tractatus on the Code of Hermes and Order of Hermes Lore (history and geography).

label: De Potestate et Obligatione
summary: A Tractatus on Philosophiae (Quality 11) by Elaine discoursing on the responsible and ethical practice of magic, influenced by Saint Augustine's City of God.

label: (Dead Language)
summary: An Academic Ability for speaking a language no longer used natively, such as Latin, available only to educated characters.

label: Dead Language: Gothic
summary: An Academic dead-language Ability used in all the rituals of House Bjornaer and essential to members of Clan Ilfetu, with little use outside ritual contexts.

label: Deaf
summary: A Major General Flaw: the character cannot hear at all; magi with it roll two extra botch dice when casting spells with a spoken component.

label: Death Prophecy
summary: A Major General Virtue placing a supernatural condition on a character's death so that, until met, they cannot die of wounds or old age.

label: Decay Fur and Hide
summary: A Perdo Animal spell (Level 10) that destroys an object made of animal fur or hide, including wool and leather.

label: Decaying
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab's equipment, furnishings, and materials are neglected or gone bad (-1 General Quality, -1 Upkeep, -1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

label: Decimus
summary: A House Tytalus faction member who supports Harpax, the tenth Primus; Decimi wear revolutionary green as their badge.

label: Decrepitude
summary: A score that increases like an Ability as a character accumulates Aging Points; at 4 the character is frail and must roll on the Crisis Table, and at 5 is bedridden.

label: Dedicated Building
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab is in its own building shared with no one else, reducing distractions (+1 Upkeep, +1 Aesthetics, +1 Rego).

label: Defective Heating
summary: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab has inadequate or missing heating and is too cold in winter (-1 General Quality, -1 Upkeep, -1 Health, -1 Aesthetics).

label: Defective Lighting
summary: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is poorly lit, dingy and gloomy (-1 General Quality, -1 Upkeep, -1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

label: Defenses
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab has a sturdy defense such as a portcullis or battlements (+1 Aesthetics).

label: Deficiency
summary: A Hermetic Flaw imposed when a master opens an apprentice's Arts while having a score below five in an Art; inflicting it is normally a Low Crime.

label: Deficient Arts
summary: A Hermetic Flaw afflicting Sebastian, who learned Hermetic magic despite several Deficient Arts, leading him to fight using his one strong Form, Aquam.

label: Deficient Technique
summary: A Hermetic Flaw weakening a magus in a particular Form; Philippus Niger is deficient in Imaginem and Imanitos Mendax in Animal and Ignem.

label: Deformed
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: part of the structure has subsided or warped, e.g. a partially collapsed wall (-1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

label: Deft Art
summary: A Virtue, here Deft Art (Herbam), possessed by Ioannes Acer.

label: Deft Form
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue removing Casting Total penalties for non-standard voice/gestures with one Form.

label: Degenerative
summary: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the equipment and ingredients decay unnaturally quickly (+2 Upkeep, -1 Safety, +1 Warping, -2 Health, -1 Aesthetics, +2 Perdo).

label: Deheubarth
summary: An ancient Welsh principality in the south, centered on the fort of Dinefwr; once nearly unified under Lord Rhys.

label: Deleterious Circumstances
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw that halves all of the magus's magic totals (excluding Magic Resistance) under certain uncommon circumstances of state, target, or place.

label: Deluge of Rushing and Dashing
summary: A Creo Aquam spell that causes a stream to flood into a raging torrent, sweeping along and damaging anyone caught nearby.

label: Delusion
summary: A Flaw representing false belief; Criamon magi do not have it because their cosmological errors cannot be demonstrated within the game setting.

label: Demeter
summary: A powerful nature-oriented Greek deity whose name eumolpids of the Huntress may learn through the Mysteries of Names of Power and Invocation Magic.

label: Demetrius
summary: An alchemist Criamon magus, teacher of the current Prima Muscaria, whose carnal urges are embodied in the captured adulteration called the Carnal Wolf.

label: Demon
summary: Infernal beings made of the essence of deception; summoning and dealing with them is forbidden in the Order, they cannot be reliably detected, and they can be fought with Vim magic.

label: Demon of Scrofula
summary: A demon with Infernal Might that uses the Diseased Possession power to inflict the disease scrofula on a possessed victim.

label: Demon's Visage
summary: A Major Curse (Muto Corpus Animal effect) transforming the victim's head into a demon-like beast shape, penalizing communication, social rolls, and spell casting by -6.

label: Demonic Blood
summary: A Major Supernatural Tainted Virtue making a character a half-demon with Infernal Might, Infernal Powers, no need to eat, immunity to Warping, and a drastically shortened lifespan.

label: Demonic Familiar
summary: A Minor Story Flaw binding the character to a famulus, a familiar demon possessing an animal, which is not loyal and pursues its own goals.

label: Demonic Might
summary: A Minor Supernatural Virtue (requires Demonic Blood) increasing a character's Infernal Might by 2 points.

label: Demonic Powers
summary: A Minor Supernatural Virtue (requires Demonic Blood) granting an extra 20 levels of Infernal Powers.

label: Demonic Steed
summary: A corrupt beast (Might 7, Animal) appearing as a fearsome black stallion with iron hooves, unimpeded by poor terrain; one of three created by an Infernalist magus using a tainted Steed of Vengeance spell.

label: Demon's Eternal Oblivion
summary: A Perdo Vim spell that damages or destroys demons and other infernal beings.

label: Dependant
summary: A minor Flaw representing someone who depends on the character; can be used as a hostage or leverage to dominate an agent.

label: Depiction of the Waking Dream
summary: An InCrMeIm 35 enchanted effect in the Mirror of Dreams that makes a subject's thoughts visible as images around his head, aiding Mentem lab work.

label: Depraved
summary: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw where the character seeks to undermine religion and avoid the Dominion whenever possible.

label: Depressed
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw giving the character a dark outlook on life, seeing little point in acting and taking no pleasure in events.

label: Desiderius of Verditius
summary: An old Verditius magus of Voluntas who is a necromancer, smelling of rotting flesh, lately becoming sociable despite poor social skills.

label: Despair of the Quivering Manacles
summary: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 15) that makes the target shake vigorously side to side, penalizing physical movement and other rolls.

label: Deteriorating Power
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw that reduces the effectiveness of one of the character's powers over time, linked to age, Might, or Warping Score.

label: Determine the Location of the Absent Volume
aliases: Determine the Location of the Absent Volume
summary: An Intellego Animal 25 spell (based on The Inexorable Search) that locates a missing book by showing the magus's sigil on a map, with an optional Creo requisite to project the location on a mirror.

label: Deventer
summary: A modest-sized city and early missionary-bishopric on the right bank of the Rhine, surrounded by marshland, with a church named after St. Lebuinus and at the center of a struggle against pirates.

label: Devil Child
summary: A type of Mythic Companion created by powerful demons as weapons in the conflict between Heaven and Hell; tragic figures with Hellish powers but free will.

label: Devoted Parent/Child
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is extremely attached to a parent or child, suffering anxiety and penalties when separated.

label: Dhimmi
summary: A Minor General Flaw marking a non-Muslim living under Muslim rule, who must pay the jizya head tax and abide by social restrictions in return for tolerance and protection.

label: Diabetes
summary: A Minor Sanguine, Lifelong Disease from rich food and gluttony, named by Aretaeus after the Greek word for a siphon.

label: Diabolic Past
summary: A Major Story Flaw in which the character was once associated with diabolists and is still haunted and watched by former associates.

label: Diamond Mines of Solomon
summary: A legendary treasure-site the Expedition covenant was founded to discover, following a map used by two prior expeditions that never returned.

label: Diana
summary: The mater of Theoderic; the last magus to attempt to reach the Lunar Sphere, she was blasted into fragments of glass in a laboratory accident, and a Fallen Temple at the covenant is dedicated to her.

label: Diana of Tremere
summary: A Tremere maga of Blackthorn who declared a Wizards' War in 873 against William of Jerbiton of Rosalba.

label: Dictionarius
summary: A famous 13th-century craft manual by John de Garlande about various trades that adds +4 to a craftsman's Workshop Total.

label: Didyma
summary: A covenant in the Theban Tribunal linked to the city of Miletos by the Sacred Way, a mundane road that is also a major route from the faerie realm to the mundane world.

label: Diedne Magic
summary: A Major Hermetic Virtue from the druidic House Diedne lineage granting superior Spontaneous magic, requiring the lineage to be hidden via a Major Story Flaw.

label: Dietrich III
summary: The duke of Upper Lorraine who dies in 1220 and is succeeded by Matthew II.

label: Dietrich of Bern
summary: A Daimon (Magic Might 35, Corpus) of the German hero and boy-king of Bern, whose tomb in the Lessini Mountains holds dragon-blood-enchanted arms; he animates his corpse to test those who enter.

label: Difficult Longevity Ritual
summary: A Major Hermetic Flaw making it difficult to create an effective Longevity Ritual for the character, halving the Lab Total of anyone who tries.

label: Difficult Spontaneous Magic
summary: A Hermetic Flaw referenced as combinable with Weak Spontaneous Magic to create a magus who cannot cast spontaneous magic at all.

label: Difficult Underlings
summary: A Story Flaw representing a fractured relationship with one's agents; acquired when a non-magus principal recruits an agent of higher social standing, applying to dealings with that agent.

label: Dimicatio
summary: A dangerous Flambeau tournament event where competitors cast real spells using forceless casting and fast-cast defenses, the first to reach the opponent's Parma winning.

label: Diminutive
summary: A Minor laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab is configured for an especially small magus, causing difficulty for normal-sized users.

label: Dionysus
summary: A god originally worshipped alongside Hermes by Orpheus's society but who fell out of favor after Orpheus's death; the Maenads who killed Orpheus were devoted to him.

label: Dirne-Weibl
summary: A wood-wife who dresses in a red frock and carries a basket of apples that turn to gold if she is treated courteously; her apples are Creo vis sought by magi.

label: Dirty
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is not kept to basic cleanliness, leaving the owner smelly (-1 Health, -2 Aesthetics, +1 Perdo).

label: Disceptator
summary: The chairman and spokesman of a covenant's Council of Members, a rotating mandatory office held by full members serving seven-year terms.

label: Discern Own Illusions
summary: An Intellego Imaginem spell that makes the caster's own illusions appear largely transparent but still discernible.

label: Discern the Images of Truth and Falsehood
aliases: Discern the Images of Truth and Falsehood
summary: An Intellego Imaginem (General) spell that lets the caster tell whether an image was created or altered by a spell, seeing both original and false images.

label: Diseased Possession
summary: An infernal power, a variety of Possession, by which a demon enters a victim and spends Might to inflict a disease's contagion.

label: Disenchant
summary: A Perdo Vim ritual that permanently strips a Hermetic magic item of all its powers, destroying its enchantment and invested vis.

label: Disfigured
summary: A Flaw earned by a single visible tattoo, considered uglier than a scar by medieval people; commonly afflicting tattooed Criamon magi.

label: Disguise of the New Visage
summary: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 15) that transforms the target's facial features to any approximately human configuration the caster chooses.

label: Disguise of the Putrid Aroma
summary: A Rego Animal spell (Level 5) that makes a targeted animal take no interest in the caster as long as concentration is maintained.

label: Disguise of the Transformed Image
summary: A spell useful for creating a persona with specific physical characteristics such as a particular sex, hair color, or stature.

label: Disguise of the Transformed Wizard
summary: A Muto Imaginem 15 spell known by Imanitos Mendax.

label: Disguised
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab or its entrance is concealed mundanely, such as by a hidden door (-1 Aesthetics).

label: Disjointed Magic
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw preventing the magus from using prior knowledge of similar spells or enchantment bonuses to aid his magic.

label: Disorganized
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is organized haphazardly, though some magi prefer it (-1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics, +1 Muto or Experimentation).

label: Disorientating Magic
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw requiring the magus to spend a round recovering his mental faculties after casting a spell.

label: Dispassionate
summary: A new Minor Personality Flaw making one unable to express strong emotions; the first Sacrifice on the Arcadian Path.

label: Dispel the Phantom Image
summary: A Perdo Imaginem (General) spell that destroys the image from any one Creo Imaginem spell whose level the caster matches or exceeds on a stress die plus spell level.

label: Disputatio
summary: A formal academic debate resolved much like certamen, using paired totals (Attack, Defense, Weakening, Resistance) and symbolic Fatigue Levels to determine a winner across deliberative, epideictic, and forensic forms.

label: Dissolving the Wall of Shields
summary: A PeMe 20 spell that removes the procedural memories letting a group of soldiers fight as a unit, or destroys other simple group skills.

label: Distillation of the Purest Stream
summary: A Rego Vim 15 spell (R: Touch, D: Mom, T: Ind) that concentrates the essence of exceptionally pure stream water into a pawn of Aquam vis.

label: Distraction of the Magpie
summary: A Muto Mentem spell that alters the target's estimation so shiny objects become highly desirable and distracting.

label: Divination and Augury
summary: The Major non-Hermetic Virtue of the Hermetic Haruspexes tradition.

label: Divination & Augury
summary: A supernatural Virtue allowing the performance of auguries; Chnoubis' Augury power functions as this Virtue, granting ten levels of success per Might point.

label: Doctor
summary: The title held only by graduates of a university faculty of medicine (or those with Clerk and Medicine 3+), the only physicians with formal claim to it.

label: Doge
summary: The leader of the city of Venice, who annually casts a vis-bearing engagement ring into the sea to symbolize the city's espousal to and dominance over the waters.

label: Dogrose School
summary: A regio covenant claimed by House Bonisagus that draws Gifted children via their possessed toys and teaches them before sending them to masters.

label: Doissetep
summary: A powerful covenant in the Provençal Tribunal where the dark Jerbiton magus Imanitos Mendax was apprenticed.

label: Domestic Animal
summary: A Free Social Status Virtue (animals only) for an animal that is the property of a covenant or character.

label: Dominican
summary: One of the two major new mendicant friar orders of the early thirteenth century, growing rapidly in popularity.

label: Dominicans
summary: An orthodox religious Order whose friars at Paris live in private hospices, strictly adhere to papal authority, and criticize teachers of possibly heretical ideas.

label: Dominicus
summary: A magus of House Jerbiton exonerated by the Normandy Tribunal of 898 for using Wizard's War to avenge a slain amicus, establishing legal precedent for avenger pledges.

label: Dominion Lore
summary: A supernatural Ability covering knowledge of the Divine realm; the angels Seferiel (Divine Lore 10) and Nasir (Dominion Lore 8) both have it with a specialty in angels.

label: Domus Magna
summary: The principal covenant of a Hermetic House, many of which have excellent libraries focused on their House's interests; examples include Durenmar and the Cave of Twisting Shadows.

label: Donning the Mask of Another
summary: A Tytalan MuMe 35 Ritual spell that creates a persona from the identity of a donor, granting the caster the donor's memories and personality as a deep cover disguise; it can also steal or transfer a persona.

label: Doolin
summary: A guild master clothier living in Paris, a man of inexhaustible energy who makes excellent quality clothing and dreams of monopolizing the formal attire of wizards.

label: Dorana
summary: A master maga of House Bonisagus at Fengheld, foremost of the lineage of Irmele filia Trianoma in the Tribunal, who argues for rationality but cannot stand her prima Murion.

label: Doublet of Impenetrable Silk
summary: A Muto Animal spell (Level 15) that changes an item of silk, wool, or leather so it cannot be cut or penetrated by weapons, granting a Soak bonus.

label: Doubt
summary: A Major Curse (Rego Mentem effect) filling the victim with doubt, requiring Intelligence rolls before undertaking any activity.

label: Dover Castle
summary: Castle whose octagonal three-story archery Bell Tower (built 1189) exemplifies the archery-tower extreme of mural-tower design.

label: Down Tor
summary: A group of stones on Dartmoor with a circle around a barrow and a long line of stones said to bind and channel a powerful ghost that can be summoned along the line by those who know the rituals.

label: Dowsing
summary: A Supernatural Ability to find things nearby using a dowsing rod and an intuitive sense, requiring a sympathetic connection to the thing sought.

label: Drachenfels
summary: Dragon's Rock, a famous legendary site (Magic aura 3) with catacombs where the hero Siegfried slew the dragon Fafnir; crowned by Schloss Drachenfels owned by the archbishop of Cologne.

label: Dragon
summary: A dragon that killed the last Verditius magus (Parsirus) of Ungulus and against which Sinead burns for revenge; a magical force now pushes her away from it.

label: Dragon Hill
summary: A small hill near the White Horse of Uffington with a flat top on which nothing will grow.

label: Dragon of the Sauerland
summary: A dragon that must be conquered and its heart eaten as the second Quest of the Path of Energy.

label: Drawing Up the Siege Ladder
summary: A Rego Herbam 15 spell originally for hauling siege ladders over castle walls, used by librarians to rearrange wooden furniture and move groups of wooden objects.

label: Dreadful Bane of the Fae
summary: A general Perdo Vim spell invented by Philippus Niger, like Demon's Eternal Oblivion but working on creatures with Faerie Might.

label: Dream Magic
summary: A Virtue gained through Clan Maruhs's Deed of Emulation and spread within the clan by the Sept of Gyöngy.

label: Dream of the Mind That Sits
aliases: Dream of the Mind That Sits
