summary: An Intellego Terram spell (with Creo requisite) that lets the caster probe and perfect the memories of a spirit within a natural stone object.

label: Dripstone
summary: A brownish wax-feeling enchanted stone (chalcedonius) harvested from Pfalz Island; worn around the neck it lets the wearer perceive illusions, discern truth, and resist the Loreley's song, and is worth 1 pawn of Imaginem vis.

label: Driven
summary: A Personality Flaw compelling a character to pursue a particular goal relentlessly; Darius is Driven to hunt enemies of the Order.

label: Drogo Invigilor
summary: A Tremere magus of Fengheld closely associated with the Welfs, investigated by House Guernicus over suspicions he arranged accidents for the emperor's heirs.

label: Druids' Circle
summary: A stone circle on a moor overlooking the Irish Sea whose entrance stones are sensitive to oaths and move nearer to swearers; dark tales say druids practiced human sacrifice there.

label: Dunoding
summary: A region of Wales near an island where the swynwyr established Pralix's military headquarters, later renamed Cad Gadu.

label: Durendal
summary: Roland's magic sword, forged by Wayland Smith with Verditius as apprentice, later stolen by Roscius and studied by the Confraternity of Roland; used in their Initiations.

label: Durenmar
summary: A leading Rhine covenant in the Black Forest that sponsors new covenants; it offered resources to bring Roznov into the Rhine, its leadership decides to recolonize the Rhine Gorge, and its Forum hosts initiations into the Order.

label: Durenmar Lore
summary: An Ability reflecting a magus' familiarity with the contents of the Great Library, addable to study rolls there with a cumulative penalty.

label: Durham
summary: The site of the cathedral of St. Cuthbert on a high hill in a loop of the river Wear; a palatinate center of pilgrimage and resistance to the Normans.

label: Dust Devil
summary: A Minor Supernatural Skinchanger variant letting a character become a Size +1 dust devil whirlwind, focused through a glass amulet of Magic-aura sand.

label: Dust to Dust
summary: A Perdo Corpus spell (Level 15) that turns a dead body or mindless undead to dust in two rounds; does not affect undead possessed by spirits.

label: Dutiful Movement
summary: A common automaton power (base effect 20) letting the automaton walk and follow its creator around.

label: Dutybound
summary: A Flaw binding a character to a sense of duty; those with this Flaw who partake of Honos' Centurions' Feast are instantly cured of Light and Medium Wounds.

label: Dwarf
summary: A Major General Flaw making the character the size of a child, with Size -2 and penalties to Strength and Stamina.

label: Dyscrasia
summary: The imbalanced state of humors producing a patient's symptoms, which a physician must understand to bring the humors back into balance.

label: Eadric Wilde
summary: A lord who captured and married a faerie woman, becoming famous and being summoned to London by King William Rufus; he lost her when he reproached her about her sisters.

label: Eagle Clan
summary: A Crintera clan of the nimblest, keen-eyed grogs who are expert archers, acting as spies, hunters, and an informant network across Europe.

label: Ealwynn
summary: A member of the Sept of Orn (Clan Wilkis) trained by Hosvir Goatlegs.

label: Earth Elemental
summary: An ancient elemental summoned by a now-fallen covenant to tend a cavern rock garden; mourning his lost water-elemental love, he yearly carries an engraved rock outside that yields Aquam and Terram vis.

label: Earth Shock
summary: A Terram spell that mimics an earthquake, cited as an example where the material cause (earth) determines the Hermetic Form.

label: Earth That Breaks No More
summary: A Muto Terram spell that turns a volume of packed dirt up to ten cubic paces into stone.

label: Eastern Christendom
summary: A cultural society of Mythic Europe centered on the Byzantine empire and Constantinople, defining its own Social Statuses.

label: Eastern Roman Empire
summary: The cosmopolitan eastern realm ('Romania') whose Greek-cultured cities produced House Jerbiton's founding members and the League of Iconophiles.

label: Ebroin
summary: The relatively young current Primus of House Ex Miscellanea, elected after Immanola entered Final Twilight, with ambitions to revitalize the House from Cad Gadu.

label: Eden
summary: The biblical paradise from which man was expelled; noxious plants are said to have acquired harmful qualities after the expulsion.

label: Edgar
summary: The newest Redcap of the Stonehenge Tribunal, in his early twenties, good-looking with light brown hair and gray eyes, with no magical items yet.

label: Edge of the Razor
summary: A spell that sharpens a weapon to improve attacks; disfavored by the School of Ramius because Magic Resistance can stop the enchanted weapon. Its damage bonus can combine with Hardness of Adamantine.

label: Edifice Boon
summary: A covenant Boon that troupes may select instead of paying Build Points for a Great Work.

label: Educated
summary: A Minor General Virtue for education in a beit ha-midrash or yeshivah, granting Academic Abilities and 50 experience points in Hebrew, Aramaic, and Judaic studies.

label: Educated (Bardic)
summary: A Minor General Virtue for attending a Hibernian bardic school, granting 50 experience points in storytelling and lore Abilities.

label: Educated (Islamic)
summary: A Minor General Virtue for education in a mosque or Qur'an school, granting Academic Abilities and 50 experience points in languages and Islamic studies.

label: Educated (Vernacular)
summary: A Minor, General Virtue representing secular instruction given by tutors to scions of merchant houses, granting Academic Abilities and 50 extra experience points for practical business skills.

label: Edward of Milton
aliases: Edward of Milton, follower of Jerbiton
summary: A Jerbiton archmagus and nominated head of the covenant Schola Pythagoranis in Cambridge, friend and former teacher of the scholar Robert Grosseteste.

label: Edward the White of Jerbiton
summary: A magus skilled in the magic of the sea, famed for unsuccessful attempts to find Atlantis, who leads The Single Ocean league from his enchanted ship.

label: Efnisien
summary: A Welsh hero claimed by some as the first of the Nemthengacha, the bitter-tongued Ex Miscellanea tradition.

label: Eginolf
summary: A magus of House Flambeau of Rudiaria covenant against whom charges of diabolism were brought (unproven) in 962 AD.

label: Egypt
summary: A region of Mythic Europe near the Pyramids and the great Sphinx where magi established a desert laboratory.

label: Einherjar
summary: Spiritual warriors awaiting Ragnarok, into whom Valkyries transform the worthy dead chosen from battle.

label: Elaine
summary: Flambeau's second apprentice, a Frankish girl who became a Hoplite, Archmage, and scholar; she trained four apprentices and authored several enduring books.

label: Elbe
summary: A river haunted by a Wild Hunt led by Frau Wode and by shadowy boatmen carrying invisible passengers.

label: Elbruz Mountains
summary: The mountains where Baghl the earth jinni haunts a dark cave formerly used as a quarry.

label: Elder Gild
summary: A gild that split from the Hawthorn Gild to pursue a fae-focused agenda, concentrating on preserving faeries and friendly contact with them; led by Iacob of Irencillia and made up mostly of Merinita magi.

label: Eleanor of Aquitaine
summary: Overlord of Aquitaine who attended the Second Crusade with a guard of female knights dressed as Amazons; her scandalous behavior led to a Papal Bull barring women from the Third Crusade. An example of inheritance-based female power.

label: Eleanor Sworder
summary: The woman who has led Nigrasaxa's turb for five years and aspires to be a knight; bears an ugly scar on her left cheek.

label: Elemental
summary: Magical creatures composed of pure elemental matter (earth, water, air, or fire) formed through rarefication under a magical impetus; not truly alive, they do not age, eat, or reproduce and recover Might only slowly in a Magic aura.

label: Elemental kings
summary: Powerful spirits of the Magic realm whose favor Archmage Vinaria of Merinita must win for her archmage challenge.

label: Elemental Magic
summary: A Major, Hermetic Virtue letting a magus manipulate the elemental Forms (Aquam, Auram, Ignem, Terram) as a connected whole, sharing experience among them.

label: Elemental spirit
summary: A spirit that broke free of an ancient binding and caused rockslides in the Black Mountains in revenge on humanity; Goliard restored its binding and took control of it.

label: Elementalist
summary: A Virtue common among Hermetic Sahirs reflecting their facility with the elemental Forms.

label: Elementary
summary: A Major laboratory Outfittings Flaw: a cut-down lab with extremely limited equipment allowing only one category of lab activity, cheap to maintain (-2 General Quality, -3 Upkeep).

label: Elevated
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab is at least four floors up or atop a tower, commanding a view (+1 Aesthetics, +1 Auram).

label: Elsa
summary: The young widowed duchess of Brabant rescued by the Knight of the Swan Lohengrin, whom she wedded and lost when she broke her vow not to ask his name.

label: Ely
summary: An abbey and bishopric, site of the tomb of St. Etheldreda and a pilgrimage destination; setting of Bricstan's miraculous deliverance.

label: Elysium
summary: A place where magi have encountered Valkyries, who are no longer worshiped in Mythic Europe.

label: Embitterment
summary: A Major Non-Hermetic Supernatural Ability of the Nemthengacha allowing a speaker, through conversation, to make a listener hostile to a chosen target, up to the level of murder.

label: Embrace of Boethius
summary: A Perdo Mentem 35 ritual spell that damages a magus's mind, heart, and Gift, forcing reliance on casting tools, used to initiate other Hermetic magi into House Verditius.

label: Emir
summary: A Minor, Social Status Virtue equivalent to Knight but for Muslim emirs, who are skilled in hunting, religious teachings, and culture as well as martial pursuits.

label: Emotion Theft
summary: A Supernatural Ability granted by the Thief of Emotions Virtue, allowing one to steal an emotion from a person and transfer it to another by touch.

label: Empedocles
summary: An ancient philosopher whose teaching underlies Criamon thought; the Gorgiastics are named for a student who turned against him, and one Sufi school reveres him as a hierophant.

label: Empiricus
summary: A character specializing in one surgical or medical procedure, often itinerant; a derogatory term used by the literate medical profession for the unlearned.

label: Employed by Company
summary: A minor Story Flaw for salaried employees answerable to an employer but backed by the company's resources; suits characters working primarily for a salary.

label: Empty
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab has a large amount of unused space, costlier to maintain; taken per two points by which Size exceeds occupied Size.

label: Emrys
summary: A Welsh seer who made a pact with faeries to trade his life for his son Ambrosius's, serving as magical advisor to a faerie court; his spirit could be seen watching over the boy.

label: Enchant Casting Tools
aliases: Enchant Casting Tools — Minor House Mystery
summary: A Minor House Inner Mystery of Verditius allowing a magus to enchant his casting tools to mirror mastered spell effects and grant casting bonuses.

label: Enchanted birthing chair
summary: An enchanted chair at Voluntas's village that ensures almost all mothers and children survive childbirth, giving Wilton unusually high life expectancy.

label: Enchanting (Ability)
summary: A Minor Supernatural Ability Virtue applying to a particular artistic expression (dance, drawing, storytelling, craftwork) that in Faerie auras can control events through art.

label: Enchanting Music
summary: A performance Ability; a Music score of six or higher is required for Imaginem vis to accumulate in Reginald's Rebec, and the rebec grants a +3 bonus to Music rolls.

label: Enchantment
summary: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab itself has been enchanted as a magic item, granting Virtues, Flaws, or Specialization changes.

label: Enchantment of Detachment
summary: A spell that calms and greatly lowers the intensity of the target's current emotions.

label: Enchantment of the Pedestrian Pigeon
summary: A MuMe 15 spell that occludes a person's memory of told information until a key phrase unlocks it, used for secure transfer of information between conspirators.

label: Enchantment of the Scrying Pool
summary: An Intellego Aquam Ritual spell (Level 30) with an Imaginem requisite that turns a body of water into a scrying pool; an old Mercurian ritual known throughout the Order.

label: Encumbrance
summary: A penalty derived from the Load of carried equipment, calculated through Burden and offset by Strength, that subtracts from athletic and spellcasting rolls.

label: End of the Mighty Castle
summary: A Perdo Terram (PeTe 25) spell that collapses a building; since non-magical stone falls due to gravity, Magic Resistance does not protect against it.

label: Endurance of the Berserkers
summary: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 15) that makes the caster's body act as though unwounded and unfatigued while concentrating, with deferred Fatigue loss.

label: Enduring Constitution
summary: A Minor, General Virtue allowing a character to withstand pain and fatigue, reducing Fatigue and wound penalties and granting +3 to resist pain.

label: Enduring Magic
summary: A Minor, Hermetic Virtue causing the magus's spells to last longer than usual, with the storyguide secretly multiplying durations by a die roll.

label: Enfeebled
summary: A Major General Flaw preventing the character from exerting himself for more than a few seconds, rendering him helpless in combat or chases.

label: Engelbert I
summary: The current archbishop of Cologne, a tall, fair, and just man holding the status of Archchancellor of Italy, martyred in 1225 if the saga follows real history.

label: England
summary: A kingdom of Mythic Europe where women have fewer rights than in most other parts (partly an effect of the Norman Conquest) and large areas are set aside as noble hunting ranges; its king has sworn fealty to the king of France for mainland possessions.

label: Enigmatic Wisdom
summary: A House Criamon Ability that grants far-reaching perception of strange phenomena, aids comprehension of Wizard's Twilight (while making it more likely), and can substitute for Chirurgy and Medicine on the Path of the Body.

label: Enslave the Mortal Mind
summary: A spell that lets the caster completely control the loyalty, emotions, desires, and activities of any person.

label: Enticer of Multitudes
summary: A Minor, General, Tainted Virtue giving a corrupt version of Inspirational usable only to manipulate people toward evil acts.

label: Entisimon
summary: A Primus of House Flambeau who rallied the House during the Schism War but was disgraced and forced to resign during the Normandy Crisis.

label: Entrancement
summary: A Supernatural Ability (always Range Eye, Duration Special, Target Individual) using Rego Mentem guidelines to control a human's emotions and thoughts; the defining magic of the Malocchi.

label: Enumerus
summary: A renowned Jerbiton magus who wrote a treatise on covenant economics held in the Great Library of Durenmar; he gave his name to the Pound of Enumerus, the unaccountable yearly petty expenditure.

label: Envied Beauty
summary: A Major Story Flaw whose character's beauty draws revulsion and jealousy, especially from vain persons of the character's gender.

label: Envious
summary: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character believes others undeservedly have it better and tries to ruin their lives.

label: Environmental Magic Condition
summary: A Major Hermetic Flaw halving all of the character's Casting and Lab Totals in certain common environmental conditions.

label: Environmental Sensitivity
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is unusually sensitive to an uncommon environmental feature, suffering a Stamina penalty when exposed.

label: Ephesus
summary: A site in the Theban Tribunal holding a statue of Diana that Huntress initiates may anoint with sacred oil during the Eumolpid initiation.

label: Epimetheus
summary: Hariste's devoted pupil who contracted leprosy while consoling her after Tytalus's disappearance, thereby founding the leper magi lineage.

label: Erfurt
summary: The oldest and largest settlement in Thuringia, an episcopal city under the archbishopric of Mainz, deriving wealth from the export of woad.

label: Eric
summary: A reckless magus of House Tytalus and co-founder of Waddenzee, a Danish generalist who favors Aquam and Auram and embraces the pirate lifestyle.

label: Erik von Ribe
summary: A magus of House Tytalus, filius of Tasgillia, quoted remarking that a magus lacking a disgraced ancestor shows a distinct lack of enterprise.

label: Eristic Moot
summary: A public dispute between competing speakers used by House Tytalus to settle differences, announced by Redcap; includes special forms such as the Apprentice's Gauntlet and the contest for Primus.

label: Erysipelas
summary: A Minor Choleric Disease of morbid choler from excessive heat and dryness, causing a maddening rash on the extremities.

label: Erythravis
summary: An Archmage of House Guernicus who executed Tasgillia for diabolism in 961 AD.

label: Eschenfrau
summary: A very evil wood-spirit who must be appeased with a sacrifice on Ash Wednesday by those unfortunate enough to live near one.

label: Espera of Merinita
summary: A Merinita maga of Ungulus who offended a faerie lord and devotes herself to survival, never leaving the Aegis and wearing enchanted iron items against faeries.

label: Essential Nature
summary: A character's intrinsic, magically defining nature, which can make certain Flaws impossible to remove even with Hermetic magic.

label: Essential Traits
summary: Traits possessed by some creatures of the Magic Realm that are part of their essential nature, marked with an asterisk; magic cannot make such creatures act against them.

label: Estrid Danesson
summary: A magus Ex Miscellanea (age 36) of Oculus Septentrionalis, a Danish former hedge wizard specializing in sailing and weather magics who gathers vis around the Baltic; cousin and enemy of Eric Ribecus.

label: Eternal Repetition in a Bottomless Pool
aliases: Eternal Repetition in a Bottomless Pool
summary: A Creo Imaginem 35 spell that uses enchanted mirrors to display the text of a book the magus has an arcane connection to, navigable by vocal command.

label: Ethelwald
summary: The seneschal and autocrat of Voluntas who plays lord of the manor to the outside world and avoids becoming a knight to escape military service.

label: Ethiopia
summary: The location of a cave complex that is the perfect site for the Microcosm ritual on the Path of the Body, discovered in North Africa.

label: Etiquette
summary: The Ability central to Jerbiton 'tasteful living,' used to convey symbolic messages, make individual impressions at events, and force rivals into faux pas.

label: Etzel
summary: The king of the Huns in the Nibelungenlied, who marries Kriemhild; historically Attila, the dreaded chieftain checked at the Battle of Chalons.

label: Eucrasia
summary: The state of perfect balance of the humors that prolongs life and negates bodily suffering, the goal of a medical regimen, represented as a Living Conditions Modifier.

label: Eudokia
summary: One of the three regions of the Faerie Realm; the land of tales that teach a lesson.

label: Eule
summary: An aged master of House Bjornaer at Fengheld with the heartbeast of an owl and the honorary rank of Quaesitor; she may have entered Final Twilight and her wisdom is faked by Gunther.

label: Eule's Wisdom Item
summary: A low-level but very high-Penetration Perdo Mentem magic item hidden in the floor of Eule's receiving room that calms minds and removes emotion, used by Gunther to fake her wisdom.

label: Eunuch
summary: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for a sexually incapable male educated to serve Byzantine nobility as courtier, steward, scribe, or accountant.

label: Eurydice
summary: Orpheus's beloved wife who died of a viper's bite and whom he tried to recover from the Underworld.

label: Eurynome
summary: A sea nymph who, with Thetis, rescued and raised Hephaestus after Zeus cast him into the sea.

label: Eustace, Abbot of Flay
summary: An abbot sent by the Pope in 1200 to lead a mission against Sunday trading in England, whose preaching and miracles caused many Sunday markets to close or move.

label: Eustace de Faukenberg
summary: The treasurer of England, who heads the Exchequer.

label: Eustace the Monk
summary: The leader of the French reinforcement fleet of eighty ships; defeated by Hubert de Burgh's fleet and beheaded against the rail of his own ship.

label: Eve
summary: The first woman of biblical lore referenced in the Divine setting material.

label: Everstorf Forest
summary: A forest north of Schwerin in which the Giant's Grave lies.

label: Evil Destiny
summary: A Major Story Flaw in which the Infernal realm has taken an unexplained interest in the character, who must guard against dark forces.

label: Evil Eye
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character bears the uncontrolled potential to harm those around her, adding a botch die to stress rolls made in her presence.

label: Evisceration of a Thousand Knives
summary: A Perdo Corpus 30 spell invented by Philippus Niger that inflicts an Incapacitating wound on one target.

label: Evisceration of Ten Thousand Knives
summary: A Perdo Corpus 35 enchanted-item effect in Philippus Niger's talisman, a Group-targeted version of his Evisceration of a Thousand Knives.

label: Excessive Heating
summary: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is kept far warmer than necessary with extensive facilities (+2 Upkeep, -1 Safety, +2 Ignem).

label: Excessive Lighting
summary: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is lit far more than necessary with hundreds of candles or lamps (+2 Upkeep, +2 Imaginem).

label: Exchange of the Two Minds
summary: A ritual spell that switches the minds (but not the souls) of two creatures.

label: Exchequer
summary: A branch of the royal court headed by the treasurer Eustace de Faukenberg, responsible for checking and receipting all moneys owed to the crown; staffed by Barons of the Exchequer.

label: Exciting Experimentation
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw causing the character's experiments to have dramatic flair, rolling two dice on experimentation tables with the storyguide choosing the more amusing result.

label: Excommunicate
summary: A Major Story Flaw in which the character has been cast out of the Church for crimes against God, gaining a bad reputation and losing access to the sacraments.

label: Exeter
summary: The seat of a bishop and the most important town of southwest England, a sea-port on the river Exe with a Norman cathedral dedicated to St. Peter and a wine trade with Gascony.

label: Exiled Atlantean
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw marking the character as an Atlantean tainted by contact with the surface world and unable to return to her native magic regio.

label: Exotic Casting
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue allowing a magus to cast Hermetic spells using non-Hermetic methods, making it hard for others to recognize the spell being cast.

label: Experimental Philosophy
summary: A system of 'natural' magic that produces wondrous effects through the intrinsic power of the subject rather than any arcane force, using contagion, affinity, similarity, hidden virtues, astrology, ligatures and formulae.

label: Experimentation
summary: Risky laboratory practice of pushing beyond known limits, adding a simple die to the Lab Total but requiring a roll on the Extraordinary Results Chart each season.

label: Exposed
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the building is partially exposed to the elements, e.g. unroofed or wind-cracked (-1 Safety, +1 Upkeep, -2 Health, -1 Aesthetics, +1 Auram).

label: Extensive Stores
summary: A Minor laboratory Structure Virtue: large stores let the lab withstand shortages and store vis and dangerous materials more safely (+2 Safety).

label: Extractor of (Form) Vis
summary: A Minor, Hermetic Virtue allowing a magus to extract vis of a chosen Form from a Magic aura whose features exemplify that Form.

label: Eye of Hephaestus
summary: A Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a craftsman innately tell the quality of a manufactured item by touch, including whether it is flawed or magical. Called the Eye of St Dunstan for Christian characters.

label: Eye of the Eons
summary: An Intellego Terram spell (InTe 5) known by Tabanus.

label: Eyes of the Bat
summary: A Hermetic spell whose vision is mimicked by the Eyes of the Bat creature Quality, letting a beast see as magi do under that spell.

label: Eyes of the Cat
summary: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 5) with an Animal requisite that gives the target a cat's eyes, allowing sight in near darkness.

label: Eyes of the Eagle
summary: An Intellego Imaginem spell (Level 25) that lets the caster see distant things clearly, making out details as if they were a foot away while still judging distance accurately.

label: Eyes of the Eons
summary: An Intellego Terram spell that determines the age of any nonliving target to within 10% of its actual age.

label: Eyes of the Flame
summary: An Intellego Ignem spell (Level 35) that lets the caster see a fire to which they have an Arcane Connection, plus all things the fire illuminates.

label: Eyes of the Treacherous Terrain
summary: An Intellego Terram spell that lets the caster intuitively tell if any natural terrain they see is treacherous, such as a rock field prone to sliding.

label: Fabric Ripper
summary: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue granting the power to tear any manufactured object made from plant or animal fibers, as a PeAn(He) 25 effect.

label: Fabricor of Verditius
summary: A young Verditius magus, one of the newly arrived members of Libellus.

label: Facilitate the Stifled (Form) Spell
summary: A Muto Vim general spell cast alongside a formulaic spell to remove the casting penalty from reduced or absent gestures and voice; has ten versions, one per Hermetic Form.

label: Factor
summary: A minor Social Status Virtue for a character who manages the interests of a trading house in a single city; also used for independent traders with capital but lacking other-city connections.

label: Faerie Blood
summary: A Major Supernatural Virtue granting natural longevity, faerie eyes (Second Sight and sight in darkness), Faerie Lore, and the benefits of a particular type of fay heritage; cannot be combined with Faerie Blood.

label: Faerie Chains of the Familiar Slave
aliases: Faerie Chains of the Familiar Slave
summary: A CrVi ritual spell (R: Touch, D: Until) that binds a supernatural creature as a temporary familiar to the caster until an incorporated condition comes to pass.

label: Faerie Doctor
summary: A Mythic Companion type: a faerie-trained healer who removes blights, banes, and diseases via Curse-Throwing, dowses for water and lost things, and keeps a faerie companion. They swear oaths to remain apart from humanity.

label: Faerie Doctor (Virtue)
summary: The Free Mythic Companion Virtue defining a character as a faerie doctor, required of all faerie doctors.

label: Faerie Enmity
summary: A Flaw cursing the exsules's line, stemming from Quendalon's ancient curse, causing faeries to instinctively hate them.

label: Faerie Familiar
summary: A faerie bound as a magus's familiar; at Irencillia magi such as Glesig make their caricatures (e.g., the troll Humnel) into faerie familiars.

label: Faerie Friend
summary: A Flaw taken as an Ordeal in the sample Line of Quendalon Initiation, representing a befriended faerie appropriate to the Initiate's highest Technique and Form.

label: Faerie Hounds
summary: Huge faerie dogs (Might 5, Animal) that haunt the roads of Mythic Europe, terrifying and sometimes killing travelers, often with shining eyes and powers like Enthralling Sound and Fearful Flaming Eyes.

label: Faerie Ingredients
summary: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: some lab stores are supplied by faeries with beneficial if unpredictable properties, e.g. faerie silver.

label: Faerie Knight
summary: Faerie warriors (Might 10, Corpus or Terram) bound to the rules of chivalry, found on lonely roads and guarding bridges, who seek defeat by humans to gain additional combat Pretenses.

label: Faerie Lore
summary: An Ability representing knowledge of faeries; used to navigate faerie regiones in Initiations and combined with Magic Lore to inform Faerie Magic.

label: Faerie Magic
aliases: the Outer Mystery of Faerie Magic
summary: An Arcane Ability and the Outer Mystery learned by Merinitae representing how their magic differs from normal Hermetic magic, governing charms, faerie vis, and faerie-magic botches.

label: Faerie Queen of Irencillia
summary: A faerie queen used as an example target in the Symbolic Magic ritual, affected at Symbol Range via 'queen,' 'winter,' and 'faerie' charms.

label: Faerie-Raised Magic
summary: A Major Hermetic Virtue conditioning a character to invent spells very quickly, allowing self-teaching of spells outside the lab; common in the Line of Quendalon.

label: Faerie Sight
summary: The ability to read glamour, allowing the holder to see magical things and tell what other faeries want simply by looking at them.

label: Faerie Speech
summary: A faerie ability to converse in the language of one's audience, speaking any language someone has used to speak to them without needing to Penetrate.

label: Faerie Spider
summary: A poisonous faerie spider befriended by Lutisse that protects her treehouse lab, though its cobwebs infest the dwelling.

label: Faerie Tarantula
summary: A faerie creature whose bite afflicts victims with tarantism, an excess of yellow bile causing an irresistible urge to dance.

label: Faerie Upbringing
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character was raised by faeries, gaining enhanced understanding of magic and faeries but finding human society bizarre.

label: Fafnir
summary: The great dragon slain by the hero Siegfried at Drachenfels, in whose blood Siegfried bathed to become invulnerable; his brood or his brother Regin's may still endure.

label: Failed Apprentice
summary: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for someone once apprenticed to a mage who never completed studies, familiar with magi's lives and possibly retaining Supernatural Abilities.

label: Failed Journeyman
summary: A Minor Social Status Flaw for a character expelled from his guild for illegal practices, unable to practice his trade legally, with a bad Reputation of 2 in town.

label: Failed Master
summary: A Minor Social Status Flaw for a character who ran his workshop into the ground and must work as a journeyman, with a bad Reputation of 4 in town.

label: Failed Monk
summary: A Minor Social Status Flaw in which the character was cast out of a cloistered order, gaining a poor reputation but freedom from monastic vows.

label: Failed Student
summary: A Minor Story Flaw for a character who studied for a university license but failed the final examination, gaining a Bad Academic Reputation of 2.

label: Falconer
summary: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for a character who trains hawks and falcons for a noble patron, granting Profession: Falconer and extra experience points.

label: Falke
summary: The Prima of House Bjornaer who seeks to end animosity with non-Hermetic shapeshifters and admit them to the House; leader of the Harmonist faction who becomes besieged on Rügen during the Crintera Schism.

label: Falkes de Breaute
summary: A powerful commoner-noble who professes loyalty to the king while disregarding central government; holds custody of the earl of Devon's lands and disputes manors with the earl of Pembroke.

label: Falls Like a Cat
summary: A Minor, General Virtue protecting a character from injury when falling up to three (or six) times his height.

label: False Power
summary: A Major (or repeatable Minor) Supernatural Tainted Flaw in which one of the character's Supernatural Virtues is also associated with the Infernal realm, making it appear unholy.

label: False Window
summary: A CrIm 5 miniature spell that traces a door or window frame to create an illusion of something beyond it, requiring a Perception + Finesse roll.

label: Familiar
summary: A magical companion bonded to a maga through Merinita's enchantment using three cords; Merinita summoned the first familiar, a great stag, and faerie familiars have special powers and decaying cords.

label: Familiar Bond
summary: A Hermetic enchantment binding a magus to a familiar; it can be dispelled by Perdo Vim and is automatically re-sustained when a magus enters an Aegis.

label: Famous
summary: A Virtue that cannot be used for an Artist Reputation, since characters with Famous are known for something other than their artwork.

label: Farrago Bonisagi
summary: A maga of House Bonisagus in the late 1000s who joined House Merinita to research faerie powers and discovered the three faerie cords (leaden, iron, and tin) for binding faerie familiars.

label: Fast Caster
summary: A Minor, Hermetic Virtue granting +3 to Initiative for casting spells in combat and +3 to fast-casting speed rolls.

label: Fast Runner
summary: A heartbeast Quality example that, applied via Theriomorphy, gives the magus the legs of his heartbeast.

label: Fatal Register
summary: A Muto Animal 20 spell that changes a book's bookmark ribbon into a venomous serpent (traditionally a cobra), typically vested in a single-use charged object activated when a book is stolen.

label: Fatigue
summary: A measure of tiredness with six named levels (Fresh, Winded, Weary, Tired, Dazed, Unconscious), lost through strenuous activity and recovered with rest.

label: Fauho
summary: The filius of Midusulf and second primus of House Bjornaer, with a fox heartbeast; the Seat of the Fox is named after him.

label: Faun
summary: A common woodland faerie creature; the common lezi is a form of faun, and gigantic fauns are found in the Basque country.

label: Faux Feudalism
summary: A Free covenant governance choice modeling hierarchical, feudal-style rule over residents.

label: Favors
summary: A Story Flaw representing being an agent who is periodically contacted by a principal or factor to provide information or assistance; also a minor inconvenient flaw on the Resistance table.

label: Fear
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw gained as an Ordeal in the sample Wayfarers Arcadian Travel Initiation, representing dread of something encountered on the path.

label: Feather Messenger
summary: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue for a bird-shifter who can separate a feather and telepathically control it as a self-inking quill, associated with the Daughters of Four Fathers.

label: Febris Semitertiana
summary: A Major Choleric Disease (Severity 18) from water corrupted by Saturn and Mars, capable of killing thousands in summer.

label: Fedoso
summary: The protagonist of Verderis's epic poem The Travels of Fedoso, a young man who travels a strange landscape facing mystical obstacles, believed by some Criamon to be a map of the House's future.

label: Feldberg
summary: The highest peak of the Black Forest, the bare-topped seat of the King of the Black Mountain, reached only via the haunted Höllental, with a multi-level regio of Faerie aura 3 to 8.

label: Felicia
summary: A freshly Gauntleted journeyman maga, filia of Dorana of Fengheld and a descendant of Trianoma in the lineage of Irmele, who works weather magic and travels the Tribunal.

label: Fengheld
summary: One of the two most powerful Rhine covenants, founded in the Harz Mountains in 1039 by veteran Tremere and Flambeau magi; rival to Durenmar and keen to found a chapter house in the Rhine Gorge.

label: Fenicil
summary: The Primus of House Guernicus and the Order's most famous historian, who claimed the tradition of magic was eternal and reputedly rediscovered some lost Mercurian rituals.

label: Fenistal
summary: The hidden 'covenant' base of the exsules, located in the southern Bohemian Forest in the upper level of a powerful magic regio (aura 8); the original temple of Diana where Merinita served, occupied by renegade House Merinita exiles.

label: Fenistour
summary: A figure who invented casting tools allowing Verditius magi to cast Formulaic spells; her filii later developed methods of enchanting those tools.

label: Feral Scent
summary: A Minor General Flaw giving a character the strong natural smell of a wild animal, imposing a social penalty and an Unclean Reputation but doubling Scent Target spell areas if Sensory Magic is Initiated.

label: Feral Upbringing
summary: A Flaw representing a wild, untamed childhood; a required Flaw of all Beast Masters due to their abandonment in the wilderness.

label: Ferocity
summary: A Minor Virtue for beasts only, granting confidence points usable when the animal's natural ferocity is triggered, such as defending its den; possessed by many of the Beasts of Legend.

label: Ferramentum of Verditius
summary: A magus of House Verditius whose wizard's sigil makes his spells very orderly, seen in his versions of The Cloudless Sky Returned and Curse of the Rotted Wood.

label: Fettered Magic
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw making all of the character's spells and activated magic item effects Arcane Connections to him.

label: Feud
summary: A major Flaw representing an ongoing feud likely to inconvenience a principal, lowering an agent's Resistance Strength.

label: Fickle Nature
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw causing the character to swing between two directly opposite personality behaviors with no middle ground.

label: Fidaʾi
summary: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for an assassin of the Nizari Isma'ilis trained in daggers and disguise, prepared to die on the sect's orders.

label: Fidelus
summary: A House Tytalus faction member who is a loyalist of Buliste, the ninth Prima; Fideli wear royal purple as their badge.

label: Fimus, Warrior Demon
summary: A warrior demon (Might 10, Terram) made of solid rock with one eye, controlling earth and exploding on death; one of many identical brother-demons used as foot-soldiers by other demons.

label: Findabair Ex Miscellanea
summary: A young, stunningly beautiful maga at Cad Gadu who uses magic to preserve her looks and dresses to seduce, while whining about the covenant's decay.

label: Finding Hidden Loot
summary: A Minor, General Virtue granting +9 to Awareness rolls when searching a confined space for hidden items.

label: Finesse
summary: The Ability governing precision and control when directing a spell's effect.

label: Finesse roll
summary: A roll using the Finesse Ability that controls the quality of craft magic and substitutes for mundane Craft rolls when using craft spells or devices.

label: Finz-Weibl
summary: A wood-wife who wears a wide-brimmed hat and is very hairy.

label: Fire Damp
summary: A Level 10 Alteration Reagent kept in a stoppered flask that releases a heavy gas which dampens the intensity of flames, removing 10 points of fire damage.

label: Fire Elemental
summary: An elemental being of fire that can be created from elemental matter via a Creo Ignem ritual and controlled, transformed, or destroyed via Ignem magic by reducing its Might.

label: Fireheart
aliases: The Lost Talisman of the Founder
summary: Flambeau's lost talisman, an oval-cut flawless fire opal the size of a walnut into which he invested several fire and mind effects; serves as an Arcane Connection to its creator.

label: First Flautist
summary: A leadership title of the Seirenes won at a grand competition every 12 years, treated equally to the other Firsts.

label: First Lyrist
summary: A leadership title of the Seirenes won at a grand competition every 12 years, treated equally to the other Firsts.

label: First Singer
summary: A leadership title of the Seirenes won at a grand competition every 12 years, hosting the next competition at her covenant.

label: Fish Out of Water (Terrain)
summary: A Minor General Flaw giving the character an affinity for one terrain type and penalties when away from it.

label: Fist of Shattering
summary: A Perdo Terram spell that breaks apart an object of stone or weaker material, cited as an example affected by the Harmless Magic Flaw.

label: Five Fairs of Flanders
summary: A fair cycle of Lille, Mesen, Ypres, Torout, and Bruges held between February and November, built on the fine woolen and linen cloth trade.

label: Flabbergast the Impertinent
summary: A sample relic power (2 points, Init +3, Mentem) that curses the target into a deep, snoring sleep for the night from which no magic can prematurely wake them.

label: Flamen
summary: The title ('priest') for a Mercurian magus, who performs ceremonial duties such as leading ritual magic, reading omens, and officiating Hermetic events.

label: Flames of Sculpted Ice
summary: A Muto Ignem spell (Level 35) with an Aquam requisite that turns a fire up to the size of a small house into ice sculptures of leaping flame; the flames return as the ice melts.

label: Flash of the Scarlet Flames
summary: A Creo Ignem spell that explodes a brilliant red flash in the air, able to temporarily or permanently blind a target who fails a Stamina roll; Rose of Jerbiton's version smells of roses.

label: Flashbacks
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which combat or tense situations may trigger hallucinatory flashbacks to past battles, causing panic.

label: Flavia of Jerbiton
summary: A Jerbiton maga trained by Jerbiton himself who founded Rosalba in 820 and wrote philosophical tractatus before her mysterious Final Twilight in 890.

label: Flavius Ex Miscellanea
summary: A frustrated old magus of Ungulus, trained there in its glory days, who clings to the failing covenant and hopes to rebuild it with young magi after the others pass.

label: Flawed Parma Magica
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character's Parma Magica provides only half the normal Magic Resistance against a certain Form.

label: Flawed Powers
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw applying the effects of a Major Hermetic Flaw (such as Restriction or Necessary Condition) to a character's Supernatural Virtues rather than to Hermetic magic.

label: Flawless Equipment
summary: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab's outfittings are flawless, perhaps too perfect for mortal hands (+2 General Quality, +2 Vis Extraction).

label: Flawless Magic
summary: A Major, Hermetic Virtue that automatically masters every spell learned at Spell Mastery 1 and doubles Spell Mastery Advancement Totals.

label: Flawless Tools
summary: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab's tools are legendarily perfect (+2 Items).

label: Flaws of the Weaponsmith
summary: A Perdo Terram 25 spell invented by Philippus Niger that rusts away up to 100 metal objects, such as the arms and armor of 30 men.

label: Fleets of Venice
summary: Heavily oversubscribed Venetian trading-fleet investments assumed unable to fail, whose occasional loss of ships to weather or piracy can cascade into an unraveling city economy.

label: Flexible Formulaic Magic
summary: A Major, Hermetic Virtue allowing slight variation of Formulaic spell parameters (Range, Duration, Target) while still casting known magic.

label: Florence
summary: A great Italian city founded by Julius Caesar in 59 BC, with a developed cloth and banking industry, dominated by noble tower societies and the feud between the Guelphs and Ghibellines.

label: Florilegium
summary: A category of compiled Hermetic book noted by dedicated students of a subject, rarer than the Roots and Branches and found in libraries specializing in its theme.

label: Fluctuating Fortune
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character alternates yearly between the Wealthy Virtue and the Poor Flaw in opposition to his needs.

label: Flumen of Tremere
summary: A Tremere magus, parens of Goliard and former leader of Blackthorn, who captured the Wild Hunt in 1154 and passed into Final Twilight in 1187.

label: Focus of Flambeau
summary: A Flambeau magus at Burnham, Scintilla's filius, about whom little else is known.

label: Focus Power
summary: A Major, Supernatural Virtue granting a supernatural power with a narrow range of effects, like a magical focus, with a 25-point pool for effect level and Penetration.

label: Fog of Confusion
summary: A Muto Auram ritual (Level 45) that turns a bank of fog into a silvery mist too thick to see through, harassing and confusing those within it.

label: Folk Ken
summary: An Ability used (with Awareness) to recognize hidden social or behavioral patterns, such as identifying the mushroom circle as dance steps.

label: Folk Magic
summary: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue allowing minor magic via a chosen (Realm) Lore in one of four areas: Abjuration, Divination, Healing, or Evil Eye.

label: Followers of Pendule
summary: A House Merinita lineage and Mystery Cult descended from Pendule's followers who Initiate the illusion Mysteries of Spell Timing, Glamour, and Perpetuity.

label: Font of Knowledge
summary: A Supernatural Ability allowing a creature to attempt a task with any untrained ability as if it had a score of 2 by succeeding in an Ability check.

label: Fooling the Eye
summary: A CrIm 10 miniature spell creating species of a swift bright object that makes the target's eyes track toward the magus, enabling Eye Range spellcasting.

label: Footsteps of Slippery Oil
summary: A Creo Aquam spell (Level 5) creating nonflammable grease from the caster's footsteps, leaving a slick area that forces Dexterity rolls.

label: Forceless Casting
summary: A technique of deliberately casting a spell with Penetration Total of 0 so it cannot affect a magus's Magic Resistance, used in tournaments and group spellcasting.

label: Foreign Upbringing
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw marking the character as a foreigner from a remote corner of Mythic Europe with odd customs and a foreign Native Language.

label: Forest Law
summary: A separate legal system applying in royal forests, prohibiting hunting, wood-cutting, and fires, enforced by foresters and forest eyres.

label: Forest of Shining Stone
summary: A Great Work at Durenmar where Bonisagus's epitome The Art of Magic has been etched into 36 clear crystals each six feet high.

label: Forest Paths
summary: Mystical paths through the forests of the Rhine Tribunal that a magus may explore; ascending the Glade of the Seven Waterfalls grants deeper understanding of the Forest.

label: Forge-Companion
summary: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for an unGifted craftsman attached to a Verditius magus and working in his lab, with extra experience for Crafts.

label: Forge of Hephaestus
summary: Sacred forges built by Hephaestus, the three Hermetic ones located at Verdi (Sardinia), Lemnos, and Mount Olympus, serving as Verditius Initiation chambers.

label: Forgettable Face
summary: A Minor, General Virtue making a character hard to notice or describe, imposing -3 on rolls to identify him but incompatible with great beauty or charisma.

label: (Form) Monstrosity
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw, mainly for animal characters, giving a monstrous feature corresponding to a magical Form, from which Muto vis may be extracted.

label: Form of the (Temperament) Heartbeast
summary: A Muto Animal 20 spell with four temperament versions (sanguine, choleric, melancholic, phlegmatic) that enhances an animal form's humoral correspondences; modeled from Birna's innate abilities.

label: Formula
summary: A researched recipe of experimental philosophy, like a Laboratory Text, describing how to make astrological inceptions, alchemical reagents, or pharmaceutical theriacs.

label: Formulaic Magic
summary: A category of Hermetic spell with fixed parameters, distinct from Spontaneous and Ritual magic, affected by Virtues like Boosted and Flexible Formulaic Magic.

label: Fornax of Tremere
summary: Goliard's filia at Blackthorn, an ugly and rude mature maga rumored to specialize in Rego and Mentem to make people entertain her.

label: Fortunata of Jerbiton
summary: A powerful eleventh-century spirit master of House Jerbiton who defeated many non-Hermetic enemies but was forced into exile and disappeared into Final Twilight after 1120.

label: Fortunatus of Jerbiton
summary: A magus of House Jerbiton whose Creo Imaginem illusions often have a small religious icon worked into their structure due to how he invents his spells.

label: Founding of the Order
summary: The historical establishment of the Order of Hermes, predating which some traditions held antipathies against House Diedne.

label: Fountain of Youth
summary: A magical fountain deep in the forest sought by Alexander of Jerbiton; drinking from it infused his blood with the power of youth, enhancing his longevity rituals.

label: Fountains Abbey
summary: A great Cistercian abbey in Yorkshire, founded in 1132 by monks from York and a daughter house of Clairvaux, motherhouse of a wide filiation.

label: Fourth Crusade
summary: A late-12th-century crusade for which the Venetians built a fleet; unable to pay, the Crusaders were forced to sack Constantinople in 1204, and many cycled-out Venetian warships later mysteriously disappeared.

label: Fourth Lateran Council
summary: A Church council of 1215 that forbade clergy from cautery or surgical incision and obliged physicians to require patients to summon a confessor before treatment.

label: Fragile Constitution
summary: A Minor General Flaw making the character sickly with a -3 penalty on rolls to recover from wounds and diseases.

label: Frail
summary: A Minor General Flaw making the character weak of build with a -3 penalty to Soak score.

label: France
summary: A kingdom of Mythic Europe whose king the king of England owes fealty for mainland possessions; home to Cluny, the Champagne fairs, and Laon, and which can be saved from demons in a saga.

label: Franciscan
summary: One of the two major new mendicant friar orders of the early thirteenth century, whose members take vows of poverty, chastity, and obedience and travel preaching.

label: Franciscan Order
summary: A mendicant order of friars founded in Italy in 1209, found preaching in market places and public squares, which had not yet spread beyond Italy and France.

label: Franconia
summary: A large and important region of the Rhine Tribunal containing some of the greatest German cities, with no single ruler; land shared between emperor and church.

label: Frankfurt
summary: A trading city founded by Charlemagne at the 'Ford of the Franks' on the River Main, home to about 10,000 citizens and host of imperial elections.

label: Frau Holle
summary: A modest Holzfrau who in the nine days before Walpurgis Night travels the land on a rickety wagon, pursued by the Wild Hunt, before ascending the Brocken and revealing herself as the goddess Walpurga.

label: Frau Wacholder
summary: A wood-wife who is the genius of the juniper tree, invoked to make thieves give up their booty.

label: Frau Wode
summary: The female leader of a Wild Hunt that haunts the Elbe river, accompanied by shadowy boatmen carrying invisible passengers.

label: Fredegisa the Quaesitor
summary: A reforming idealist quaesitor at Schola Pythagoranis, a brilliant young student of all laws who devises new structures of Hermetic law.

label: Frederick Barbarossa
summary: The emperor who in 1190 granted Bolognese scholars freedom of movement throughout the Holy Roman Empire and safe residences, the root of universities' political autonomy.

label: Free Expression
summary: A Minor Virtue prized by artistic Jerbiton magi; can be granted or doubled by a muse and grants familiarity bonuses with depicted objects.

label: Free Study
summary: A Minor, Hermetic Virtue adding +3 to Source Quality when studying from raw vis.

label: Freedom of Movement
summary: A common automaton power (base effect 25, Mentem requisite) letting the automaton walk toward areas pointed out to it.

label: Freeing the Striding Tree
summary: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 30) like Lord of the Trees but enabling the tree to walk half as fast as a human; a botched Concentration roll causes the tree to attack the caster.

label: Freiberg
summary: The biggest of the mining towns in the Ore Mountains, founded in 1186 after silver and tin were discovered.

label: Freiburg
summary: The largest settlement around the Black Forest, founded in 1120 by Conrad Zähringen, lying in the valley of the River Dreisam with a cathedral under construction.

label: Fria
summary: The goddess worshiped by the old Germanic tribes alongside Woden, Thunor, and Tius.

label: Friderich Invigilor
summary: The filius of Drogo Invigilor, similarly investigated by House Guernicus for his association with the Salian dynasty.

label: Friesland
summary: A broad, flat, swampy territory bordering the North Sea, sparsely populated and home to the independent Friesian people and the Friesian Islands.

label: Frightful Presence
summary: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue letting a character instill dread or awe, forcing witnesses to make Brave Personality rolls.

label: Frosty Breath of the Spoken Lie
aliases: Frosty Breath of the Spoken Lie
summary: An Intellego Mentem spell (Level 20) that makes a target exhale misty breath with each spoken lie; House Guernicus brought it to the Order and it is essential to Quaesitors.

label: Fudarus
summary: The domus magna of House Tytalus, where the memory of Kalliste is ritually cursed each midwinter; it is currently occupied by both rival Primi and maintains an immense spy network.

label: Fulda
summary: An important pilgrimage site and home to a wealthy monastery, burial place of the martyred English monk St. Boniface.

label: Fulmonious
summary: A magus of House Tytalus who, with Schwall of Bjornaer, founded the covenant of Rheinstein in the Rhine Gorge in 1123 AD.

label: Furioso
summary: A Sorcerous Musician who lacks Subtle Magic, used as a contrasting example to Orlando in Performance Magic.

label: Fury
summary: A Major Story Flaw in which a violent temper overwhelms the character, sending him into uncontrollable rage.

label: Fury of the Charging Bull
summary: A ReAn 20 spell that enrages a target animal (up to Size +3), sometimes used by School of Vilano followers to make animals attack enemies, though unpredictably.

label: Gabai
summary: A Minor Social Status Flaw marking the character as the local Jewish tax collector appointed by the community council, with a negative Tax Collector Reputation.

label: Gabriel, the Archangel of Prophecy
summary: A Divine creature (Might 100, Mentem), the chief messenger of God known for teaching the prophet Daniel, announcing Christ's incarnation to Mary, and bringing the Qur'an to Muhammad.

label: Galen
summary: The ancient authority on medicine since whom chirurgy has held a less prestigious position; quoted on the distinction between knowledge by experience and by reason.

label: Gallery
summary: A Minor laboratory Structure Virtue: an interior gallery or platform lets someone view the whole lab without disturbing it (+1 Safety, +1 Aesthetics, +1 Teaching).

label: Galley
summary: An oar-propelled single-masted vessel popular with Italian maritime powers and Byzantine states, designed to ram enemies and discourage piracy.

label: Galli
summary: A sect of nature worshippers once associated with the wild lands beyond the Roman Empire, later integrated into the Cult of Diana, said to be the origin of a True Merinitae Initiation Script.

label: Ganelon
summary: A leading magus of the Ash Gild who declared Wizard War on Aschlaranda and Schadrit and pursued them into the Black Forest, never to be heard from again.

label: Gangrene
summary: A Minor Sanguine Disease in which evil spirits in an improperly cleaned wound putrefy the blood; common after a botched Wound Recovery roll.

label: Garden of Eden
summary: The biblical paradise referenced in the Divine material of the setting.

label: Garotillo
summary: A Serious Choleric Disease from excessive exercise inflaming the choler; its second stage spreads to the windpipe causing suffocation.

label: Garrinchus
summary: A newly apprenticed magus of House Ex Miscellanea at Fengheld's Rheingasse chapter, companion of Wilhelm Weiss and a member of the Apple Gild; his master was an expert in physick.

label: Garus
summary: The current Primus of House Flambeau in 1220, an aging former soldier-of-fortune and tournament champion who leads the milites and authored the Code of Garus.

label: Gascony
summary: A region of southwestern France, the probable birthplace of Flambeau the Founder around 715 AD.

label: Gateway
summary: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab sits at a supernatural gateway such as a regio entrance, faerie realm, or Mercere Portal.

label: Gather the Essence of the Beast
aliases: Gather the Essence of the Beast
summary: A Touch-range, Momentary Vim spell that concentrates the raw vis in a corpse into one removable part, letting a magus gather vis without carrying entire corpses.

label: Gathering of the Stormy Might
summary: A Rego Auram spell (Level 40) like Clouds of Thunderous Might but producing a larger storm that can cover the entire visible sky.

label: Gathering of Twelve Years
summary: A periodic gathering of House Bjornaer (the Swan Clan performs a special ritual role at it); held in 1227 and figures in the Crintera Schism as each rival faction holds its own.

label: Gaudy
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab's decoration is tasteless and excessive (+1 Upkeep, -1 Aesthetics, +1 Imaginem).

label: The Gauntlet
summary: The final test of apprenticeship, after which an apprentice becomes a full magus of the Order.

label: Gaze of Death
summary: A Corpus power of the basilisk Sordus (8 points) that inflicts an incapacitating wound on anyone his gaze rests upon.

label: Geirlaug
summary: A notable contemporary House Flambeau Archmaga of Montverte covenant in the Normandy Tribunal, renowned for her great age, power, and mastery of Ignem.

label: Gelon
summary: Verditius's first apprentice and the first Primus of House Verditius; he attended the original Grand Tribunal, won the first Contest, and perpetuated the Corsican blood feud.

label: Gender Nonconforming
summary: A Personality Flaw (Major or Minor) representing a character who does not conform to societal gender expectations; common among Faerie Doctors.

label: Gender Shift
summary: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue letting a character change genders each midnight, with consistent male and female forms.

label: Generous
summary: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character willingly gives away property to anyone who desires it.

label: Genius Locus
summary: A spirit embodying and protecting a particular forest, formed from the fragmentation of the great Hercynian Forest spirit; each has a Might score, Personality Traits, and Special Powers.

label: Genoa
summary: A north Italian city-state whose merchants rival Venice's and who have seeded the East with trading colonies that act as resupply points and friendly wartime ports.

label: Genomi
summary: Earth elementals known to the Order as genomi, rarefied from unworked earth, rock, or metal; long-lived, patient predators that crave the moisture of living beings and make excellent guards.

label: Gentle Caress of Aesclepius
summary: A CrCo 30 Ritual spell that improves all of the target's wounds by one level of severity and instantly heals Light Wounds.

label: Gentle Touch of the Purified Body
aliases: Gentle Touch of the Purified Body
summary: A Corpus spell that, under these rules, heals a Minor disease instead of a Light Wound caused by disease.

label: Gentleman
summary: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for a minor member of a noble family treated as their own and addressed as Lord or Lady, though without inheritance.

label: Geoffrey de Mandeville
summary: A treacherous noble who, charged with treason in 1143, ravaged the East Anglian fens and destroyed the covenant of Natura Antiqua before being killed in 1144.

label: Geoffrey de Marsh
summary: The justiciar of Ireland refusing to come to England to account for his office's revenues, possibly seeking to form a palatinate with vice-regal authority.

label: Geoffrey de Nevile
summary: The seneschal of Poitou who returned to England to resign his office, claiming he lacked the resources to carry out his role.

label: Gerald of Wales
summary: A churchman who campaigned much of his life to make St. Davids an archbishopric over the Welsh sees, author of The Journey Through Wales.

label: Gerard
summary: A grog used in the complex combat example, with combat statistics and skills Single Weapon 6 and Leadership 2, who fights his faerie duplicate.

label: Gerbert of Aurillac
summary: A scholar said in legend to have stolen a book of magic from a Saracen wizard and made a golden oracular head; Hermetic seekers covet his rumored treasures.

label: Gerfallon of Criamon
summary: The tattooed, shape-shifting Criamon leader of Semitae since 1151 who maps the covenant's wanderings and pursues the Enigma; shows no signs of aging.

label: Gerfallon of Semitae
summary: A magus of the tribunal whom some magi believe carved the strange cup-and-ring markings at Roughting Linn, though he will not confirm it.

label: Gerontocracy
summary: A Free covenant governance choice in which the oldest members rule.

label: Gharad Ex Miscellanea
summary: The second oldest maga at Cad Gadu, nearly blind and beset by Twilight delusions; rarely leaves her sanctum.

label: Ghent
summary: A place near which the Spinnen Blood family line of the Faerie Blood Virtue originated.

label: Ghibellines
summary: One of the two factions feuding over Florence since 1216, splitting the city along with the Guelphs.

label: Ghost
summary: The disembodied spirit of a dead person, associated with Mentem; ghosts can be warded against, summoned, coerced, or controlled by Mentem magic.

label: Ghostly Warder
summary: A bound ghost covenfolk template with Magic Might 10 (Mentem), insubstantial and invisible, that stands watch over a covenant; bound magically rather than haunting.

label: Giant
summary: Large Magic-realm Corpus creatures detailed in the bestiary.

label: Giant Blood
summary: A Virtue indicating descent from giants, cited as a possible background Virtue for an Ex Miscellanea magus and common among the Damhadh-Duidsan.

label: Giant Blooded
summary: A Virtue making a character larger than a normal human, so that a wound that would be Medium for a normal human is only Light for them.

label: Giant's Dance
summary: The great stone circle Merlin magically moved from Mount Killaraus in Ireland to Britain, erecting it around the tomb of those slain at Ambrius (Stonehenge).

label: Giants' Blood
summary: A heritage that makes its bearer unusually large and strong; Great William has giants' blood and stands just under eight feet tall.

label: Gift of the Bear's Fortitude
summary: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 25) that makes the caster's flesh resistant to physical damage (+3 Soak) but insensitive to touch.

label: Gift of the Frog's Legs
summary: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 15) that allows the target to leap up to 15 feet vertically or 25 feet horizontally.

label: Gift of the Tortured Bowels
summary: A Rego Corpus 10 spell that inflicts a sudden intestinal cramp and bout of diarrhea, used therapeutically by medically inclined magi to purge putrefied humors.

label: Gifted Companion
summary: A character type a hedge wizard may become if the opening of his Arts fails or he declines the risk, joining the Order without full magus status.

label: Gifted Companions
summary: Hedge wizards new to the Order, or those resisting conversion to Hermetic magic, who have The Gift and one or more Supernatural Abilities but do not open their Arts; the Scinnfolk are an example.

label: Gilbertine Order
summary: The order of St. Gilbert of Sempringham, confined to eastern England and unique in having both male (Augustinian canons) and female (Benedictine nuns) members.

label: (Gild) Enmity
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw representing the active enmity of one of the Rhine's political gilds, which seeks to thwart the character politically; Tabanus has Hawthorn Gild Enmity.

label: (Gild) Trained
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue representing training at Durenmar and induction into a Rhine political gild, granting extra experience points appropriate to the gild.

label: Gilles de Corbeil
summary: An 80-year-old master physician and archiater (chief physician) to King Philip Augustus of France, born in northern France in 1140, who trained at Salerno under Petrus Musandinus and wrote famous summae on urine and the pulse in hexameter verse.

label: Gillomaur
summary: The king of Ireland who swore the Britons would take no stone from his kingdom; his naked army was defeated and he was slain in a wood while fleeing.

label: Gilpatrick
summary: An Irish-born baccalaureate student at the University of Paris and companion-level character with the Entrancement Ability and Latent Magic Ability, indebted to the bishop of Dublin.

label: Glam
summary: A revenant of the walking dead from The Saga of Grettir the Strong who rode on house-tops by night and terrorized a district after his death.

label: Glamour
summary: A Major Illusion Mystery of House Merinita that creates illusions with real substance via Muto or Creo Imaginem; Merinitae gain the Vulnerable Magic Flaw on Initiation.

label: Glass-blower
summary: A covenfolk template for a dwarf-blooded glassblower craftsman with Faerie Blood and Great Dexterity, able to make clear glass.

label: Glastonbury Abbey
summary: The oldest and richest monastery in England, identified with the isle of Avalon and the burial place of Arthur, standing near Glastonbury Tor in the Somerset fens.

label: Glastonbury Tor
summary: A commanding hill near Glastonbury where St. Collen confronted Gwynn ab Nudd's faerie castle.

label: Gleam of the Freshly-Polished Glass
summary: A Perdo Terram 25 spell that keeps a lab's equipment immaculately clean, granting the Spotless Virtue while cast monthly but raising Warping by one.

label: Gleemen
summary: A group of jugglers warned of by northern clerics as tainted by the infernal, accused of diabolical powers, robbery, and sacrificing stolen children to a demon patron.

label: Glesig
summary: A master maga of House Merinita at Irencillia, most versed in the subterranean fae and specializing in Terram magics; her copper hair is a Twilight effect and her familiar is the troll caricature Humnel.

label: Gloom of Evening
summary: A Perdo Ignem spell (Level 10) that substantially drops the level of light in a target room, making it gloomy with deep shadows.

label: Glowing Footprints of the Thief
summary: A MuIm 20 synaesthetic spell that makes a person's sweat traces visible by transforming olfactory species into iconic species.

label: Gmünd
summary: A town in the Stauferland founded by Conrad III in the 12th century, named after the Hohenstaufen dynasty; it lies on the ancient Roman limes and specializes in luxuries.

label: God
summary: The supreme being of the Divine Realm in Mythic Europe.

label: Godfroi
summary: An example agent of Carolus, a merchant who handles stolen goods and is influential in local government and the Merchant Guild; held by Fear of Carolus.

label: Goetic Art of Binding
summary: A Goetic Art used by a sahir to bind the Buran of Yenghissar; an Infernal supernatural ability for trapping spirits.

label: Golden Cider
summary: The power gained at the Avenue of Death on the Path of Strife, which makes mystical things mundane; many followers use it upon themselves near death to relinquish The Gift.

label: Golden Cord
summary: The three mystical cords forged when binding a familiar: golden (magic), silver (mind), and bronze (body), each rated 0 to +5 and granting specific benefits.

label: Golden Fleece
summary: The treasure the Argonauts voyaged to retrieve, during which Orpheus saved them from the sirens.

label: Golden Head of Gerbert
summary: A legendary golden head crafted by Gerbert of Aurillac said to answer yes or no to any question; rumored to be used in Verditius Mystery Cult initiations.

label: Golden Maiden of Hephaestus
summary: An ancient automaton created by Hephaestus and left in his forge; Verditius alone could understand it and made it function for seven days.

label: Golden Map
summary: A solid-gold, gemstone-marked copy of an ancient Roman map given to Augustus Caesar; coveted as an enchantment shape and possible Arcane Connection, and rumored by some pagans to sustain the Dominion.

label: Goliard
summary: The vigorous apparent leader of Blackthorn, nearly ninety, who controls a bound elemental spirit and seeks to restore the covenant's lost influence.

label: Goliardic tradition
summary: A tradition of wandering, irreverent student-poets famously led by the Archpoet, spreading debauchery and satire across Germany and Italy.

label: Golias of Tytalus
summary: An old Tytalus magus at Blackthorn who feigns being newly gauntleted; the covenant's best political dealer, with unknown magical interests.

label: Good Teacher
summary: A Virtue improving the quality of works a character produces; Hildegard of Bingen's Good Teacher Virtue contributes to the exceptional Quality of her writings.

label: Gorgias
summary: A Sophist and pupil of Empedocles quoted in the Analects of Tytalus who taught the arts of persuasion and deceit, illustrating the corrupting power of words.

label: Gorgiastic
summary: Former House Criamon magi (or their descendants) who rejected the quest for the answer; named for a student of Empedocles, most found in Houses Ex Miscellanea and Jerbiton.

label: Gorlois
summary: Lord whose stronghold was Tintagel and whose wife Ygerna Uther Pendragon desired; Uther was magically disguised as him to father Arthur.

label: Goslar
summary: A Free Imperial City on the northern edge of the Harz Mountains, famed for the silver mines of the Rammelsberg, which are flooding due to spiteful gnomes.

label: Gossip
summary: A minor general Virtue making a character a fount of rumor and information; listed as a resource increasing an agent's Resistance Strength.

label: Gossip of the Marketplace
summary: A Creo(Rego) Mentem 20 spell invented by Imanitos Mendax that implants information in a target who is then compelled to pass it on to friends.

label: Gothic shapeshifters
summary: An Infernal Gothic witch-cult that enslaved ancestor-spirits to shapeshift; Birna's former tradition, surviving in secret in the forests of Pomerania and reviling Birna.

label: Granada
summary: A region whose harried magi monitor the largest uncontrolled portal at the Pillars of Hercules for creatures that might harm Europe.

label: Grand Entrance
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Virtue: an elaborate entranceway leads to the lab, impressing observers (+2 Aesthetics).

label: Grand Silesia
summary: A covenant founded between the Oder and Warta rivers in Poland by magi from Rethra and Crintera (993-1009); it split to form the New Slavonic Tribunal and was destroyed in the Schism War.

label: Grand Tribunal
summary: The supreme Tribunal of the Order of Hermes that can modify the Code as practiced in all Tribunals; it ended the Tytalus-Flambeau conflict in 1063 and sponsored joint covenants.

label: Grant Flaw
summary: A special power of the Holm Oak of Romowe that inflicts the Depression Flaw upon anyone who breaks a branch or kills an animal in its grove.

label: Gratian
summary: A Benedictine monk at Bologna who completed the Decretum, a collection of ecclesiastical laws, contributing to Bologna's legal reputation.

label: Gravis
summary: A journeyman magus of House Bonisagus at Irencillia pursuing a fascination with the fae; despite great Faerie Lore he cannot grasp Faerie Magic, and his caricature is the grumpy dwarf Danket.

label: Great Beast
summary: Powerful ancestral beast-spirits of House Bjornaer who set quests and trials for magi seeking the Inner Heartbeast Mysteries and who act as Mystagogues during their Initiation.

label: Great Characteristics
summary: A Virtue boosting a character's physical or mental Characteristics; held by the Blacksmith template.

label: Great Communication
summary: A Virtue held by Brogo giving him exceptional Communication, contributing to his songs' Aesthetic Quality.

label: Great Dexterity
summary: A Virtue providing an exceptionally high Dexterity Characteristic, taken by the glass-blower and burglar templates.

label: Great Intelligence
summary: A Virtue that raises a character's Intelligence Characteristic beyond the normal limit; an example Great Characteristic Virtue.

label: Great Lezi
summary: A powerful faerie (Might 40, Herbam) of Slavic lands appearing as a tall pale bearded man who commands woodland animals and can change into any plant or animal and vary its size enormously.

label: Great Presence
summary: A Virtue boosting a character's Presence Characteristic; one of Falke's Virtues.

label: Great Stamina
summary: A Minor General Virtue boosting the Stamina Characteristic; required of Nephilim.

label: Great Strength
summary: A Virtue recommended for Line of Muj characters, representing their supernaturally great hereditary strength.

label: Great Weapon
summary: A combat Ability used for large two-handed weapons such as the cudgel, pole arm, great sword, long spear, and warhammer.

label: Great William
summary: A Redcap with giants' blood standing just under eight feet tall; interested in magical theory, with boots of swiftness and an enchanted accurate axe.

label: Great Work
summary: Beautiful learning structures created as alternatives to books that embody their creators' values, studied as summae or tractatus, costing at least 100 Mythic Pounds to build.

label: Greater Benediction
summary: A Major, Supernatural Virtue granting a major blessing from a supernatural power, with examples such as Flight, True Sight, and Universally Liked.

label: Greater Collection
summary: The sum of all Hermetic libraries, which great libraries coordinate to build by specializing in areas of weakness; Durenmar aids its construction as a spare copy of its own collection.

label: Greater Expansion
summary: A Major laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is greatly enlarged with at least double the usual equipment for specialized tasks.

label: Greater Feature
summary: A Major laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab prominently features a unique extensive structure aiding certain lab work, granting +2 Aesthetics and 3 Specialization points.

label: Greater Focus
summary: A Major laboratory Structure Flaw: an existing Greater Feature is the overwhelming focus of the lab, enhancing it but hindering unrelated activities (-2 General Quality).

label: Greater Guardian
summary: A Major laboratory Supernatural Virtue: a powerful supernatural creature (Might 20+) that is not the owner's familiar resides in and protects the lab.

label: Greater Horde
summary: A Major laboratory Supernatural Virtue: a large community of minor supernatural creatures serves and protects the lab and assists with simple tasks.

label: Greater Illusion
summary: A Major laboratory Supernatural Flaw: a major aspect of the lab is merely an illusion; a balancing Major Virtue is taken but its effects are negated.

label: Greater Immunity
summary: A Major Virtue that a Bjornaer inner heartbeast may acquire (Ease Factor 30), also listed as a beast Virtue (e.g., immunity to fire or poison for a lizard).

label: Greater Infernal Power
summary: A Major Supernatural Virtue for corrupted beasts adding 5 to Infernal Might and granting an Infernal Power requiring a Penetration total.

label: Greater Malediction
summary: A Major Supernatural Flaw in which the character has been cursed by a supernatural power in a way comparable to other Major Flaws.

label: Greater Power
summary: A Major, Supernatural Virtue granting an at-will supernatural power equivalent to a Formulaic Hermetic spell of level 50 or lower.

label: Greater Purifying Touch
summary: A Supernatural Virtue (Greater or Lesser) cited as a possible Major Virtue for a magus Ex Miscellanea and common among the Scinnfolk.

label: Greedy
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw driving a character toward acquisitiveness; the Nephilim must take it due to their enormous appetite.

label: Greek Fire
summary: A sticky, flammable substance that cannot be extinguished by water, used by the Byzantine navy from siphons and catapult pots to incinerate enemy vessels; its manufacture is a closely guarded secret.

label: Green Dragon of Labin
summary: A dragon famously slain by the Flambeau magus Vilano, who crushed it with two falling trees using only indirect spells.

label: Gregorius of Bonisagus
summary: A young Bonisagus magus, one of the newly arrived members of Libellus.

label: Gremlins
summary: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab is home to deliberately disruptive creatures, spirits, or demons (-3 Safety, +1 Warping, -1 Aesthetics).

label: Grendel
summary: A troll that terrorized King Hrothgar's hall until slain by Beowulf; its kin still haunt the bogs of Zealand and plague the covenant Heorot.

label: Griffin
summary: A famous legendary chimera; also a Mythic Blood lineage granting the Panic of the Elephant's Mouse feat and a Focus in Courage.

label: Grifo
summary: An example famous maestro affiliated with the Divine realm, commissioned to paint a wall mural for the bishop of Milan.

label: Grim
summary: An example grog used to illustrate disease and demonic possession rules, who is assailed by a Demon of Scrofula.

label: Grime's Graves
summary: About a dozen large pits with tunnels in a Norfolk chalk hill, believed to be inhabited by faerie folk; those who wander too close at night tend to vanish, and strange lights are seen.

label: Grimgroth
summary: A figure of the Order named as a trademark in the book's front matter.

label: Grip of the Choking Hand
summary: A Perdo Corpus spell (Level 25) that makes the target feel an invisible strangling hand on the throat, losing a Fatigue level each round.

label: Grog
summary: A mundane soldier or servant of a covenant, the rank-and-file companions who guard and serve the magi.

label: Growth of the Creeping Things
summary: A Muto Animal spell (Level 15) causing a small creature like an insect, mouse, or toad to grow to four times its normal size, increasing any venom.

label: gruagachan
summary: Monstrous wizards of northern Britain who, along with the Anglo-Saxon rune wizards, joined Damhan-Allaidh to oppose the Order.

label: Grudge
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character holds a strong grudge against someone in his normal social circle and seeks to outdo them.

label: Gruffyd ap Llewelyn
summary: A Welsh king who attacked England, besieged Blackthorn and sacked Cad Gadu; magi suspected him of being a returned Díedne magus due to his name.

label: Guard
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: a shield grog stands permanent duty at the lab's entrance to dissuade intruders (+1 Aesthetics).

label: Guardian Angel
summary: A Major, General Virtue giving a character a divine watcher who offers spiritual advice and can grant +5 Soak and Magic Resistance 15.
