summary: A great earthwork of more than seventy miles marking the England-Wales boundary, completed in 787 with the faerie Huarwar's aid.

label: Offensive to (Beings)
summary: A Minor General Flaw causing a chosen class of beings (humans, demons, or divine beings) to react badly to the character; known among Merinitae as the Tin, Iron, and Leaden Gifts.

label: Ogam
summary: Runes carved into trees and stones or written in ashes by the Damhadh-Duidsan to curse, steal life, inflict wounds, and heal.

label: Ogmios
summary: A Gaulish god of strength, eloquence, and poetry worshiped at the western Vosges springs, identified by the Romans as Hercules.

label: Ointment for Congealing Blood
summary: A Theriac of Level 20, Potency Moderate, a compress of tormentil and comfrey that stays bleeding and cures a Medium Wound from a slashing weapon over a month.

label: Ominous Levitation of the Weighty Stone
aliases: Ominous Levitation of the Weighty Stone
summary: A ReTe 15 spell that moves a stone through the air; when released it falls naturally and bypasses Magic Resistance, dealing damage based on the stone's size with a successful aiming roll.

label: On Divers Arts
summary: A famous craft manual by the monk Theophilus about painters, glass makers, and metalworkers that adds +4 to a craftsman's Workshop Total.

label: Opening the Intangible Tunnel
summary: A Rego Vim spell that opens a magical channel from the caster to a target, allowing spells of greater than Personal range to be cast through it, subject to Penetration of Magic Resistance.

label: Opening the Tome of the Animal's Mind
aliases: Opening the Tome of the Animal's Mind
summary: An Intellego Animal spell (Level 25) that lets the caster read an animal's memories of the past day by touching its head.

label: Ophia Sirnaus Isle-Warden
summary: Clan Chief of Clan Sirnas, a serpent-heartbeast maga who lives on an uninhabited Aegean island with a shrine to Artemis.

label: Optimistic
summary: A Personality Flaw making a character habitually optimistic; held by the Scribe template, swappable for Carefree or Pessimistic.

label: Opulent
summary: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is comfortable and well furnished (+1 Upkeep, +1 Health, +2 Aesthetics, +1 Teaching).

label: The Order of Hermes
summary: The society of Hermetic magi founded by Bonisagus and Trianoma, organized into Houses and Tribunals and bound by the Code of Hermes.

label: Order of Hermes Lore
summary: A General Ability covering knowledge of the legends, history, structure, operation, and goals of a specified organization; Order of Hermes Lore is a notable example.

label: Order of Montjoie
summary: The oldest of three monastic orders dedicated to ransoming slaves, now failing and negotiating to be absorbed by another order.

label: Order of Odin
summary: A putative organized group of powerful pagan Norse wizards in Scandinavia, a long-standing threat and bugbear of the Order of Hermes whose very existence remains unconfirmed.

label: Order of St. John
summary: A religious order that built the Jerusalem Hospital for those injured on Crusade.

label: Order of Suleiman
summary: A legendary organization of Islamic magi, rivals in power to the Order of Hermes, said to be the association of the non-Hermetic sahirs with close ties to Levantine rulers.

label: Order of the Green Cockerel
summary: A Hermetic group described in The Mysteries, Revised Edition, likely to include at least one member of the Collegium.

label: Order of the Hospitalers of St. Anthony
aliases: Order of the Hospitalers of St. Anthony
summary: An order established in 1095 and named after a fourth-century Egyptian hermit; it knows a ritual to exorcise the St. Anthony's Fire demon and maintains houses across Europe with a chapter house in London.

label: Order of the Lady of Mercy
aliases: Order of the Lady of Mercy
summary: An order of monks founded in 1218 dedicated to ransoming slaves.

label: Original Research
summary: The pursuit of advancing Hermetic theory through novel investigation, which Pralicians are especially likely to undertake.

label: Orlando
summary: A musician and magus who knows Sorcerous Music and Subtle Magic, used as an example of casting spells while singing or playing his lute.

label: Orn
summary: The ancestor after whom the Clan Wilkis Sept of Orn is named.

label: Orphedra
summary: A cruel Follower of Merinita at Dankmar (age 139), the covenant's link to the dark fae who specializes in illusions, cold, darkness, and fear; she taught Schadrit Faerie Magic.

label: Orpheus
summary: The legendary Thracian poet, musician, and magician taught by Hermes, regarded by his cult as the first user of Hermetic magic and who descended to the Underworld for Eurydice.

label: Orphic Magic
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue granting Orphic magoi access to the additional Range Adelphixis, using emotional connections as Arcane Connections.

label: Ossium of Bjornaer
summary: A magus of House Bjornaer whose version of Talons of the Winds produces an eerie keening sound; his wizard's sigil makes many of his spells eerie or frightening.

label: Oswald
aliases: Saint Oswald, King of the Northumbrians
summary: A most Christian king of the Northumbrians (633-642) who raised a cross before battle and won; many miracles and healings occurred at the cross and at the sites of his death and burial.

label: Otto I
summary: Son of Henry the Fowler, crowned at Aachen in 936, who defeated the Magyars at the Battle of the Lech (Lechfeld) in 955 and was crowned emperor in Rome in 962.

label: Outcast
summary: A Minor Social Status Flaw in which normal society rejects the character and he is not attached to a covenant; he may not take the Wealthy Virtue.

label: Outdoors
summary: A Major laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab is not housed in a building and is fully exposed to the elements, taken with the Natural Environment Virtue.

label: Outlaw
summary: A Major Social Status Flaw in which the character has been outlawed and must live by his wits outside society, with a Reputation at level 2 for whatever got him outlawed.

label: Outlaw Leader
summary: A minor Social Status Flaw that grants a character an agency of criminal underlings prior to play; listed with a Resistance of -1 on the Resistance of Agents Table.

label: Outsider
summary: A Minor or Major Social Status Flaw in which the character belongs to an identifiable group that is distrusted or disliked, giving a bad Reputation among the dominant social group.

label: Overconfident
summary: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character has unshakable faith in his own abilities and cannot imagine failure.

label: Oversensitive
summary: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character finds intolerable something others find merely unpleasant.

label: Owein son of Uryen
summary: A figure at Arthur's court in the Dream of Rhonabwy who played gwyddbwyll with Arthur while his magical ravens battled Arthur's men.

label: Owl of Virtue
summary: A Great Beast Mythic Blood lineage granting the Silence of the Smothered Sound feat, a Focus in Ghosts, and the Nocturnal flaw.

label: Oxford
summary: A master-run English university closely modeled on Paris, with four faculties and two student nations, governed via a chancellor appointed by the Bishop of Lincoln.

label: Pack Mentality / Follower
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw making the character a follower rather than a leader who tends to stick with a decisive person.

label: Paderborn
summary: A town at the source of the River Pader, famous as the site of the 799 meeting of Charlemagne and Pope Leo III that agreed the establishment of the Holy Roman Empire.

label: Pagan
summary: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character does not follow the Church and has never been baptized; may begin with Magic Lore or Faerie Lore.

label: Pagan Theology
summary: An Ability covering non-Christian religious doctrine; the second book of Aristotle's Metaphysics is a tractatus on it.

label: Paid Rights
summary: A Virtue that is a game-mechanical way to acknowledge that an exceptional woman who holds public power in Mythic Europe is genuinely exceptional.

label: Painful Magic
summary: A Major Hermetic Flaw in which casting spells causes the equivalent of one Fatigue level in pain per spell, applying a cumulative penalty to actions.

label: Pains of the Perpetual Worry
summary: A Creo Mentem spell (Level 20) that gives someone a nagging, painful recurrent emotion of anxiety and fear; described as truly a curse.

label: Painting
summary: A Craft/Profession Ability representing skill at painting, used in the example maestro Grifo's Aesthetic Quality calculations.

label: Palatial
summary: A Major laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is lavishly outfitted with the best comforts and decoration (+1 General Quality, +3 Upkeep, +2 Health, +4 Aesthetics).

label: Pallas
summary: A maga whose death left her lover, a nymph of unmatched beauty, in inconsolable mourning, leaving a covenant tower unused for sixty years.

label: Palm of Flame
summary: A Creo Ignem spell (Level 5) in which a flame leaps up in the caster's upturned palm, casting torch-like light and igniting flammable items without burning or damaging the caster.

label: Palsied Hands
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character's hands shake uncontrollably, giving -2 to rolls involving holding or wielding objects and an extra botch die when casting.

label: Pancrestis
aliases: Pancrestis filius Occultes, Follower of Bonisagus
summary: A young journeyman of House Bonisagus at Heorot, filius of Occultes and mentored by Philippus Niger, keen to learn Norse magic but deeply fearful of the wilderness.

label: Pandora
summary: A clay woman that Hephaestus made for Zeus, listed among his famous treasures.

label: Pandulf
summary: The Papal Legate in England, elected bishop of Norwich in 1215 but not yet consecrated, who serves as regent for the young king and in theory outranks both king and archbishop.

label: Panic of the Elephant's Mouse
summary: A Rego Animal spell (Level 15) that makes an animal afraid of the target, causing it to flee by the quickest means.

label: Panic of the Trembling Heart
summary: A Creo Mentem spell cited as an example of a base-level-4 spell creating emotion directed at a particular person or object.

label: Panther of Virtue
summary: A symbolic beast whose hide provides a Shape and Material bonus of +6 to song and melodious sounds.

label: Paralyze a Man at R: Eye
aliases: Paralyze a Man at R: Eye
summary: The magical feat granted to magi of the Wolf of Virtue Mythic Blood lineage.

label: Parching Wind
summary: A Perdo Aquam spell (Level 20) that removes most water from an object, and with a Corpus or Animal requisite can damage humans or animals while making them thirsty.

label: Parens
summary: A magus's master/teacher within the Order; the parens trains the apprentice, sets the gauntlet, and conventionally is regarded as a superior throughout life.

label: Paris (son of Priam)
summary: Son of the faerie lord Priam of Ilium, who holds a beauty contest during Ilium's mid-summer fair.

label: Parma Magica
summary: The Hermetic defense against magic, invented by Bonisagus; the personal magic resistance that made the Order possible.

label: Parsirus
summary: A Verditius magus of Ungulus, beloved of Sinead, who was killed by the dragon.

label: Parting the Waves
summary: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 30) that parts a body of water, revealing a dry path five paces wide along the bottom.

label: Partner
summary: A major Social Status Virtue for a character with a large financial stake in a wealthy company, providing minor-noble-level income and the ability to act in any company role except capo.

label: Parzival
summary: A poem by Wolfram von Eschenbach of which the legend of the swan knight Lohengrin forms part.

label: Pass the Unyielding Portal
summary: A Muto Herbam spell (Level 5) that makes the wood of a door pliable, allowing the magus to bend it open regardless of most locks or bars.

label: Passion's Lost Feeling
summary: A spell that renders the target unable to feel any emotion, leaving them listless and without motivation.

label: Past of Another
summary: A Muto Mentem ritual (Level 35) that completely rewrites the target's memories so they cannot remember their actual life until the effect is dispelled or expires.

label: Path
summary: A House Criamon tradition combining a field of study, set of values, and lifestyle, each granting different Mystery Virtues; clutches originally followed a single path.

label: Path of Aging
summary: A forest path through which Alexander of Jerbiton sought to reverse aging, requiring sacrifices and a quest to drink from the Fountain of Youth, yielding the Immortality of the Forest Virtue.

label: Path of Energy
summary: A forest path discovered by Terious of Flambeau to replenish spent spellcasting energy from the forest, yielding the Life Boost and Mythic Blood Virtues.

label: Path of Warping
summary: A forest path walked by Kleon of Criamon to influence the effect of Wizard's Twilight on his Gift, yielding the Puissant Enigmatic Wisdom and Twilight Mastery Virtues.

label: Paths through the Forest
summary: A tradition of nature magic inherited from Merinita, walked by many exsules, which may let them overcome one or more of the Lesser Limits of Hermetic magic.

label: Patron
summary: A sponsor who agrees to support an artist for an undetermined length of time, funding all of his work; losing one costs 12 Artist Reputation experience points.

label: Peasant
summary: A Free Social Status Virtue for a free (non-serf) character who lives by working the land, possibly controlling and hiring labor if wealthy.

label: Peering into the Mortal Mind
summary: An Intellego Mentem spell (Level 30) that lets the caster thoroughly probe and understand the contents of the target's mind, including motives, strengths, and weaknesses.

label: Peitho
summary: The Daimon of persuasion and charming speech, daughter of Styx and Pallas, who with her sister Bia represents forceful inducement.

label: Pelagius
summary: One of Jerbiton's allies who traveled Europe seeking further recruits for the expanding House.

label: Pelican of Virtue
summary: A symbolic bird whose beak provides a Shape and Material bonus of +8 to healing and nurturing.

label: Pendule
summary: A legendary Provençal hedge wizard who evaded the Founder Flambeau, took four Hermetic followers (two from House Merinita), taught illusion Mysteries, and died in 854 AD.

label: Penetration
summary: The Ability and value determining whether a spell overcomes a target's Magic Resistance.

label: Penetration Ability
summary: An Ability that provides a Penetration bonus; creatures and characters without it have a Penetration bonus of zero.

label: Penteli
summary: The marble quarries near Athens, cited as a legendary mining income example.

label: Perceive Motives
summary: An Intellego Mentem effect (InMe 10) enchanted into Falke's talisman, like Sight of the Transparent Motive but with zero Penetration to avoid affecting Hermetic magi.

label: Perceive the Change
summary: An InAn 14 constant enchantment effect detecting whether an item touches an animal, used to trigger linked size/shape effects when a Bjornaer transforms.

label: Perceive the Eyes of Knives
summary: A new Intellego Mentem spell (InMe 20) invented for Tabanus that indicates whether anyone in the target room has hostile thoughts toward the caster.

label: Perception of Conflicting Motives
summary: An Intellego Mentem 15 spell known by Imanitos Mendax.

label: Perception of the Conflicting Motives
summary: An Intellego Mentem spell (Level 15) that detects the conflicting motives behind a target's actions, often cast before a Muto or Rego spell to change emotions.

label: Perceval
summary: A Redcap in his late forties contemplating retirement; tall, thin, balding, married to Lucy, with a brooch that makes him and his horse invisible.

label: Perdo
summary: Technique meaning 'I destroy'. Destroys, weakens, harms or removes.

label: Perdo Vim
summary: A Hermetic Technique-Form combination of destruction and magical power; Perdo Vim spells that reduce Might can kill a legendary artist.

label: Peredur
summary: A knight-hero of a Mabinogion tale who slew the Black Oppressor and the Black Serpent of the Barrow with the aid of a magic stone given by a mysterious lady.

label: Peredur's concealment stone
summary: A magic stone given to Peredur by a mysterious lady that hid him from the seeing stone pillar guarding the Black Serpent's cave, letting him slay the serpent unseen.

label: Peregrinator
summary: The wandering magi of the Rhine Tribunal, typically journeymen, who travel from covenant to covenant relying on the Laws of Hospitality; about a sixth of Rhine magi are peregrinatores.

label: Perfect Balance
summary: A Minor General Virtue granting +6 to rolls to avoid falling or tripping, especially on narrow ledges or tightropes.

label: Perfect Eye for (Commodity)
summary: A minor general Virtue letting a character always accurately assess the value of one commodity and products made from it, granting extra Labor Points when trading exclusively in it.

label: Perfectus
summary: A Minor Social Status Virtue for one of the leaders of the Cathar heretics in southern France, sworn to preaching and ascetic abstinence.

label: Performance Artist
summary: An artist who performs art using a Profession Ability, such as jugglers, musicians, and minstrels, taking the Social Status Virtue Wanderer.

label: Performance Magic
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus conceal spellcasting by substituting the actions or words of a specified Ability for normal Hermetic gestures and words.

label: The Peripheral Code
summary: The accumulated body of Tribunal rulings that interpret and extend the Code of Hermes.

label: Perpetuity
summary: A Major Illusion Mystery of House Merinita granting three potentially-permanent spell durations (Might, Aura, Hidden); Merinitae usually gain the Unnatural Magic Flaw.

label: Persephone
summary: The queen of the Greek Underworld who, with Hades, was moved by Orpheus's song; the sirens felt guilt at failing to save her from Hades.

label: Persia
summary: The land of the Magians, original priestly caste, and home to most Mazdean communities, lying east of Mythic Europe.

label: Person
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: another person, such as a family member or maid, frequents the lab (-1 Safety, +1 Corpus or Mentem).

label: Persona
summary: A Supernatural Ability and deep-cover disguise technique allowing a magus to flawlessly alter his appearance and mannerisms to adopt a distinct identity; a subtle form of Muto Corpus magic.

label: Personal Power
summary: A Minor Supernatural Virtue giving the character an at-will supernatural power equivalent to a Formulaic Hermetic spell of level 25 or lower.

label: Personal Vis Source
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue granting exclusive access to a supply of raw vis yielding about one tenth of the player covenant's expected annual gathering.

label: Personality Flaw
summary: A category of Flaw reflected by an extreme Personality Trait that shapes how a character behaves.

label: Personality Trait
summary: Short descriptors of a character's personality with scores from -3 to +3 (e.g., Brave, Loyal), used as roleplaying guides and for some rolls.

label: Pessimistic
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character always expects the worst.

label: Peter Abelard
summary: A famous scholastic logician who taught at the cathedral school of St Geneviève in Paris; held two heretical theories condemned by Bernard of Clairvaux and exemplifies both good and bad Academic Reputation.

label: Peter des Roches
aliases: Peter des Roches, Bishop of Winchester
summary: The bishop of Winchester (since 1205) and member of the regency triumvirate, a wealthy French-born warrior-bishop and former tutor of the king, contemptuous of Magna Carta.

label: Peter Lombard
summary: A scholar who taught at pre-university Bologna and Paris and wrote the Sentences and biblical glosses, compared in a story seed to the works of a Hermetic writer.

label: Peter the Lombard
summary: Author of the Sententiae (Sentences), one of the authoritative sources for the Academic Ability Theology: Christian.

label: Peter von Wurzburg
summary: A master of House Verditius at Fengheld, a famed grower of grapes and maker of wine who cultivates special varieties into wine as Charged Items.

label: Petronilla of Leicester
summary: A woman recorded as having armed herself as a knight and fought in battles during the reign of Henry II; a namesake later haggled the right to choose her own husband. An example of absence-based female power.

label: Petrus Musandinus
summary: A great Salernitan master under whom Gilles de Corbeil trained in medicine.

label: Petrus of Verdun
summary: A tenth-century Primus of House Jerbiton who advocated magi living within mundane communities as wealthy citizens, abandoning multi-House covenants.

label: Pfalz Island
summary: An island in the center of the Rhine that formerly housed the covenant of Rheinstein (Magic aura 2), with a ruined castle, a dripstone-bearing rocky spine, and currently occupied by Lord Robert Schonburg.

label: Phaeton
summary: A young sun god of folklore who, in river myth, drowned in the Po after falling from the solar chariot, his body never recovered.

label: Phantasm of the Human Form
summary: A Creo Imaginem spell (Level 25) that makes an image of a clothed, equipped person that can move, speak, and behave as a human under the caster's unspoken command.

label: Phantasm of the Talking Head
summary: A Creo Imaginem spell (Level 10) that creates an illusory face on a wall or flat object that can speak during the spell's duration.

label: Phantasmal Animal
summary: A Creo Imaginem spell (Level 20) that creates an image of any animal up to pony size that moves under mental command and makes appropriate noises and smells, but has no effect on touch.

label: Phantasmal Fire
summary: A Creo Imaginem spell with an Ignem requisite that makes an image of a fire that dances, illuminates, crackles, and apparently warms but does not actually burn; popular at gatherings of House Flambeau.

label: Pharmaceutical Theriac
summary: An experimental-philosophy product forming part of the corpus of Medicine; a medicinal cure-all preparation, often a restorative, that some empirici sell genuinely and others fake.

label: Pharmocopoeians
summary: A tradition referenced as the model for the Taltos, focused on herbcraft and pharmacology.

label: Phessallia of Merinita
summary: An old, cold Merinita maga of Voluntas connected with the faeries of winter, skilled in Perdo, who possesses faerie items obtainable only as gifts.

label: Philip Augustus
summary: King of France for whom Gilles de Corbeil serves as archiater (chief physician).

label: Philip of France
summary: The king of France who expelled John from Normandy in 1204 and besieged Ghent; forced to abandon plans to invade England after William de Longespee's naval action at Damme.

label: Philip of Oldcoates
summary: The sheriff of Northumbria who holds Mitford castle and refuses to surrender it to Roger Bertram despite royal summons.

label: Philippus Niger
summary: An Archmage of Durenmar who uses the Holy Vehm to execute hedge magicians and at least one Marched magus, and promotes spread of the Vehmgerichte as a tool against hedge wizards.

label: Phillipus de Grevia
summary: The chancellor of Notre Dame at Paris, who holds power to confer degrees and excommunicate university members and uses these rights to dominate the masters.

label: Philosophiae
summary: A Hermetic Academic Ability measuring philosophical understanding, added to Verditius Lab Totals when carving Verditius runes and limiting Items of Quality bonuses.

label: Phimosis
summary: A Minor Choleric Disease afflicting promiscuous men, caused by excess lust, usually clearing on its own.

label: Phlegethi
summary: Fire elementals ('burners') that rarefy only from naturally occurring flame; short-lived, fast-moving creatures driven to burn and consume cold, that can beguile those who stare into their flames.

label: Phoenix
summary: A legendary bird whose ashes provide a powerful Shape and Material bonus (+11) to rejuvenation and regeneration enchantments.

label: Phthisis
summary: A Major Phlegmatic, epidemic Disease that pollutes the vital faculty with phlegm and spreads via putrid breath.

label: Phyllia
summary: A master maga of House Bjornaer, the Eagle Elder at Crintera with a polecat heartbeast; a widely-traveled Harmonist and notorious gossip.

label: Physician of Salerno
summary: A Minor General Virtue indicating attendance at the famed School of Salerno, granting a Reputation, unique medical procedures like anesthetics, and 50 experience points.

label: Physician's Eye
summary: An Intellego Corpus spell (Level 5) that determines the general health of a person, showing afflictions as yellow coloration on the body.

label: Physicus
summary: A term applied to anyone with advanced education in both medicine and natural philosophy, distinguishing educated medics from educated chirurgeons.

label: Physis
summary: In Tytalan philosophy, the abstract force of nature or self encompassing instincts, ambition, and competition, derived from a higher divine authority and thus permanent and unquestionable.

label: Piercing Gaze
summary: A Minor General Virtue letting a character unsettle people with an intent stare and gain +3 to intimidation rolls; faeries and demons are unaffected.

label: Piercing Shaft of Wood
summary: A Muto Herbam spell (Level 10) with a Rego requisite that turns a piece of wood into a barbed shaft that flies at a target and cannot miss but is resisted.

label: Piercing the Faerie Veil
summary: An Intellego Vim spell that lets the caster see through the boundaries of Faerie regiones and find the path to the next level.

label: Piercing the Magical Veil
summary: An Intellego Vim (InVi 20) spell that detects and analyzes magical power.

label: Pietro
summary: A magus of House Diedne of Oakdell covenant against whom Cirion of Tremere declared Wizard War in 1004 AD.

label: Pillars of Hercules
summary: Islands at the western edge of the known world near Granada, thought to contain uncontrolled gateways to Arcadia and the Magical realm.

label: Pilum of Fire
summary: An iconic attack spell hurling a javelin of flame; a signature of House Flambeau.

label: Pious
summary: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character is a fervent follower of his religion, avoiding what it prohibits and doing what it commands.

label: Pisa
summary: A north Italian city of famed merchants, favored by the Holy Roman Emperor, which acts as the port for landlocked Florence.

label: Pit of the Gaping Earth
summary: A Perdo Terram (PeTe 15) spell that opens a pit beneath a target's feet; no one can resist it, so it bypasses Magic Resistance, and it can also create defensive trenches.

label: Plague of Frogs
summary: A Rego Animal spell that spontaneously generates a swarm of up to thousands of frogs in a touched pool of water.

label: Plagued by a Demon
summary: A Story Flaw granted to a child chosen by the demon Bordelon as her personal tormentor.

label: Plagued by Angel
summary: A Story Flaw in which a character is troubled by the attention of an angel; held by the Priest companion and possible for Devil Children.

label: Plagued by Demon
summary: A Flaw involving demonic persecution that cannot be taken if the saga excludes demons.

label: Plagued by Supernatural Entity
summary: A Flaw representing a supernatural entity (often a spirit too powerful to defeat) that torments a character; a jinni variant afflicts sahirs.

label: Plain of Wolves
summary: A battlefield of the Schism War where the Tytali fought alongside Houses Tremere and Flambeau, referenced by the Tremere Primus Cercistum.

label: Plant's Withering Bane
summary: A Perdo Herbam spell (Level 20) that withers and destroys one living plant up to the size of a small tree.

label: Plato
summary: The philosopher whose advocacy of training women for all duties of the state, including warfare, underlies the Order of Hermes's position of equity for women.

label: Plentarch
summary: An ancient Mercurian high priest who gathered 38 Mercurians at Pompeii and taught them a ritual allowing them to commune with their gods in concert.

label: Pliny
summary: The Roman author cited as mentioning an ancient mariner who circumnavigated Africa and found the place where much of Europe's gold originates.

label: Pneumonia
summary: A Serious Phlegmatic Disease, an inflammation of the lungs caused by polluted air, prone to a Crisis on the seventh day.

label: Po
summary: A river in which the young sun god Phaeton is said to have drowned after falling from the solar chariot.

label: Południca
summary: A faerie (Might 10, Auram) appearing as a maiden, crone, or girl with a scythe who appears at noon on hot days, asking farmhands difficult questions and inflicting heatstroke if they fail to answer.

label: Poena
summary: The Prima of House Tremere at the domus magna Coeris in the Transylvanian Tribunal, said to know the names and strengths of every member of her House.

label: Poisoning the Will
summary: A ritual spell that curses a place such as a valley, town, city, or covenant, gradually sapping the will and vitality from the people there.

label: Polandrus
summary: A demon (Might 20, Animal) appearing as an extremely large jet-black wolf with red eyes who dominates wolves and targets livestock farmers, gradually coercing them into sin.

label: Political Agent
summary: A thematic covenfolk template skilled in Intrigue, Guile, and Order of Hermes Lore, employed by covenants involved in Hermetic politics.

label: Pollute Water
summary: An Aquam power of the basilisk Sordus that turns all standing water within 5 paces stagnant and putrefies other liquids; he cannot control it.

label: Pomerania
summary: A sparsely-populated realm of Slavic peoples between the Baltic Sea and Poland, bordering the Novgorod Tribunal; part of the Holy Roman Empire since 1181 and a region of contention with werewolves and the Knights of the Sword.

label: Pomeranian Forest
summary: One of Germany's most oppressive forests, dominated by pine, fir, holly, and evergreen oak; reputedly a stronghold of witches and werewolves and home to the sacred grove of Romowe.

label: Pomeranian tradition
summary: A surviving pre-Hermetic magical tradition with which some of Bjornaer's descendants seek détente, fearing their Founder left it before learning all its rites.

label: Pompeii
summary: The Roman city where the high priest Plentarch gathered 38 Mercurians to teach them the ritual of concerted communion with their gods.

label: Poor
summary: A Flaw representing less than average wealth for a trader; can be combined with Employed by a Company given troupe approval, and reduces a local carrier to a single pack animal's goods.

label: Poor (Characteristic)
summary: A Minor General Flaw lowering a Characteristic already at -3 or lower by one further point.

label: Poor Concentration
summary: A Minor General Flaw giving the character a -3 penalty to Concentration rolls due to a short attention span.

label: Poor Disputer
summary: A Minor General Flaw causing a character to suffer a -3 penalty on disputatio die rolls.

label: Poor Eyesight
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which bleary vision gives -3 to rolls involving sight, including attack and defense; can combine with Missing Eye.

label: Poor Formulaic Magic
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw subtracting 5 from every roll to cast Formulaic spells, though not Ritual spells.

label: Poor Hearing
summary: A Minor General Flaw subtracting 3 from rolls involving hearing and making hard-to-understand speech nearly impossible to follow.

label: Poor Living Conditions
summary: A Minor General Flaw giving an additional -1 Living Conditions Modifier, cumulative with the base modifier.

label: Poor Memory
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character has a very hard time recalling one type of thing such as names, faces, or places.

label: Poor Reader
summary: A common Flaw among the exsules, most of whom have studied from vis for their entire careers.

label: Poor Strength
summary: A Flaw possessed by Brother Julian reflecting weak physical strength.

label: Poor Student
summary: A Minor General Flaw subtracting 3 from Advancement Totals derived from teaching and books.

label: Poorly Insulated
summary: A Minor laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab is poorly shielded from the outside, easily overheard and a nuisance to neighbors (-1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

label: Pope
summary: The head of the Church, granted by the Divine a Magic Resistance of 25 (the highest among listed leaders) and an Aura of Rightful Authority, lost upon excommunication.

label: Pope Alexander III
summary: Pope who issued an 1179 decree, followed by most communities, requiring the expulsion of lepers.

label: Pope Gregory the Great
summary: A pope, later a saint, at whose earnest request God allowed the Roman Emperor Trajan to be saved after death, with a warning not to ask such things again.

label: Pope Gregory VII
summary: A church reformer who decreed in 1079 that all cathedrals must make schooling compulsory for priests.

label: Pope Honorius III
summary: The pope who banned civil law teaching at Paris, counseled Bologna's scholars to resist non-violently, and is petitioned over university licenses.

label: Pope Innocent III
summary: The pope who established Dominic's Order in 1216, sanctioned the Franciscans, recognized subdeacons as a major order, and was himself a university man.

label: Portunes, Spirit of Safe Harbor
summary: A Daimon spirit (Magic Might 25, Auram) charged with ports and harbors, keys and locks, worshipped as a god in Rome; summoned by throwing keys into a fire.

label: Posing the Silent Question
summary: An Intellego Mentem spell (Level 20) that lets the caster ask one silent mental question of a target and detect the answer, limited by the target's knowledge.

label: Possession
summary: A demonic power by which a demon places Might into a human host (an energumen), taking direct control of the victim and able to use powers through them.

label: Pot Plants
summary: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab contains dozens of potted plants (+1 Upkeep, +1 Aesthetics, +1 Herbam).

label: Potent Magic
summary: A Minor or Major Hermetic Virtue attuning magic to a narrow field, granting a Lab Total and Casting bonus and allowing design of Potent spells using Casting Items.

label: Potent Spells
summary: Spells that gain a Potency bonus to Casting Score derived from Casting Items combined into the spell's design.

label: Pound of Enumerus
summary: A Hermetic accounting concept named after the magus Enumerus: at least one pound of covenant spending each year that can never be fully accounted for.

label: Powerful Relic
summary: A Major General Virtue granting ownership of an unusually powerful relic with a True Faith score of 3 and one agreed power.

label: Powys
summary: An ancient Welsh principality in the central regions, centered on the fort of Mathrafal; home of Gwenwynwyn and the abbey of Strata Florida.

label: Praeco
summary: The presiding senior officer of a tribunal who calls magi forward, sets the order of business, and convenes tribunals; normally the oldest maga but in Stonehenge held by Talion of Blackthorn.

label: Praefactus of Bonisagus
summary: A magus of House Bonisagus whose wizard's sigil makes him appear as dignified as possible; his version of Seven-league Stride always lets him arrive in a safe place.

label: Prague
summary: Bohemia's principal settlement, straddling the River Vltava, with Prague Castle, the Basilicas of St. George and St. Vitus, and a large slave market controlled by the Knights of the Sword.

label: Pralix
summary: The founder of the Lineage and the Ordo Miscellanea who defeated Damhan-Allaidh, learned a Supernatural Ability from an ancient wizard, and integrated her order into the Order of Hermes.

label: Preaching
summary: A Profession-type Ability used to emotionally influence an audience or teach Theology; in 1220 almost exclusively practiced by Dominican friars.

label: Precarious
summary: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab sits in a supernaturally dangerous place such as inside a volcano (-1 Safety).

label: Precious Ingredients
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is supplied with more expensive ingredients than typical (+1 General Quality, +2 Upkeep, +1 Longevity Rituals).

label: Predecessor
summary: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab retains foibles of its notable previous owner (-1 Safety, +1 Warping, +1 Experimentation).

label: Predictive Stigmata
summary: A Minor Story Supernatural Flaw whose stigmata predict future challenges symbolically and may flee the body to become adulterations if ignored.

label: Prelum of Tremere
summary: Goliard's filia at Blackthorn, a polite young maga with a remarkable talent for Vim, contrasting with her sister Fornax.

label: Premonitions
summary: A supernatural Virtue granting forewarning of danger; Lord Robert Schonburg uses Premonitions to know when he is in trouble or about to be exposed.

label: Premonstratensians
summary: An order of regular canons relying on the Rule of St. Augustine.

label: Premysl
summary: A farmer found plowing with two oxen who became Libuse's husband and the founder of Bohemia's ruling Premyslid dynasty.

label: Preservative
summary: A Level 10 alchemical Reagent, a tarry substance that when painted onto wood proofs it against rot, mold, and pests, making about two gallons.

label: Preserved
summary: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab or its contents are immune to natural decay (-1 Upkeep, +1 Warping, +2 Health, +1 Aesthetics, +1 Creo).

label: Prestigious Student
summary: A Minor General Virtue for the son of a nobleman or prosperous merchant matriculated at a university with retainers, trained in Artes Liberales and Latin by a private tutor.

label: Pretense
summary: A faerie's skill in mimicking a particular human Ability through glamour; not quite the same as an Ability, a skilled observer may detect its use to reveal a faerie's nature.

label: Preternatural Growth and Shrinking
summary: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 15) that adds +1 to the target's Size or decreases it by up to 2 points.

label: Prevailing Discipline
summary: An optional measure, tracked like Prevailing Loyalty, of how disciplined a covenant's covenfolk are, modifying rolls related to their duties.

label: Prevailing Loyalty
summary: A game measure of how loyal a covenant's covenfolk are overall, derived from a Base Loyalty (driven by the magi's Gifts) modified by living conditions, treatment, and events.

label: Priam
summary: The elderly faerie lord of Ilium who claims descent from Zeus and granted the town its charter; his son Paris hosts a beauty contest at the mid-summer fair.

label: Priamitus
summary: Son of Mercere who sought out hedge wizards of the Cult of Mercury and worked to reconstruct the Roman cult, bringing the Mercurians into House Flambeau.

label: Priceless Ingredients
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is supplied with copious gold and gems (+2 General Quality, +4 Upkeep, +2 Longevity Rituals).

label: Priest
summary: A Social Status Virtue for a medical character in holy orders, usually attached to a monastic house; compatible with Magister in Medicina.

label: Prime Qualities
summary: Properties of a thing derived from its matter and essential form, including the elemental mixture of hot, cold, moisture and dryness, readily discerned with the senses.

label: Primitive Equipment
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character can use only the simplest tools and equipment, suffering penalties when forced to use anything beyond Inexpensive weapons and armor.

label: Primogeniture Lineage
summary: A Minor Story and Hermetic Flaw in which the character is in line for Primus of House Verditius, receiving undue attention and political enmity; only available to Verditius magi.

label: Primus
summary: The titular head of a House of the Order; in House Tytalus the Primus is merely the most skilled member rather than a true leader, holding the office because the Order expects it.

label: Primus Johannes
summary: A non-magus notary who unexpectedly claimed Criamon Primacy; his ghost is the House expert in Hermetic legal precedent and he secured the Privileges of Criamon.

label: Prince of Gwynedd
summary: A Welsh noble who has expressed interest in examining the seemingly immortal Gwrhyr; a court date has been set in the Fate of Cad Gadu story.

label: Principal
summary: A character (often a magus) who controls an agency of agents.

label: Principia Magica
summary: The authoritative summa on Magic Theory written by Bonisagus; the Great Library holds three copies.

label: Pripet Maior
summary: A New Slavonic Tribunal covenant settled in 1052 by Bjornaer magi formerly of Grand Silesia; allied with Crintera.

label: Pripet Major
summary: A covenant in the Novgorod Tribunal near the terminus of the one-way faerie trod from the Ziegensteine on Rugen.

label: Pripet Marshes
summary: A wilderness ancestor site in the Novgorod Tribunal, the supposed origin of all the Slavic people, protected by the covenant Pripet Maior.

label: Prison of Flames
summary: A Muto Ignem spell (Level 20) that turns a bonfire into a prison shaped like a miniature castle; a person inside is unburned but takes +15 damage trying to escape.

label: Privileged Upbringing
summary: A Minor General Virtue giving 50 extra experience points spendable on General, Academic, or Martial Abilities from a childhood with teachers and study time.

label: Privileges of Criamon
summary: A Grand Tribunal ruling that allows for House Criamon customs such as the ceremonial slaying of a willing Primus.

label: Probe for Pure Silver
summary: An Intellego Terram spell that lets the caster smell silver and follow the scent.

label: Probe Nature's Hidden Lore
summary: An Intellego Herbam spell (Level 4) that tells you what kind of plant you are touching and gives an image of it in its natural habitat.

label: Production Artist
summary: An artist who produces tangible artwork using a Craft Ability, akin to a craftsman, taking the Social Status Virtue Craftsman.

label: Profession
summary: A Craft-like Ability for an artist's trade; performance maestros use Communication + Profession Ability + Form when instilling effects.

label: Profession: Boating
summary: A Profession Ability for navigating rivers; needed (Ease Factor 9) to safely pass the treacherous Loreley stretch of the Rhine.

label: Profession: Chamberlain
summary: A Profession Ability used (with Presence) to compute the loyalty bonus contributed by a Chamberlain specialist.

label: Profession: Marshal
summary: A Profession Ability dealing with understanding, purchasing, and caring for horses, functioning like Medicine for veterinary treatment.

label: Profession: Master of Kennels
summary: A Profession Ability governing the care of dogs, treatment of their diseases, and acquisition and breeding of hounds.

label: Profession (Merchant)
summary: A Profession Ability in which traders and factors are skilled, eligible for Affinity, Cautious, Puissant, and other modifiers.

label: Profession: Minnesinger
summary: A Profession Ability for the German minstrel art; Wolfram von Eschenbach uses it to determine his songs' Aesthetic Quality.

label: Profession: Scribe
summary: A profession Ability; in one season a character can copy Profession: Scribe x 60 levels of Laboratory Texts that are already written understandably.

label: Profession: Steward
summary: A Profession Ability for managing a household or manor; held by the Spying Maid, Lord of the Manor, and Lady of the Manor, and used to calculate a Steward specialist's loyalty bonus.

label: Profession: Trouvère
summary: A Profession Ability for the northern French minstrel art; Brogo uses it to compose and perform songs with a high Aesthetic Quality.

label: Prognosis Total
summary: A medical total (Intelligence + Medicine + modifiers) compared against a disease's severity to determine whether a physician is skilled enough to plan therapy.

label: Prohibition
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character has had a Conditional Curse (Geas) cast upon him and must obey its restrictions or suffer the curse in full.

label: Prolific Artist
summary: A Minor Supernatural Virtue that reduces the time to create a piece of artwork by one quarter, but prevents the use of assistants.

label: Prone to Chance
summary: A Minor Ordeal Flaw making a Verditius magus keen on risk-taking, forcing experimentation on every applicable laboratory activity; incompatible with Averse to Risk.

label: Protagoras
summary: A Sophist quoted in the Analects of Tytalus who taught that humans are the yardstick for deciding what is real, and that there is no independent truth.

label: Protected Guest
summary: A covenant membership status extended to visitors by a single full member, affording basic rights but no vote or council obligation.

label: Protection
summary: A Minor General Virtue placing the character under the aegis of a powerful noble or Church official, granting a Reputation of level 3.

label: Protector
summary: An honorary Durenmar title for the magus responsible for the covenant's martial defense, traditionally a Flambeau; currently held by Philippus Niger.

label: Proud
summary: A Personality Flaw that automatically increases a Verditius magus's Hubris score (by 1 for Minor, 3 for Major); also gained as a Personality Trait by magi converted into the House.

label: Prudentum
summary: A Jerbiton magus and former leader of Oculus Septentrionalis who was slain in Wizard's War by Urgen of Bjornaer in 1179.

label: Prying Eyes
summary: An Intellego Imaginem spell that lets the caster see inside a room as long as they touch one of its walls, changing viewpoint within during the duration.

label: Psychodrama
summary: An allegorical story taking place in the mind of a meditating Criamon magus, amounting to spiritual combat against the self, used to dramatize introspective avenues.

label: Puissant Art
summary: A Virtue granting a bonus to an Art or Ability, applied in Hephaestion's Terram (Puissant Art) and Craft Metalsmith (Puissant Ability) Lab Total examples.

label: Puissant Artes Liberales
summary: A Virtue making a character particularly adept with all seven liberal arts; the Sons of the Peters receive an Infernally tainted version from demonic tempters.

label: Puissant Awareness
summary: A species Virtue of the Familiar Cat granting a bonus to the Awareness Ability.

label: Puissant Corpus
summary: The Minor Hermetic Virtue of the Damhadh-Duidsan tradition, granting bonus effective Corpus.

label: Puissant Craft
summary: A Virtue granting a bonus to a Craft Ability such as Painting or Baking, used by several covenfolk templates.

label: Puissant Craft or Profession Ability
summary: A Minor Virtue a maestro may select at no cost, granting a bonus to a Craft or Profession Ability such as Painting.

label: Puissant Enchanting Music
summary: A Virtue adding a bonus to the Enchanting Music Ability; held by the Minstrel template.

label: Puissant Enigmatic Wisdom
summary: A Hermetic Virtue gained as the first Fruit of the Path of Warping.

label: Puissant Finesse
summary: A recommended Virtue for the School of Vilano that boosts the magus's effective Finesse Ability for aiming indirect attacks.

label: Puissant Heartbeast
summary: A common Virtue for Bjornaer magi giving a bonus to the Heartbeast Ability.

label: Puissant Imaginem
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue boosting the Imaginem Art, available to Confraternity of Irene Initiates.

label: Puissant Intellego
summary: A Hermetic Virtue granting a bonus to the Intellego Technique; possessed by Tabanus.

label: Puissant Intrigue
summary: A Virtue granting a bonus to the Intrigue Ability, taken by the Political Agent template.

label: Puissant Medicine
summary: A Virtue that enhances a character's effective Medicine Ability score.

label: Puissant Mentem
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue boosting the Mentem Art, available to Confraternity of Irene Initiates.

label: Puissant Perdo
summary: A Virtue granting bonus effectiveness with an Art or Ability; House Flambeau offers a choice of Puissant Perdo or Puissant Ignem as its House Virtue.

label: Puissant Swordsmith
summary: A Virtue providing a bonus to the Swordsmith Craft Ability, held by the example craftsman Klaus.

label: Pukis, Dragon of the Hearth
summary: A lesser Daimon (Magic Might 10, Ignem) first summoned by Baltic wizards, taking the form of a small fire dragon that dwells in a hearth, leaving gifts but causing mischief if mistreated.

label: Pulch
summary: A magus of House Merinita who haunts the Kammerforst posing as a Waldgeist, chastising those who steal wood, and skirts close to the edge of Hermetic Law.

label: Pull of the Skybound Winds
summary: A Creo Auram spell (Level 30) that makes winds rise upward, pulling an object, creature, or person up to 50 feet into the sky before dropping it.

label: Pull of the Watery Grave
summary: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 35) that creates a strong undertow pulling objects smaller than a rowboat 25 fathoms into the depths.

label: Purgatory
summary: A realm beyond Mythic Europe; summoning a spirit residing there requires a Ritual spell.

label: Purification of the Festering Wound
summary: A Creo Corpus spell that provides a bonus to a wound Recovery roll, adding to any bonus from medical attention.

label: Purification of the Festering Wounds
summary: A Creo Corpus spell (Level 20) granting a +9 bonus to Recovery rolls if maintained throughout the recovery interval.

label: Push of the Gentle Wave
summary: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 15) that forms a low wave to propel a small boat slowly through the water.

label: Pyramids
summary: Monuments in Egypt near which magi established a covenant and a desert laboratory beside the great Sphinx.

label: Pyrenees
summary: The mountain range between France and Spain where Flambeau hid in a cave, founded Val-Negra, and where his lost talisman is thought to lie.

label: Quaertus of Bonisagus
summary: A magus of House Bonisagus credited as author of the encyclopedia De Ordinis Hermetici, covering the Code of Hermes and Order of Hermes Lore.

label: Quarter Days
summary: The four festival days marking the mid-points of the Hermetic stellar seasons, cited as good days for covenant meetings.

label: Quaternuli
summary: David of Dinant's confiscated book of 'little note-books'; a tractatus describing the Infernal Virtue Incantation with a Quality of 13.

label: Quedlinburg
summary: A Saxon town that was briefly the German capital under Henry the Fowler, later ruled by abbesses of a collegiate foundation; the lair of the Boglin lies near it.

label: Queen Isabella
summary: The king's mother and countess of Angoulême, wife of Hugh de Lusignan, threatening to withdraw her support unless she receives more aid.

label: Queen of Faerie
summary: A faerie ruler in the Maddenhofen Woods of Bohemia whom the Founder Tytalus entered to challenge, never to be seen again.

label: Queen of Snowflakes
summary: A powerful faerie, former lover of the Blackberry God, who controls the land above the tree-line and obstructs the Worshipful covenant's vis collection.

label: Queen of the Faeries
summary: A faerie ruler from whom Tytalus claimed he would win his "heart's desire" in the Maddenhofen Woods; rumors say Tytalus may one day win free from her and return.

label: Queen of Winter
summary: A powerful supernatural being who holds the Baltic Sea in ice each winter; she is propitiated by the ritual spell Appease the Queen of Winter and opposed by the sun-god Svantovit.

label: Quench the Raging Conflagration
summary: A PeIg 20 spell that extinguishes any fire up to the size of a house fire, learned by many Flambeau magi to control accidental Creo Ignem fires.

label: Quendalon
summary: A figure who at the beginning of the ninth century defeated the followers of Merinita and allegedly slew both Merinita and Myanar to claim leadership of the cult of Diana; he is said to hide in Arcadia and is the target of the Huntress's pagan messiah.

label: Quiet Magic
summary: A Virtue (also called Quiet Magic) that the Silent Ones league seeks to integrate into standard Hermetic practice for casting inconspicuously in cities.

label: Quiet the Cursing Tongue
summary: A ReVi spell of the Lineage of Pralix that prevents a target from using lower-level curse magic.

label: Quiet the Raging Winds
summary: A Perdo Auram spell (Level 20) that stops all wind from blowing on the caster, leaving only calm air.

label: Quinotaur
summary: A creature of Neptune that, in legend, seduced and impregnated Merovech's mother in the sea, giving Merovech two fathers and a magical bloodline.

label: Quinsy
summary: A Serious Phlegmatic Disease contracted from swallowing worms that live in and swell the tonsils.

label: Quintus
summary: A magus used as an example for writing books, with Ignem 24, Communication -1, and Language 5, who writes an Ignem summa.

label: Rübezahl
summary: A Waldgeist who haunts the forests of the Riesengebirge (Giant Mountains).

label: Rügen
summary: An island in the Eastern Marches that is home to the covenant of Crintera and a focus of the Crintera Schism; the spread of the Church there makes recruiting difficult.

label: Rabbi
summary: A Minor Social Status Virtue for an ordained Rabbi, teacher and wise man of the Jewish community, who must take the Educated (Hebrew) Virtue.

label: Rabbinic Law
summary: An Academic Ability, the Jewish version of Civil & Canon Law, drawn from the Talmud, the Oral Torah, and the Responsa of the Geonim.

label: Rabies
summary: A Serious Choleric Disease caused by the bite of a mad dog, inflaming the choler and reducing the sufferer's mind to that of a furious beast.

label: Radegast
summary: An archetypal Slavic god of chieftainship, war, fertility, and harvest worshipped at Rethra and Mount Radhost; in saga material revealed as a powerful demon controlling the Slavic lands and a willing source of vis through human sacrifice.

label: Rain of Oil
summary: A Muto Auram ritual (Level 50) that turns rain into droplets of flammable oil, drenching the landscape; can be ignited with Creo Ignem magic.

label: Rain of Stones
summary: A Muto Auram spell (Level 20) that turns falling rain into small stones causing minor damage; the stones revert to water when the spell expires.

label: Raised from the Dead
summary: A Major Story Supernatural Flaw in which the character died and was brought back through a holy miracle, beginning with at least three Warping points plus more over time.

label: Raised in the Gutter
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character was raised on the margins of society and suffers -3 when using social Abilities among her betters.

label: Ralph de Neville
summary: The vice-chancellor of England, a bastard son of a baronial family and royal clerk who does almost all the chancellor's work in the absence of the Great Seal.

label: Ramius
summary: A mid-rank House Tremere magus who defected to House Flambeau after the Sundering of Tremere in 848 AD; skilled in mundane arms, he created the School of Ramius and fought Moorish wizards in Iberia.

label: Ranulf de Blundeville
summary: Earl of Chester since 1180, an elder statesman of England and head of the palatinate of Cheshire, on Crusade in the Holy Land in 1220.

label: Rapid Convalescence
summary: A Minor General Virtue letting a character's body heal quickly, granting +3 on all rolls to recover from wounds.

label: Rarefication
summary: The magical process by which pure physical matter takes on pseudo-life and self-organizes into an elemental, catalyzed by spells, botches, or spontaneous Warping in a Magic aura.

label: Rat Up a Drainpipe
summary: A Minor General Virtue letting a character run through urban areas unobstructed using acrobatics, climbing, and dodging, aiding opposed Athletics rolls when chased.

label: Realia
summary: Collections of mundane or magical objects (preserved animals, minerals, gemstones, bones) that magi study as a tractatus and use as clues for Intellego magic.

label: The Divine Realm
summary: The realm of the one God, angels and the major monotheistic faiths; supreme over the other realms.

label: The Faerie Realm
summary: The realm of faeries: glamour, story and the power of belief and emotion.

label: The Infernal Realm
summary: The realm of demons and damnation, which corrupts and deceives.

label: Realm Interaction Table
summary: A rules table modifying how the prevailing Aura affects power recovery; Jumayl recovers Might per hour equal to the prevailing Aura as modified by it.

label: The Magic Realm
summary: The realm of magical power, source of the Arts, magical creatures and raw vis.

label: (Realm) Stigmatic
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character manifests physical phenomena and loses Fatigue when in a strong aura aligned to a chosen Realm of Power.

label: Realms of Power: Faerie
summary: An Ars Magica sourcebook whose character creation and advancement rules can handle faerie-realm legendary artists.

label: Realms of Power: Magic
summary: An Ars Magica sourcebook containing rules for training magical animals and for creating magic-realm characters such as legendary artists.

label: Realms of Power: The Infernal
summary: An Ars Magica sourcebook cited for rules on Infernal Ceremonies and infernalist abilities relevant to the False Power Flaw.

label: Rebellious
summary: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character reacts adversely to any attempt to impose authority and works against those in command.

label: Rebuttal
summary: A Mastered Spell special ability applicable to Muto or Rego Vim spells affecting another being's magic, adding three times Mastery score to the spell's effective level.

label: Reckless
summary: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character fails to notice threatening situations and charges right in.

label: Reclusive
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character dislikes being disturbed or interrupted and is reluctant to enter public places or group activities.

label: Recognize Your Master
summary: An InCo 5 enchanted effect in the Door of Deimos that checks whether a toucher matches an arcane connection and, if not, triggers the door's repelling effect.

label: Recollection of Memories Never Quite Lived
aliases: Recollection of Memories Never Quite Lived
summary: A Muto Mentem spell (Level 4) that changes the target's memory of a detail into a similar but different memory the target cannot distinguish from the authentic one.

label: Rector Maris
summary: A covenant founded on the Isle of Man in 866 and destroyed within six months.

label: Rector Novus
summary: A covenant founded on the Isle of Man in 938 and destroyed within a year.

label: Rector/Proctor
summary: A Major Story Flaw in which the character is the representative leader of his faculty or nation at a university and is responsible for his colleagues' behavior.

label: Red-Hame
summary: A faerie wolf with Faerie Might 12 and a ruddy neck and back; the messenger of the Winter Court who accompanies Torven and conveys the court's wishes to Waldheim.

label: Refinement
summary: A laboratory Characteristic representing its sophistication; together with Size it sets the space for Virtues, and is improved through seasons of work requiring Magic Theory.

label: Reforging Enchanted Items
summary: A Minor House Mystery of Verditius allowing a magus to repair, smelt, and reforge enchanted items to enhance their magical potential or extract vis.

label: Reforging Items
summary: A Minor House Inner Mystery of Verditius for re-forging or repairing items, part of the Confraternity of Roland's mystery path.

label: Refrigerant Salt
summary: A Level 10 Alteration Reagent whose salt-like crystals freeze water when scattered on its surface, creating a sheet of ice up to six paces in diameter.

label: Regimen
summary: A tailor-made recipe of diet, exercise and bloodletting prescribed by a physician to control the non-naturals and ensure eucrasia, providing a Living Conditions bonus.

label: Regin
summary: An evil-hearted dwarf who coveted the magic ring of the Nibelungs and under whom Wayland apprenticed; played a part in the life of Siegfried.

label: Reginald
summary: A wandering minstrel who plays a rebec of exceptional quality inherited from his minstrel father; his playing causes Imaginem vis to accumulate in the instrument's bowstrings.

label: Reginald's Rebec
summary: A three-stringed fiddle of exceptional quality played by the minstrel Reginald; it grants a +3 bonus to Music rolls and accumulates Imaginem vis in its horsehair bowstrings when played well.

label: Rego
summary: Technique meaning 'I control'. Directs or controls a target according to its own nature.

label: Rego Mentem
summary: A Hermetic Technique-and-Form combination (Control Mind) used to make disloyal covenfolk loyal or to compel obedience regardless of emotion.

label: Rego Vim
summary: A Hermetic combination governing control of magic; Rego Vim spells and wards can dampen a legendary artist's powers and bar him from areas.

label: Regular
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character lives according to a strict religious rule and must spend one free season on worship; suitable for monks and canons.

label: Reismann Ex Miscellanea
summary: The probable founder of the Rusticani tradition, a hedge wizard who swore the Oath at the Rhine Tribunal of 963 and wrote a summa on Craft Masonry.

label: Relic
summary: Physical objects housing part of the power of the Divine, often parts of saints' bodies; they grant Faith Points, Divine Might, Magic Resistance, and an aura hostile to Infernal creatures.

label: Relics of the Three Magi
aliases: relics of the three wise men
summary: A fabulous golden casket in Cologne's cathedral containing the bones of the three wise men who visited the infant Jesus, taken from Milan by Frederick Barbarossa in 1164.

label: Religious
summary: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a monk, nun, beguine, anchoress, anchorite, holy hermit, or similar religious figure.

label: Relisius
summary: A contemporary House Bonisagus magus well known for his Christian faith and advocacy of harmony between Magic and the Divine.

label: Relocation
summary: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab's physical-world location can be magically adjusted, e.g. via a powerful Rego Terram effect.

label: Remi of Museau
summary: A friendly, effusive 48-year-old Master magus of House Jerbiton at Triamore, a veritable polymath accomplished in mundane tasks and magic alike.

label: Remora of Virtue
summary: A symbolic fish whose fins provide a Shape and Material bonus of +7 to slowing or halting a moving object.

label: Removal of the Conspicuous Sigil
summary: A Perdo Imaginem spell (Level 20) that obscures grooves, runes, and writings so they are not visible while the overall shape of the medium remains, e.g. hiding runes on a sword blade.

label: Reorder the Contents of the Armarius
aliases: Reorder the Contents of the Armarius
summary: A Rego Animal 10 spell with Intellego requisite that sorts books in a chest or closet into a chosen sequence; an optional Mentem requisite raises it to level 15 for emotional or read-status sorting.

label: Repair Cracks and Tears
summary: A Creo Animal 20 ritual that heals cracks and tears in the parchment and leather of a book, used for historically significant works like Bonisagus's diaries.

label: Repel the Intruder
summary: A CrMe 15 enchanted effect in the Door of Deimos that forces anyone who fails an Intelligence roll to flee in terror; has a high Penetration Total.

label: Repel the Wooden Shafts
summary: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 10) that deflects a single blow of any wooden weapon up to the size of a two-handed club, making the attack automatically miss.

label: Repellent
summary: A Major General Tainted Flaw in which the character has a physical characteristic of his demonic creator, causing -6 to rolls requiring trust but granting a minor advantage.

label: Replenishing the Fount of the Magus
aliases: Replenishing the Fount of the Magus
summary: A CrCo 30 spell created by Terious of Flambeau allowing a magus on the Path of Energy to restore lost Fatigue levels from the forest; recorded in the Great Library but never successfully cast.

label: Repose
summary: House Criamon's alternative to death, a paradisaical state of blessedness reached at the end of each path of Initiation, often delayed by magi out of compassion.

label: Reputation
summary: A game trait representing how a character is known in society; deep cover disguises establish a Reputation that grows like an Ability and offsets the social penalty of The Gift.

label: Requisite
summary: An additional Art required to cast certain spells, demanding greater knowledge of the caster and limiting the Arts usable; includes casting requisites.

label: Reserves of Strength
summary: A Minor General Virtue letting a character once per day add +3 to effective Strength for an action, requiring two Fatigue rolls afterward.

label: Resonance
summary: The sympathetic link between a Hermetic book's construction materials and its subject; resonant materials add quality points to a book studied by magi.

label: Restless Dead
summary: Corporeal dead rising from graves and ghostly visitations that terrorize Mythic Europe; the Donatores combat or quiet them, distinguishing Infernal from Magic or Faerie origins.

label: Restoration of the Defiled Body
summary: A Corpus spell that can remove any Flaws resulting from a disease, with a higher guideline needed to negate Flaws caused by life-saving surgery.

label: Restore the Faded Threads
summary: A Creo Vim spell that temporarily restores faded spell traces to a fresh state so they can be examined.

label: Restore the Moved Image
summary: A Rego Imaginem (General) spell that cancels a Rego Imaginem spell which moved an image, putting the image back where it belongs if the caster matches the spell's level.

label: Restricted Learning
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character can only apply experience points to five chosen Abilities and cannot learn new Abilities without Teaching or Training; required of all mundane animals.

label: Restricted Power
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw limiting the use of a normally at-will supernatural power, requiring a ceremony or restricting it to certain targets or circumstances.

label: Restriction
summary: A Flaw preventing magic under a circumstance (e.g., at sea, or in bright light as suffered by Ulf); imposed as a Great Beast Ordeal and a common Bjornaer flaw.

label: Restriction (True Feeling)
summary: A Major Hermetic Flaw of the Cult of Orpheus.

label: Retetarius Bjornaer
summary: Deputy chief of Clan Wilkis appointed by the prima, with a salmon heartbeast, dwelling in the River Danube.

label: Rethra
summary: A former great Slavic pagan fortress-temple housing the Oracle of the god Radegast; once a covenant of Slavic magi-priests, it was abolished by the Tribunal in 1207 and retains a Faerie aura of 4 (secretly Infernal).

label: Reveal the Hidden Words
summary: A MuAq 5 charged-item effect that makes any group of words written in the enchanted colorless liquid visible for a Diameter duration.

label: Reveal the Lurking Watchers
summary: An InVi 30 spell that allows the caster to see creatures of the Magic realm within his field of view and identify them as possessing Magic Might.

label: Reveal the Magical Deception
summary: A new Intellego Vim spell (InVi 25) invented for Tabanus, designed to overcome spells that hide traces of magic such as Masking the Odor of Magic.

label: Revealed Flaws of Mortal Flesh
summary: An Intellego Corpus spell (Level 10) that finds any medical defects in a person or being touched, more specific than Physician's Eye.

label: Revealed Flaws of the Mortal Flesh
aliases: Revealed Flaws of the Mortal Flesh
summary: A spell that instantly diagnoses a disease's cause and effect and adds +3 to the Prognosis total if the character designs the follow-up treatment.

label: Revenant
summary: A restless dead being whose only form is an animate material corpse, animated by a spirit and connected to the living world through an overwhelming personal need; difficult to harm with weapons and immune to Incapacitation.

label: Revenge of the Bitten Toad
summary: A PeAn 20 Flavor-Target spell inflicting a Heavy Wound on any creature that bites or tastes the caster.

label: Rewriting the Mind
summary: A Muto Mentem Ritual that utterly changes the target's cognitive goals, hopes and desires to an agenda dictated by the magus.

label: Rheinstein
summary: A former covenant founded 1123 AD on the island of Pfalz in the Rhine Gorge; attacked and destroyed in 1200 AD by an army of irate mundanes led by the archbishop of Trier.

label: Rhiannon
summary: A timid maga named Prima of House Merinita at the Grand Tribunal of 997, four generations descended from Quendalon; she defended House Diedne during the Schism War and died of old age.

label: Rhine League
summary: An alliance founded by Mainz and Worms (and joined by cities, archbishops, and nobles) to suppress unjust tolls by trade sanctions and destruction of robber-baron castles along the Rhine.

label: Rhine Lore
summary: An Area Lore Ability covering the Rhine region; held by several characters including Lord Robert, Wolkan, and David ben David.

label: Rhine-Main-Danube Canal
summary: A proposed canal connecting the Main (a Rhine tributary) and the Danube to create a trade corridor across the continent, around which a saga could be designed.

label: Rhinegold
summary: The lost treasure of the Nibelungs, possibly located at the Rhinefalls and jealously guarded by the powerful Rhine elemental in revenge for his entrapment.

label: Rhonabwy
summary: A warrior of Powys who, sleeping on an ox-skin in a foul hall, dreamed of being taken by Iddawg to King Arthur's court where ravens battled Arthur's men.

label: Rhone
summary: A river that ends at the wild, inhospitable Camargue Delta where a ghostly horse keeps a larder of wicked children.

label: Ricardus Caespuus
summary: A reclusive Follower of Bonisagus at Durenmar with a glass-walled laboratory specialized in Herbam, who cultivates many types of vis from exotic plants.

label: Richard de Marsh
summary: The Bishop of Durham (elected 1217), chancellor and creature of King John, greedy and unscrupulous, embroiled in a quarrel with the monks of his cathedral priory.

label: Richard Rufus the Deacon
summary: A learned theologian scholar at Schola Pythagoranis who writes tracts justifying the use of magic for virtuous ends, risking trouble with church authorities.

label: Richard the Lionheart
summary: King of England who spent most of his reign on Crusade and at war in France, repeatedly demanding money from England; died of an infected arrow wound in 1199.

label: Richenda Spinosa
summary: An atypical journeyman maga of House Flambeau at Irencillia of secret faerie heritage descended from Kupala; her scarred Gift left her unable to use fire magic, so she turned to Herbam thorn magic and seeks vengeance on her master Indulius.

label: Ride
summary: An Ability used when employing an animal as a mount, which can substitute for Animal Handling and adds to Attack and Defense in mounted combat.

label: Rigid Magic
summary: A Major Hermetic Flaw in which the character cannot use vis when casting spells, thus cannot boost spell rolls or cast Ritual magic, though vis can be used in the laboratory.

label: Ring/Circle Magic
summary: The Minor Hermetic Virtue of the Columbae, letting them draw circles faster and treat any well-defined boundary as a Circle by marking it.

label: Ring of Warding Against Spirits
summary: A Rego Mentem spell creating a ring that only ghosts and spirits with Magic Might higher than the spell's level can enter.

label: Rings of Verditius
summary: Five magic rings, one for each finger and thumb, that Verditius forged from all he had learned, perhaps the most powerful magic rings in Hermetic history.

label: Ripper
summary: A Minor Supernatural Virtue with two inflexible powers: destroying cloth or disemboweling an animal at Sight range without words or gestures.

label: Rise of the Feathery Body
summary: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 10) that allows the target to float vertically to any height carrying up to 50 pounds, but not move horizontally.

label: Rising Ire
summary: A Creo Mentem spell (Level 15) that makes the target furious at someone or something of the caster's choice; an appropriate Personality Trait roll can hold the anger in check.

label: Rising Passion
summary: A Creo Mentem 15 spell invented by Imanitos Mendax that raises uncontrollable carnal lust in a target.

label: Ritual Magic
summary: A type of elaborate spell that always requires botch dice (unless mastered) and whose effects cannot be placed in enchantments unless they are Ritual only due to level over 50.

label: Ritual of Twelve Years
summary: A House Bjornaer rite of passage after which a magus gains the Heartbeast Ability; experiencing it early in apprenticeship can grant Self-Confident or the Uswaurpa reputation.

label: Ritual Power
summary: A Major Supernatural Virtue giving an at-will supernatural power equivalent to a Ritual Hermetic spell of level 25 or lower, costing Fatigue and Confidence.

label: Robert de Courtenay
summary: Sheriff of Devon who refused to surrender the shrievalty to Falkes de Bréauté, claiming he should have had the wardship of the heir.

label: Robert Grosseteste
summary: A brilliant scholar and official of the bishop of Hereford, born 1170, who is an unGifted natural magician acquainted with the magi of Schola Pythagoranis though he declined to join.

label: Robert Wood
summary: An outlaw of Yorkshire in the late 1100s, presumed a rustic-magic hedge wizard and exceptional archer/bowyer/fletcher with magic in his craft, registered as a vis source by Voluntas covenant.

label: Robes of Dusty Dawn
summary: Enchanted lavender-rose robes covered in chalk markings that protect against natural and supernatural threats; the symbol of the Primus Ex Miscellanea, given to Pralix by the Columbae.

label: Robin Hood
summary: Cited as a legendary example of crime income, operating with demonic assistance.

label: Rock of Viscid Clay
summary: A Muto Terram spell that softens rock so it can be dug out, molded, and manipulated like hard river clay.

label: Roland
summary: A great Frankish knight, one of Charlemagne's 12 peers, slain at the Battle of Roncesvals in 778, who wielded the magic sword Durendal forged by Wayland with Verditius as apprentice.

label: Rolling Stone
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character has moved so often that she finds it hard to form community attachments, giving -1 to social rolls within a community.

label: Rollright Stones
summary: A thirty-meter stone circle of twenty-five stones in Oxfordshire, said to be a petrified army and its king; includes the King Stone whose chips ward against demons, watched over by a witch in the form of an elder tree.

label: Roma Nova
summary: A covenant of traditionalist Latin magi founded in Kent in 946, unpopular with Bjornaer, Díedne, and Ex Miscellanea; destroyed by the Díedne in 1008.

label: Roman Emperor Trajan
summary: A Roman emperor whom God allowed to be saved after death at the request of Pope Gregory the Great.

label: Romer
summary: A young giant of Romerstein castle who fell in love with and secretly married Ruma, daughter of the dwarf king.

label: Romowe Oak
summary: A surviving magical forest spirit of Pomerania in the Eastern Marches; it is likely to possess seekers who attempt communion with it.

label: Room of Stale Air
summary: A Perdo Auram spell (Level 15) that makes the air in a room stuffy and uncomfortable, penalizing physical exertion of breathing creatures.

label: Roots of the Arts
summary: Basic summae texts for nine of the Arts, accepted as the preferred primers for a magus seeking competence to train an apprentice, widely and cheaply available.

label: Rope of Bronze
summary: A Muto Herbam spell (Level 15) with a Terram requisite that turns a piece of plant-fiber rope into superior bronze that does not break under normal circumstances.

label: Rosalba
summary: Covenant founded by Flavia of Jerbiton in 820 in the Yorkshire Dales; destroyed in 899 when all its magi were killed in a Wizards' War with Blackthorn.

label: Roscius
summary: Filius of Verditius who stole the sword Durendal and took it to Verdi; by studying it he and his filii became famous makers of magical swords, founding the Confraternity of Roland.

label: Rose of Jerbiton
summary: A magus of House Jerbiton credited with a version of Flash of the Scarlet Flames that leaves a faint odor of roses where the flash explodes.

label: Rosh Beth Din
summary: A Major Social Status Virtue for the head who presides at the Beth Din rabbinic court, requiring high Hebrew, Rabbinic Law, and Theology: Judaism.

label: Rosmert
summary: Handri's faerie caricature, the imperious-looking Queen of Irencillia's fae and monarch of the Faerie Court.

label: Rostock
summary: An expanding Baltic trading town and port, chief town of the Mecklenburg dynasty of Sorbian princes, overshadowed by neighboring Lubeck.

label: Rottweil
summary: A town of Roman origin (Arae Flaviae) on the eastern edge of the Black Forest, overlooking the upper River Neckar, where butchers trained Rottweilers to pull carts.

label: Roughting Linn
summary: A rock face in Northumberland carved with over sixty cup-and-ring markings, thought to be maps or faerie memorials and possibly carved by Gerfallon of Semitae.

label: Round Table
summary: The Arthurian Round Table that rises from a bog each midsummer near Tintagel, which a king might seek to seize.

label: Rowan Gild
summary: A secretive Rhine political gild formed by Diedne magi who split from the Hawthorn Gild, later joined by Waldherz Bonisagus; its members were exiled and largely destroyed in the Schism War.

label: Royal Prise
summary: A special low price that royalty expects when buying at fairs, effectively a tax on the seller; King Henry III's Westminster fair promised to drop these prises.

label: Roznov
summary: An Autumn covenant in eastern Moravia combining two traditions: a pagan priesthood of Radegast (House Ex Miscellanea at Roznov Castle) and an archconservative House Tremere stronghold (at Roznov Fort).

label: Roznov Castle
summary: The castle housing the Rhine covenant of Roznov on the side of Mount Radhost, with Igor Rastvan's great-hall laboratory at one end.

label: Ruach
summary: A minor demon in spiritual form that attends a Demonic Blooded character, using its Misfortune Power to blight her enemies and reporting to her demon parent.

label: Rudesheim
summary: A Rhine town on the right bank opposite Bingen, site of the ruined covenant of Rudiaria and the Bromserburg castle; named after the covenant or archbishop Rudbrecht.

label: Rudiaria
