summary: A former covenant affiliated to House Flambeau, founded 892 AD on the right bank of the Rhine opposite Bingen; charged with diabolism and destroyed in 969 AD by an apparent catastrophic magical accident.

label: Rudolph of Bonisagus
summary: A magus of House Bonisagus and the brainchild behind plans to establish a Fengheld chapter at Durenmar.

label: Ruma
summary: Daughter of the dwarf king and a mermaid, able to transform into a stream of water; she surfaced to create the Rumaquelle while searching for her husband Romer.

label: Running Water Weakness
summary: A demonic weakness preventing the demon from crossing running fresh water deriving directly from the earth.

label: Rus
summary: One of the three legendary founding brothers of the Slavic peoples, who settled at the River Dnieper with his tribe, the Russians.

label: Rusted Decay of Ten-Score Years
summary: A Perdo Terram spell that thoroughly rusts the metal of the target so it breaks under any demanding use and loses its sharpness.

label: Sabina of the Seine
summary: A relatively young maga who leads the Viticulturalists league and keeps its collection of casting tablets for agricultural rituals.

label: Sachiko of Merinita
summary: A probably-female Merinita magus of Burnham whose sigil appears at tribunals but who is otherwise unknown to the tribunal.

label: Sacrifices
summary: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: animal sacrifices are needed for the lab to function (+2 Upkeep, -1 Safety, +1 Warping, -1 Health, -3 Aesthetics).

label: Sagitar of Tremere
summary: A Tremere magus who falsely claimed the Criamon Primacy, discovering it was voluntary mystical slavery; his contrite ghost haunts the Cave of Twisting Shadows.

label: Sahir
summary: A type of non-Hermetic wizard of the Mythic Middle East; an Infernally-aligned sahir bound the Buran of Yenghissar within his ancestral sword using the Goetic Art of Binding.

label: Sailor's Foretaste of the Morrow
summary: An Intellego Auram spell (Level 15) that tells the caster precisely tomorrow's weather and gives a general impression of the week ahead at the casting location.

label: Saint Andrew
summary: A saint whose relics were stolen from Constantinople by the bishop of Amalfi in 1210, prompting Andru's personal grudge.

label: Saint Anthony's Fire
summary: A Minor Sanguine Disease from possession by a minor demon in the intestines; cured by exorcism.

label: Saint Barbara
summary: A patron saint of French masons, whose feast day is December 4.

label: Saint Bartholomew
summary: The patron saint of tanners, whose feast day is August 24.

label: Saint Crispin
summary: One of the patron saints of shoemakers, a third-century Roman preacher who made shoes; feast day October 25.

label: Saint Crispinian
summary: One of the patron saints of shoemakers, a third-century Roman preacher who made shoes; feast day October 25.

label: Saint Denis's Lendit Fair
summary: A fair near Paris founded by King Dagobert in the seventh century for the benefit of the Abbey of St. Denis; once the most important fair in France until the Champagne cycle took over.

label: Saint Dominic
summary: Founder of the Order of Preachers (Dominicans), a trained scholastic from the cathedral school of Palencia preaching against heresy in Lombardy; historically dies 6 August 1221.

label: Saint Dunstan
summary: The patron saint of blacksmiths, whose feast day is May 19.

label: Saint Eligius
summary: The patron saint of armorers, whose feast day is December 1.

label: Saint Elisabeth
summary: Daughter of the king of Hungary and wife of the landgrave Louis IV of Thuringia, who devotes her life to the needy; subject of the miracle of roses and later canonized as patron of Marburg's poor.

label: Saint Elizabeth of Hungary
summary: A saint to be adopted as patron of bakers, who will die in 1231 and be canonized four years later; feast day November 17.

label: Saint Francis
summary: Founder of the Franciscan Order, living near Assisi and growing his newly formed mendicant order.

label: Saint Gertrude of Nivelles
summary: The patroness of the recently dead who appeared in visions to many (often unGifted) Donatores, with souls in her care for their first night after death.

label: Saint Godric
summary: A historical peddler, merchant, pirate, hermit, and saint of northeastern England who settled at Finchale near Durham; renowned for austerity, hymns, and prophecy, he died in 1170 at age 105.

label: Saint Homobonus
summary: The recently canonized patron saint of clothiers, a tailor from Cremona who gave free clothes to the poor; his feast day is November 13.

label: Saint Honoratus of Arles
summary: The patron saint of bakers, whose feast day is January 16.

label: Saint Luke
summary: One of the patron saints of glassmakers, whose feast day is October 18.

label: Saint Marina the Monk
summary: A medieval saint, used as a character-concept example, who lived disguised as a monk, accepted false blame for a pregnancy, and was revealed to be a woman only after death.

label: Saint Mark
summary: One of the patron saints of glassmakers, whose feast day is April 25.

label: Saint Nicholas
summary: A saint venerated in northwestern Mythic Europe for miraculously resuscitating three children murdered and pickled by an innkeeper; the planned Kolding church is dedicated to him.

label: Saint Odilo
summary: The Abbot at Cluny who created the Feast of All Soul's Day and promoted the Truce of God; patron saint of souls in Purgatory who appeared to Donatores in holy orders.

label: Saint Paul
summary: An apostle cited regarding slavery, counseling slaves to obey their masters while requiring masters not to abuse them.

label: Saint Stephen
summary: The first Christian martyr and patron saint of masons, whose feast day is December 26.

label: Saladin
summary: The conqueror to whom Jerusalem fell in 1187, during which Margaret of Beverley helped defend the city.

label: Salamander
summary: A fire-dwelling creature whose skin provides a Shape and Material bonus of +8 to extinguishing fire.

label: Salerno
summary: A southern center of medical learning whose school accepts female students and is the source of secret Theriacs such as the Cataplasm of Mandrake and Soporific Sponge.

label: Salgfräulein
summary: A wood-wife who dresses in white and sits under old larch trees, singing.

label: Salmo
summary: A descendent of Ilfetu who became primus after the Schism War and refocused House Bjornaer toward a more traditional Hermetic mould.

label: Samuel ibn Tibbon
summary: The translator who rendered Maimonides' Guide for the Perplexed from Arabic into Hebrew.

label: Sanctum
summary: An area, usually a magus's laboratory and living quarters, designated under Hermetic law; by a ruling of the Grand Tribunal of 997 it must be marked by a circle inscribed in a square with diagonals.

label: Sanguine Humor's Blessing
summary: A Major General Virtue granting bonuses to rolls based on a character's True Feeling Story Flaw, drawing on emotional bonds; the defining Virtue of Orphic magoi.

label: Sap the Griffin's Strength
summary: A general Perdo Vim spell invented by Philippus Niger, like Demon's Eternal Oblivion but working on creatures with Magic Might.

label: Sardinia
summary: The Mediterranean island, dotted with nuraghi and magic auras, where Hephaestus built his famous forge and House Verditius's domus magna Verdi stands.

label: Satan
summary: The tempter who led Adam and Eve to sin in the Garden of Eden, bringing about Original Sin; the devil to whom an evil lord might sell his soul for infernal powers.

label: Savantism
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is simpleminded with halved experience but exceptionally gifted in one favored Ability with a +3 specialization bonus.

label: Saxony
summary: A large and important duchy of fertile lowlands and cities in the Rhine Tribunal, ancestral home of the Welf family and rival to the Hohenstaufens.

label: Scales of the Magical Weight
summary: An Intellego Vim spell used to weigh an unknown amount of vis against a known amount to determine the number of pawns present.

label: Scarf of Healing
summary: A wondrous scarf that copies the effects of the spell Bind Wound (Craft Level 14).

label: Scattering Like Light
summary: A MuTe(Im) Level 30 spell that changes metal in an object into iconic species carried off by passing light, disintegrating objects; originally created for metal plating.

label: Scent of Peaceful Slumber
summary: A spell that makes everyone in a room fall asleep over a few seconds, with the smell of lilacs in their nostrils.

label: Scent of the Predator
summary: A CrMe 20 Scent-Target spell that fills anyone smelling the caster with a sensation of menace, cowing or intimidating targets.

label: Schöne Lau
summary: A beautiful reclusive water faerie of Blautopf Pool with webbed feet and powers of divination, banished there by her faerie-king husband because she could not laugh; she foretells visitors' futures.

label: Schadrit
summary: The ancient maga of Ex Miscellanea who leads Dankmar with malice; a former Bonisagus apprentice cast out with her mistress Aschlaranda, she is an expert in Faerie Magic.

label: Schism War
summary: A Hermetic war (also called the Sundering/Domination) during which a pagan-filled House was annihilated and a tyrannical House (Tremere) was shattered; House Jerbiton withdrew and later aided reconstruction.

label: Schleswig
summary: A Holstein town by the fjord of the River Schlei, grown next to a Benedictine cloister of St. Johannis near the ruins of the old Viking city of Haithabu.

label: Schola Pythagoranis
summary: A Hermetic covenant sited on the edge of Cambridge whose magi disguise themselves as a scholarly organization; it invited fleeing Oxford masters to Cambridge and was visited by Robert Grosseteste.

label: Scholastus
summary: A magus of House Jerbiton, the sole surviving member of Treverorum, who announced his covenant's abolition in 1172 AD and departed for the Greater Alps, held liable for its unpaid fine.

label: Scholomance
summary: A covenant in the Transylvanian Tribunal that is a school for future apprentices, agents, and companions, set in an intermittently accessible regio and reputed to be a school for sorcerers run by the devil.

label: School of Apromor
summary: A versatile school of magical combat within House Flambeau built on the Technique of Perdo, emphasizing destruction, indirect attacks, and multiple Forms; one of the most study-intensive schools.

label: School of Boreas
summary: A narrowly defined Flambeau combat school relying on the single Perdo Ignem combination, using cold and darkness; developed by the magus Boreas to bridge the Flambeau and Apromor lineages.

label: School of Chartres
summary: A medieval cathedral school whose writers (Thierry the Breton, William of Conches, Bernard Silvestris) produced foundational works on cosmology and natural philosophy still taught in Mythic Europe's universities.

label: School of Ebroin
summary: A minor combat school within the Schools of Sebastian family, based on conjuring animals.

label: School of Marosa
summary: A minor combat school within the Schools of Sebastian family, based on Herbam attacks.

label: School of Ramius
summary: A Flambeau combat school that ignores Magic Resistance by using mundane physical attacks supported by magical enhancements, emphasizing defense and Parma Magica; created by Ramius.

label: School of St Geneviève
summary: A cathedral school in Paris where the scholastic luminary Peter Abelard taught.

label: School of the Founder
summary: A Flambeau combat school based on the magic of Flambeau himself, broader than Boreas and favoring the Form of Ignem, requiring penetration of Magic Resistance.

label: School of Vilano
summary: The most commonly used Flambeau combat school in the Order, relying on indirect attacks that bypass Magic Resistance; created by the magus Vilano and requiring no specific Arts.

label: Schooled in Crime
summary: A Minor General Virtue granting 50 extra experience to spend on Abilities related to thievery such as Stealth, Legerdemain, and Guile.

label: Schools of Magical Combat
summary: Informal styles of fighting magic recognized within House Flambeau, each named after the pioneering magus who invented it, used to classify combative approaches.

label: Schools of Sebastian
summary: A catch-all family of minor Flambeau combat schools that conjure harmful objects or substances using Forms other than Ignem; named for the hedge-wizard magus Sebastian.

label: Schwall
summary: An eccentric elderly Bjornaer magus and Wilderist of the Hawthorn Gild, formerly of Rheinstein, living at the Rhinefalls; he plots to release the Rhine elemental and merge with its spirit.

label: Schwarzburg
summary: A Rhine covenant in the Swabian Jura (857-885) that warred with neighboring Arae Flaviae, causing the Tribunal to abolish both covenants.

label: Scilly Isles
summary: Islands southwest of Land's End said to be the last sinking remnants of the drowned land of Lyonesse, settled by those who fled to the high ground.

label: Scinnfolk
summary: Gifted Companions in the Order, herb-wives and faerie doctors with eclectic natural magic and faerie charms passed down orally; not a true systematic tradition.

label: Scintilla of Flambeau
summary: A Flambeau maga who came to Burnham from eastern Europe, rumored to be a powerful fire maga but has done nothing noteworthy in Stonehenge.

label: Scitalis
summary: A large slow-moving Magical serpent (Might 5, Animal) with spectacularly colored scales that can stupefy onlookers with its Dazzling Appearance and whose fangs drip venom; its hot blood keeps it active in winter.

label: Scribes' Guild
summary: The guild responsible for producing parchment for books, referenced in the seasonal production chart.

label: Scrofula
summary: A Serious Melancholic Disease from cold dry city winds; said to be cured by the touch of the Kings of England or France.

label: Scrying
summary: Magical remote observation of others; the Haunt of the Living Ghost spell is noted as not constituting scrying by magic since others can see the caster.

label: Sculpt the Living Water
summary: A Muto Aquam spell (MuAq 20) created by Falke that allows the caster to mentally mold water as if it were clay for Sun duration.

label: Seal the Earth
summary: A Creo Terram spell that creates enough dirt to fill in a pit up to 6 paces across and 3 paces deep.

label: Searching the Haystack for a Needle
aliases: Searching the Haystack for a Needle
summary: A Rego Mentem spell granting +3 to sight-based Perception rolls for a specific object or quality, often used to locate vis.

label: Sebastian
summary: An eighth-century hedge wizard who joined the Order as a Flambeau magus despite Deficient Arts, developing a combat method based on his only strength, the Form of Aquam; namesake of the Schools of Sebastian.

label: Second Sight
summary: A supernatural Ability for seeing through illusions and the supernatural; True Sight Criamon magi may use Enigmatic Wisdom as if it were Second Sight, and spectral travelers can be seen by it.

label: Secondary Insight
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue making magical study versatile, granting bonus experience in several Forms when studying a Technique, and in Techniques when studying a Form.

label: Secret Name
summary: A Bjornaer Minor House Mystery that severs and reforges a magus's sympathetic name, expiring all old Arcane Connections and invalidating all Sympathetic Connections against him.

label: Secretive
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character keeps secrets from his sodales, rarely explaining what he is doing or why.

label: See in Darkness
summary: A Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a character see in complete darkness, though without more acute or longer-range eyesight than normal.

label: Seed of Betrayal
summary: A Muto Mentem 15 spell invented by Imanitos Mendax that turns a target's emotions toward his masters into contempt, making him readily betray them.

label: Seeker
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character is a self-proclaimed member of the Seekers, a loose organization of competitive magi searching for ancient magic and arcane artifacts.

label: Seekers
summary: A loose organization of competitive magi searching for ancient magic and arcane artifacts, detailed in Houses of Hermes: True Lineages.

label: Seelie Court
summary: A faerie court of higher rank; a Seelie maid disdained the faerie Tulgank and her court caused him to meld with his cavern floor.

label: Seferiel
summary: An angel of the Divine realm (Divine Might 50, Corpus) with special responsibility for Hermetic magi, sometimes drawing them closer to God and sometimes acting as the instrument of God's vengeance. He can duplicate any Hermetic effect and is the suggested antagonist for the Plagued by Angel Story Flaw.

label: Seirenes
summary: A tradition of female magae in House Ex Miscellanea who practice lyrical Siren Song magic taught to their founder by the sirens of legend.

label: Selena Tibicena
summary: A necromancer maga of Treverorum whose Trier sanctum, hidden beneath a graveyard, contained skeletons; her grave conceals a stairway to her former sanctum.

label: Selene
summary: A famous Younger Titan, the Moon, named among the offspring of the Titans.

label: Self-Confident
summary: A Virtue shared by all magi who survive a Tytalan apprenticeship, earned upon defeating one's master in the Apprentice's Gauntlet.

label: Selkie King
summary: A faerie figure whose drowned bride a sea mist may be the ghost of, and who comes ashore to find a bride.

label: Semita Errabunda
summary: An established example covenant of six magi (including Darius, Carolus, Mari, Moratamis, Tillitus, and the unGifted Redcap Victor) used to illustrate Prevailing Loyalty calculations.

label: Semitae
summary: A covenant of traveling magi led by a Criamon, recorded at the 1151 tribunal; possibly the same wandering group recorded in Cad Gadu's records since the tribunal's founding.

label: Semitae's horses
summary: A breeding line of horses raised by Semitae that are not frightened of magi; traded to other covenants but no one else has managed to breed them true.

label: Sempringham
summary: The first and most important house of the Gilbertine order in eastern England.

label: Seneca
summary: A crazed Durenmar magus obsessed with building the tallest tower in the world; his magical botch sent him into Final Twilight and collapsed his half-built tower, now Seneca's Folly.

label: Seneca's Folly
summary: A jumble of ancient overgrown timber beams at Durenmar, the ruins of a giant tower whose builder Seneca was sent into Final Twilight by a botch.

label: Senior Bard
summary: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a character who spent five or six years at an Irish bardic school, ranked Cano or Cli, with a Local Reputation of 2.

label: Senior Clergy
summary: A Major Social Status Virtue for an archbishop, bishop, abbot, abbess, or other senior Church member with access to Church resources and a Reputation of level 4.

label: Senior Master
summary: A Major Social Status Virtue for a prosperous, authoritative guild master who may own multiple workshops, serve as a guild official, and govern guild affairs.

label: Sense Holiness and Unholiness
summary: A Supernatural Ability granted by the Divine realm to feel the presence of good and evil in areas, persons, or objects, including detecting demons and angels.

label: Sense Holiness & Unholiness
summary: A Supernatural Power allowing perception of holy and unholy qualities, such as the Manifest Sin Flaw, through one or more senses.

label: Sense of Magical Power
summary: An Intellego Vim spell that tells the caster whether he is currently in a Magic aura.

label: Sense of the Lingering Magic
summary: An Intellego Vim spell that detects many magical residues, even from weak spells, and the presence and power of active spells.

label: Sense Passions
summary: A Supernatural Ability to sense the personality and desires of an intelligent being by reading the tarnish on its soul, often a false power or Infernally associated.

label: Sense the Feet That Thread the Earth
aliases: Sense the Feet That Thread the Earth
summary: An Intellego Terram spell that feels what is moving along the ground within a mile; derived from the Terram tradition from which Guernicus the Founder came.

label: Sense the Lingering Magic
summary: The Hermetic effect (Target: Smell) underlying Philippus Niger's Sniff Out the Witch power for detecting magical residue.

label: Sense the Nature of Vis
summary: An Intellego Vim spell that reveals which Art a supply of raw vis is connected to, shown by a color-coded aura.

label: Sensory Magic
summary: A Hermetic Mystery, described in Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults, whose Initiation lets a magus with Feral Scent double the area of effect of spells with a Scent Target.

label: Sentences
summary: A work by Peter Lombard whose reading might lead to a breakthrough regarding the Divine realm's suppression of magic, per a story seed.

label: Sentient
summary: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab has developed an independent mind, likely from long exposure to a high-level magic or faerie aura.

label: Sept
summary: A local grouping within House Bjornaer to which a magus may belong; sept members typically Initiate a magus into cults and provide mentorship.

label: Serica
summary: A distant eastern land the Romans called the source of the finest silks and spices, from which Europe imports luxuries by paying tons of silver through Arabic intermediaries.

label: Sericans
summary: The people of Serica, whom no European merchant has ever met; some Hermetic scholars believe they are monsters who eat silver, given their insatiable demand for it.

label: Serlo Le Mercer
summary: The mayor of London in 1220, holding all judicial and fiscal authority within the city.

label: Serrifuloria of Merinita
summary: A magus of House Merinita believed to have discovered a unique path within the Arcadian forest, stripping herself of emotions as magical jewels to partially overcome the Limit of True Feeling.

label: Servant
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: a full-time mundane lab servant from the covenfolk performs the most menial tasks (Safety bonus from servant's Intelligence, +1 Aesthetics, +1 Mentem).

label: Servant of the (Land)
summary: A Major Story Flaw in which a powerful magical creature has saved the character and set him a difficult task, imposing a Prohibition until the task is complete.

label: Servus Maris
summary: An attempt to found a Manx covenant in 1160, destroyed by a dragon within six months; one magus was sent back with the message 'Don't come back.'

label: Seven-League Stride
summary: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 30) that transports the caster to any place within seven leagues that they can see or have an Arcane Connection with.

label: Sever the Ties That Bind
summary: A Major or Minor Ordeal Flaw causing a Verditius magus to lose emotional bonds with family and friends, appropriate for learning Bind Curse.

label: Sever the Unwanted Limb
summary: A Rego Corpus 25 spell that cleanly and painlessly amputates one of the target's limbs without bleeding, leaving the Lame or Missing Hand Flaw.

label: Severicus
summary: A master of House Tremere at Roznov Fort, a tall, bald, Terram-specialist magus who detests change; one of only two Tremere in the Rhine to hold his own sigil and controls about two-fifths of the Tremere sigils.

label: Severus Maximus
summary: A magus of House Flambeau who declared Wizard War against Caithlinn of House Diedne of Oakdell covenant in 1004 AD.

label: Shackles of the Frozen Ice
summary: A ReAq 10 spell that freezes a circular portion of water into ice, trapping anyone in it; the ice holds fast regardless of Magic Resistance but only inflicts cold damage if it penetrates.

label: Shadchan
summary: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a marriage arranger trusted by parents to find the best matrimonial match for their children.

label: Shadows of the Fires past
summary: An Intellego Ignem spell (Level 15) that reveals where fires have been in the past lunar month as a light red flickering haze, with an intuitive sense of when.

label: Shamash
summary: A Free Social Status Virtue for the servant of the synagogue responsible for its well-being, cleanliness, and announcements, requiring the Educated (Hebrew) Virtue.

label: Shamir
summary: A magical stone said to be held within the pillars of Solomon's temple that could cut other stones.

label: Shape and Material Bonuses
summary: Bonuses to magical and philosophical lab work derived from natural principles of affinity, similarity and sympathy; provided by ingredients and used by both magi and philosophers.

label: Shape of the Woodland Prowler
summary: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 25) with an Animal requisite that transforms the target into a wolf via a wolf skin; the target may change back at will.

label: Shapechanging
summary: A non-Hermetic Major Virtue option for the Damhadh-Duidsan tradition.

label: Sharp Ears
summary: A Minor Virtue acquirable by a Bjornaer inner heartbeast and possessed by the stag and wolf.

label: Shattering the Malicious Rune
summary: A general Perdo Vim spell invented by Philippus Niger, like Unraveling the Fabric of (Form) but targeted specifically at rune-magic.

label: Shell of False Determinations
summary: A Creo Vim ritual that creates a shell of magic on an item, giving false information to magi who investigate its powers.

label: Shell of Opaque Mysteries
summary: A Creo Vim ritual similar to Shell of False Determinations that causes all attempts to investigate a magic item to fail unless the magus's roll exceeds the ritual's level.

label: Sheltered Upbringing
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character grew up isolated from society and cannot understand most human customs, barring several social Abilities at start.

label: Shiver of the Lycanthrope
summary: An Intellego Animal spell (Level 10) that makes the caster feel a shiver when touching a person or beast that is a lycanthrope.

label: Shoes of the Zephyr
summary: Wondrous horseshoes that allow a horse to fly, running across the sky as if it were land (Craft Level 19).

label: Short Attention Span
summary: A Minor Flaw that affected covenfolk may acquire after a year under the Instant Loyalty of the Rebellious Turb ritual.

label: Short-Lived Magic
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character's spells do not last as long as they should, with each duration category reduced.

label: Short of Breath
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character quickly tires during extended physical activity, receiving -3 to Stamina rolls to avoid fatigue.

label: Short-Ranged Magic
summary: A Major Hermetic Flaw halving Casting Totals when not touching the target and halving Lab Total for effects with range greater than Touch.

label: Show of the Flames and Smoke
aliases: Show of the Flames and Smoke
summary: A Muto Ignem spell (Level 10) that makes a fire produce colored smoke, streams of flame, and strange noises, entrancing or horrifying onlookers and potentially igniting nearby objects.

label: Shriek of the Impending Shafts
summary: An Intellego Herbam spell (Level 15) that warns of incoming wooden objects via a shriek, granting +9 Defense against wooden weapons.

label: Shroud Magic
summary: A Muto Vim spell that lets a magus suppress or alter the sigil in a spell currently being cast.

label: Shrouded
summary: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab is hidden or protected by a supernatural effect such as The Shrouded Glen (+1 Warping, halve Aesthetics).

label: Sicero
summary: A recently Gauntletted 23-year-old Journeyman follower of House Tremere at Triamore, filius of Goliard, who secured membership on his mater's recommendations.

label: Sicily
summary: The Mediterranean island beneath whose Mount Etna the fire spirit Adranus dwells, whose inhabitants once worshipped him as a god of fire.

label: Side Effect
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue giving a magus's magic an incidental, generally useful feature whose intensity scales with spell level, such as a temporary Presence bonus after casting.

label: Siegfried
summary: The legendary hero of the Nibelungenlied who slew the dragon Fafnir, won the Nibelung treasure, became invulnerable except for one spot, and was treacherously slain by Hagen.

label: Siena
summary: A north Italian city whose goldsmiths are renowned throughout Europe.

label: Siffed of Criamon
summary: A young Criamon magus among the members recruited to Nigrasaxa.

label: Sight of the Active Magics
summary: An Intellego Vim spell that lets the caster see spells as colored, shaped auras around things and people, indicating Form and Technique.

label: Sight of the Transparent Motive
summary: An Intellego Mentem spell (Level 10) that detects the general motive most powerfully influencing the target at the moment, such as fear, anger, or greed.

label: Sight of the True Form
summary: An Intellego Corpus spell (General) that lets you see the true, original form of any person whose form has been changed or masked.

label: Sight of the Warm Surface
summary: A MuIm 20 synaesthetic spell that transforms the species of warm surfaces, normally sensed by touch, into species the eye can perceive.

label: Sign Language
summary: An Ability equivalent to a Living Language, developed by monks to communicate during times of silence, understood only by monks of a particular monastery.

label: Significato
summary: Magically occurring phenomena that illuminate truth and let magi generate study totals through mystical experiences instead of studying from vis.

label: Signum Irruptus
summary: A master of House Criamon and leader of the covenant Heorot, obsessed with the trolls (whom he believes descended from degenerate gods), having lost his left arm and 14 grogs to his studies.

label: Sihr
summary: The Major Non-Hermetic Virtue (an Accelerated Ability) of the sahirs used to summon jinn and empower bargains that bind them to service.

label: Sikelgaita of Sicily
summary: A Lombard princess and wife of the Duke of Apulia and Sicily who fought dressed as a knight, rallying troops at the Battle of Dyrrachium against the Byzantine Empire; an example of conquest-based female power.

label: Silbury Hill
summary: An artificial mound 500 feet in diameter and 120 feet high south of Avebury, said to be the cursed burial place of King Sel, entombed on horseback with his treasury.

label: Silence of the Smothered Sound
summary: A Perdo Imaginem spell (Level 20) that makes one being or object incapable of producing sound; magi so affected suffer spellcasting penalties for being unable to speak their words.

label: Silent Shout
summary: A CrIm 10 miniature spell that creates a burst of species matching the caster's voice striking the target's head, used on battlefields or to instruct apprentices.

label: Silva of Merinita
summary: A maga of House Merinita whose spell variants have whimsical qualities, such as comical coloration on created toads or a happy, playful wave.

label: Silvery Scales of the Knight
summary: A CrTe(An) 30 spell that conjures a suit of full chain mail armor styled after the caster's Wizard's Sigil; being magical, the wearer cannot grapple a magic-resistant creature while wearing the gauntlets.

label: Similarity
summary: A natural principle stating an effect resembles its cause, imbuing objects with Shape and Material bonuses; apothecaries call it the doctrine of signatures.

label: Simile
summary: The pattern underlying the natural range of variance in a class of objects, distinct from the Platonic form; familiarity with it adjusts Finesse rolls for crafting.

label: Simple-Minded
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character can only think about one thing at a time and becomes easily confused without clear instructions.

label: Simple Minded
summary: A Flaw possessed by all Rottweiler grogs reflecting limited intellect.

label: Simple Student
summary: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a university student who has not yet taken a degree, gaining 30 experience points per finished year toward Latin or Artes Liberales.

label: Simprim of Guernicus
summary: The mid-twelfth-century House Guernicus magus who started the Transitionalist movement seeking greater legal powers for the Quaesitores.

label: Simulacra
summary: A common automaton power (base effect 15, Creo Imaginem) making the automaton look, smell, and sound real rather than a facsimile.

label: Sinead Ex Miscellanea
summary: An ancient maga of Ungulus, focused on combat against magical beasts, who burns for revenge on the dragon that killed her beloved Parsirus but is magically pushed away from it.

label: Sinead's enchanted iron items
summary: A number of iron items worn by Espera of Merinita, all enchanted to defend against faeries, against the faerie lord she offended.

label: Sinews of Knowledge
summary: A covenant that has close and friendly relations with Durenmar, lying along a well-traveled Redcap route south toward the Greater Alps Tribunal.

label: Single Weapon
summary: A Martial Ability for fighting with a weapon used in one hand, possibly with a shield in the other, including lances from horseback.

label: Singlemindedness of the Concentrating Wizard
summary: A Rego Mentem spell granting +3 to Concentration rolls while automatically failing non-Concentration Intelligence rolls.

label: Sinus Wodinis
summary: A second covenant of Bjornaer magi on the southeast coast of Norway, presumed part of the Novgorod Tribunal, whose existence is known only to Crintera.

label: Sir Giles, a Ghostly Knight
summary: A magical ghost (Magic Might 16, Mentem) of a prideful knight in black mail who haunts his former lands, able to materialize, turn invisible, and ride a phantom black destrier.

label: Sir Robert the Dragonslayer
summary: An example character cited to illustrate how a high Reputation can make people doubt a character's identity.

label: Siren Song
summary: The Major Non-Hermetic Virtue of the Seirenes that empowers a character's music to command those who hear it.

label: Sirens
summary: Powerful magical creatures whose magical song lured sailors to drown; they taught Thelxiope their magic and turned to stone after Orpheus defeated them.

label: Sirmium
summary: The last Hermetic covenant in Meissen, destroyed in the 10th century by invading Magyars; its known vis sources were destroyed along with it.

label: Sirnas
summary: One of Birna's six apprentices, told to 'Protect,' with a stag heartbeast, who originated among the Wends of the Baltic Coast and founded Clan Sirnas.

label: Site of Legend
summary: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: stories and legends are associated with the lab, granting appropriate Characteristic and Specialization adjustments.

label: Skilled Parens
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue reflecting a more powerful or better-teaching parens, granting 60 extra experience points and 30 spell levels during apprenticeship.

label: Skilled Smuggler
summary: A Minor General Virtue letting a character hide one dagger-sized item, imposing -9 on Awareness rolls to find it.

label: Skinchanger
summary: A Virtue gained by stronger supernatural members of werewolf families (often women/witches), granting shapeshifting plus other magical abilities; Bjornaer the Founder was one such witch.

label: Skinchanger (Dove)
summary: A Major Supernatural variant of Skinchanger using prepared feathers or feather-engraved stones to become a dove, associated with the Daughters of Four Fathers tradition.

label: Slave
summary: A new Major Status Flaw for a character of likely Slavic origin who has been sold into captivity and is wholly beholden to a master's will.

label: Slave-Owner
summary: A new Minor General Virtue making a character the legal owner of one (largely unskilled) slave, lost if the slave is freed or killed.

label: Slavers' Guild
summary: A small guild occupying a grey area between craft and service guilds, dealing in the sale of non-Christian slaves; its members are skilled in Sailing and Leadership.

label: Slaves
summary: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: human slaves are employed in the lab as labor or experimental subjects (+1 Upkeep, -1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

label: Slay the Innocent
summary: A Perdo Corpus (Animal) spell (PeCo[An]30) that Mari Amwithig modified to include an 'enemy' charm in the Charm Magic example.

label: Sleep Disorder
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character cannot sleep soundly and risks nodding off during quiet periods, losing Long Term Fatigue; incompatible with Night Terrors.

label: Slothful
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character is lazy and indolent, constantly seeking excuses to avoid work.

label: Slow Caster
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw given to Confraternity of Irene Initiates, whose spellcasting mimics the long time it takes to paint or sculpt.

label: Slow Power
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which one of the character's supernatural powers requires an additional round of preparation to activate.

label: Slow Reflexes
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character does not react well to surprises, receiving -3 to Initiative in situations warranting a quick response.

label: Small Frame
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is of lighter-than-average build with Size reduced to -1; incompatible with Giant Blood, Large, or Dwarf.

label: Smoke Oil
summary: A Level 10 Alteration Reagent that evaporates into a thick gray fog filling about a hundred cubic paces when its sealed container is opened.

label: Snap of Awakening
summary: A spell that instantly awakens the target from sleep to alert consciousness when the caster snaps their fingers.

label: Sniff Out the Witch
summary: A 0-point Vim power of Philippus Niger that lets him smell the residue of magic on those with magical powers, with a Penetration of 5.

label: Snow and Wind
summary: Spirits of winter that descend each year to frolic in mountain lakes and bring the change of seasons; water collected as their favored lake freezes is a source of Muto vis.

label: Snowdonia
summary: The mountainous region of North Wales where Cad Gadu's island lies and where Cad Gadu magi once encountered Gerfallon etching a map into a mountainside.

label: Social Contacts
summary: A Virtue providing useful social connections; gained temporarily by a marriage broker, and possessed by smugglers and their suppliers because many people sympathize with them.

label: Social Handicap
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which some trait keeps the character from interacting easily with people, causing -3 on appropriate rolls.

label: Societates
summary: One of the three groupings of Hermetic Houses; the fourth Societas, House Ex Miscellanea, is a special case in how its members gain House Virtues.

label: Sofer
summary: A Free Social Status Virtue for the scribe who creates or repairs a Sefer Torah, requiring the ability to read and write Hebrew and the Educated (Hebrew) Virtue.

label: Soft-Hearted
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character cannot bear to witness suffering and avoids danger, valuing life and health above important goals.

label: Sol Invicti
summary: A holy Hermetic societas connected to the late Roman sun-cult of Sol Invictus, mentioned as related to the Cult of Mercury.

label: Solomon
summary: The legendary king whose encoded words of command sahirs chant to summon jinn, and a book in whose hand is a coveted item.

label: Sons of the Peters
summary: A small, argumentative group of northern speculative grammarians basing their method on Peter Helias and Peter of Spain; secretly aided in their disputationes by demonic tempters granting an Infernally tainted Puissant Artes Liberales.

label: Soothe Pains of the Beast
summary: A Creo Animal Ritual spell (Level 20) that cures one Light Wound suffered by an animal, resembling a ritualistic laying-on of hands.

label: Soothe the Ferocious Bear
summary: A Rego Animal spell (Level 10) that calms an animal until it is threatened or aroused again, requiring soothing speech.

label: Soothe the Ferocious Boar
summary: A Rego Animal spell (ReAn 10) known by Ioannes Acer with Mastery in Fast Casting.

label: Soothe the Raging Flames
summary: A Perdo Ignem spell (Level 20) that eradicates the heat of a bonfire so the flames do not spread or harm anything beyond what they already burned.

label: Sophists
summary: An antagonistic group of ancient Greek scholars and teachers of rhetoric whose teachings on the rivalry between nature and custom heavily influenced Tytalus's philosophy.

label: Soporific Sponge
summary: A Theriac of Level 15, Potency Mighty, a precious secret of the School of Salerno combining opium, mandrake, hemlock and hyoscyamus into a hypnotic aid that induces deep slumber.

label: Sorcerer's Flower
summary: A pale violet anemone growing on the slopes of the Brocken, reputed to be a source of vis.

label: Sordello
summary: A practicing Italian poet living in Florence who has begun to write poetry in the spreading troubadour style.

label: Sordus
summary: A basilisk with Magic Might 30 that serves as Philippus Niger's familiar; a knee-height gray lizard with a Gaze of Death and powers that wither plants and pollute water.

label: Sovereign Ward
summary: A powerful taboo: a faerie cannot harm someone carrying its sovereign ward, and direct contact with it destroys the faerie's body.

label: Spacious
summary: A Minor laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab has spare room so outfittings can be spread out (+2 Safety, +1 Aesthetics).

label: Spasms of the Uncontrolled Hand
summary: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 5) that makes one of the target's hands spasm, causing them to drop whatever is held.

label: Speak with the Living Flame
summary: A spell whose Bjornaer version is a Range Personal, Target Hearing effect with a free Mentem requisite that interprets the sound of fire into thoughts.

label: Special Circumstances
summary: A Minor Virtue boosting magic under certain conditions; the Malocchi take it for eye contact and the Donatores' Minor Magical Focus relates similarly.

label: Species
summary: The sensory emanations of objects manipulated by Imaginem magic; transforming species lets sounds be seen and changing species bouncing off a mirror changes mirror images.

label: Specimens
summary: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab has a large collection of related things stored in visible containers (+1 Upkeep, +1 Aesthetics, 1 Form Specialization point).

label: Speech with the Silent
summary: A Major Supernatural Virtue granting the ability to charm elemental objects into assisting, as Path of Strife magi do.

label: Spell Foci
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a rustic magus incorporate a small casting tool into spells to add a shape/material bonus to the Casting Total.

label: Spell Improvisation
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus add the magnitude of a known Formulaic spell as a bonus to his Casting Total when spontaneously casting a similar spell.

label: Spell Mastery
summary: A Hermetic system allowing magi to gain special abilities for known spells (such as Rebuttal, Still Casting, and Unravelling) and reduce botch dice; mastery can be studied from books.

label: Spell Timing
summary: A Minor Illusion Mystery of the Followers of Pendule granting new spell Durations (Held, Midday/Midnight, Season, While/Not/If Condition) and recurring spell effects.

label: Speyer
summary: A Rhine city originating as a Roman military camp, favored seat of the Salian dynasty, with a great cathedral whose bells mysteriously toll on imperial deaths.

label: Spharios
summary: The conscious sphere/mind of the universe at the moment of complete harmony, to which followers of the Path of Walking Backwards may ascend and rejoin in repose.

label: Spirit Form
summary: A power (Vim) of the angels Nasir and Seferiel that lets them become a creature of pure spirit, unable to affect or be affected physically.

label: Spirit of a Person's Anger
summary: An incorporeal Mentem spirit of Might 20 with the Wrathful Flaw and a Fury power that drives targets into uncontrollable rage; appears to Second Sight as a furious red-faced man.

label: Spirit of the Rhine
summary: A powerful water elemental spirit of the Rhine, pinioned at the Rhinefalls by a giant's rock; Schwall has served it through Quests and plots to release it.

label: Spirit Votary
summary: A Mythic Companion type: a devoted worshiper of a magical spirit who in pre-Christian days would have been a high priest forming a venerating cult, now typically a solitary pagan figure opposing the Dominion.

label: Spirit Votary (Virtue)
summary: The Free Mythic Companion Virtue defining a character as a spirit votary.

label: Spiritual Pact
summary: A Major Supernatural Virtue for a character who has made a pact with a powerful Magical spirit, gaining access to a Might Pool from the spirit by spending Confidence.

label: Spontaneous Casting Tools
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character must use casting tools to cast spontaneous spells, with 15 tools one for each Art; only available to Verditius magi.

label: Spontaneous Magic
summary: Magic producing effects not corresponding to a spell the magus knows, decided at the moment of casting; can be fatiguing or non-fatiguing.

label: Spotless
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is impeccably clean, requiring a season's work and maintenance (+1 Health, +1 Aesthetics, +1 Creo).

label: Sprouting Out of Season
summary: A Creo Herbam 20 spell (R: Touch, D: Sun, T: Ind) that causes the seed of any plant to sprout in a single day or night.

label: St. Adalbert of Prague
summary: A saint who defeated the spirit of Romowe, drove it back into the Holm Oak, and lit the fire that keeps it trapped; his relics are housed at the Basilica of St. Vitus in Prague.

label: St. Albans
summary: An abbey whose immunities Falkes de Bréauté violated by killing a fleeing monk and extorting money, before later doing penance there.

label: St. Anthony's Fire Demon
summary: A minor disease demon with Might 10 (Corpus) that lodges in a victim's intestines causing escalating wounds, exorcisable by a ritual of the Order of the Hospitalers of St. Anthony.

label: St. Augustine of Canterbury
summary: The Benedictine monk who came to convert the Saxons and founded the monastery and abbey at Canterbury that bears his name.

label: St. Benedict
summary: The saint under whose monastic rule Bricstan wished to live; he appeared in a blaze of light and broke Bricstan's fetters in prison.

label: St. Boniface
summary: An 8th-century missionary saint who miraculously felled the Donar Oak, fragmenting the primeval forest, and raised Mainz to an archbishopric, becoming its first archbishop.

label: St. Collen
summary: A hermit living on the side of Glastonbury Tor who confronted Gwynn ab Nudd, banishing the faerie king and his castle with holy water.

label: St. Crispianian
summary: Patron saint of leatherworkers and cobblers (with St. Crispin); brother of St. Crispin who preached in Gaul.

label: St. Crispin
summary: Patron saint of leatherworkers and cobblers (with St. Crispianian); one of two brothers of a noble Roman family who preached in Gaul in the third century.

label: St. Curig
summary: A Welsh saint whose gold-and-silver-encased staff, kept in the church of St. Germanus, miraculously cures tumors in exchange for an offering.

label: St. Cuthbert
summary: A saint whose shrine is at Durham cathedral; in a vision he told Godric to settle at Finchale near Durham, and pilgrims visit Godric's shrine as part of visiting Cuthbert's.

label: St. David
summary: A saint who came from Wales to Glastonbury to rededicate the old church but was told in a dream that God had already dedicated it; he was wounded then healed as a sign.

label: St. Davids
summary: A Welsh cathedral and see; Gerald of Wales campaigned to make it an archbishopric over the Welsh sees, without success.

label: St. Dunstan
summary: Patron saint of metalworkers, locksmiths, and embroiderers; a tenth-century English Benedictine monk, Abbot of Glastonbury and later Archbishop of Canterbury, and namesake of the Eye of St Dunstan.

label: St. Edmund
summary: A king of East Anglia martyred by the Danes and beheaded, his head guarded by a wolf; his shrine is at Bury St. Edmund's and he appeared in armor to condemn Henry of Essex.

label: St. Eloi
summary: Patron saint of goldsmiths and jewelers; a preacher who became Bishop of Noyon in seventh-century France.

label: St. Erhard
summary: The uncle of St. Odile who baptized her, upon which she miraculously recovered her sight.

label: St. Erkenwald
summary: A seventh-century bishop of London and patron saint of the city; the blasphemer Eustace who mocked his shrine was struck down by divine judgment.

label: St. Etheldreda
summary: A saint whose tomb at Ely is a major pilgrimage site; she appeared with St. Benedict and St. Sexburga to miraculously free the prisoner Bricstan.

label: St. Francis of Assisi
summary: Founder of the Franciscan order of friars (the followers of St. Francis), founded in Italy in 1209; he visited Acre during the Crusades before departing for Venice in 1220.

label: St. Georgen
summary: A Benedictine monastery founded 1084 as a daughter house of Hirsau, finally destroyed in 1208 by strange dark vines that killed its monks; suspected to be the work of Dankmar or the forest itself.

label: St. Gildas
summary: A saint and monk at Glastonbury Abbey who reconciled King Arthur with his brother Hueil, a king in Scotland who fought against Arthur.

label: St. Giles' Fair, Winchester
summary: The most important fair in England, the only one where Redcaps are always in attendance, sited around the church of St. Giles outside Winchester's walls; tin from Cornwall and gold from Wales are obtained there.

label: St. Hubert
summary: The successor of St. Lambert who raised a grand tomb over the site of Lambert's martyrdom at Liege.

label: St. Joseph
summary: Patron saint of woodworkers; the foster father of the Son of God who lived in Judaea and died in the first century.

label: St. Lambert
summary: A 7th-century bishop of Tongeren martyred at the site of Liege amid a Merovingian feud; his tomb drew pilgrims and the cathedral of St. Lambert was erected over it.

label: St. Lebuinus
summary: A saint who was the first to erect a chapel on the site of Deventer in 768; the present church of Deventer is named after him.

label: St. Liudger
summary: A saint who rebuilt the chapel at Deventer in 776 after it was destroyed by Saxon heathens.

label: St. Livier
summary: A local lord and saint beheaded by Attila when the Huns sacked Metz, who afterward picked up his head and walked to his burial place on a nearby hilltop.

label: St. Mary's Abbey, York
summary: A large Benedictine monastery in York founded in 1080 whose dissatisfied monks went on to found the Cistercian Fountains Abbey; led in 1220 by Abbot Robert of Longchamp.

label: St. Maurice
summary: Patron saint of dyers and weavers; an Egyptian soldier and principal officer of the Theban legion in the third-century Roman army.

label: St. Michael's Mount
summary: The place where the flood drowning Lyonesse finally stopped and where the first Trevelyan landed on his white horse.

label: St Nerius
summary: A magus famous for his Christian devotion and sanctity, generally said to have been a member of House Criamon.

label: St. Nicholas
summary: A patron saint of merchants in general; the fourth-century Bishop of Myra in Turkey.

label: St. Odile
summary: A 7th-century saint born blind to duke Adalric, who miraculously recovered her sight upon baptism, established a convent at the Hohenburg, and brought forth a curative spring.

label: St. Patrick
summary: A holy man who came from Ireland to Glastonbury and was made abbot, bringing the monks under a rule of life just before the time of Arthur.

label: St Paul
summary: A grog used in the complex combat example, on patrol with Gerard and Ignatio into a faerie forest where faeries create duplicates of them.

label: St Peter
summary: One of the twelve Apostles, the first Bishop of Rome and the rock on which the Church was built.

label: St. Swithin's Soupbowl
summary: An ancient stone column topped by a stone bowl, set there by Viking raiders; water left in the bowl by sunrise on St. Swithin's Day becomes Aquam vis by sunset.

label: St. Swithun
summary: A saint to whom the cathedral priory (Oldminster) of Winchester and a church over Kingsgate are dedicated.

label: St. Thomas Becket
summary: The martyred Archbishop of Canterbury whose shrine is the great pilgrimage site at Canterbury and whose death won benefit of clergy; killed in a dispute over jurisdictions.

label: St. Ursula
summary: A British princess who undertook a pilgrimage with 11,010 virginal handmaidens and was martyred with them at Cologne by the Huns; a church in Cologne marks their burial.

label: St. Vincent
summary: Patron saint of wine; a deacon of Saragossa in northern Iberia who was martyred in 304.

label: St. Wenceslaus
summary: Bohemia's patron saint and former duke, murdered by his pagan brother Boleslav; it is foretold he will rise from the dead, take the sword of Bruncvik, and call forth his sleeping army at Mount Blanik.

label: St. Werburg
summary: A saint whose Benedictine abbey lies in Chester; in legend she resurrected an eaten goose and forbade geese from entering a particular field forever.

label: St. Wulfstan
summary: A bishop of Worcester before and after the Norman Conquest, credited with miraculously saving Bristol merchants at sea and abolishing the Bristol slave trade.

label: Staff of St. Curig
summary: A relic staff encased in gold and silver with a cross-shaped top, kept in the church of St. Germanus, that miraculously removes tumors when pressed against them with an offering of a penny.

label: Stag Clan
summary: A Crintera clan that oversees the covenant's defense; its members are the most skilled soldiers, fighting with swords, and its leader serves as turb captain.

label: Stag of Virtue
summary: A noble Magical stag (Might 17, Animal) and great enemy of serpents that can heal its own wounds, neutralize poison, and live forever; its right antler has sought-after healing powers.

label: Stance of the Patient Tree
summary: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 35) with a Herbam requisite that turns the caster into a tree about 12 feet high; a tree branch lets the caster change back.

label: Station
summary: One of five grades of progress on a Criamon path - psychological states providing wisdom and supernatural Mystery Virtues, reached by following an avenue.

label: Station of the Perfect Tool
aliases: The Avenue of Subduing the Meat
summary: The first Station of the Criamon Path of the Body, reached via the Avenue of Subduing the Meat, where the magus realizes the body is the perfect tool for Hermetic magic.

label: Stationer
summary: A covenant staff member employed in the book trade to coordinate production, purchase scribal supplies, and dispatch books, often dealing with Redcaps.

label: Statutes of Lübeck
summary: Special privileges granted to Lübeck by Henry the Lion that let it govern itself independently under a merchant council led by the Älderman.

label: Steadying Hand
summary: A power of the angel Nasir (5 points, Animal/Corpus) that, by touching a target, ensures their footing is firm so they will not slip or fall while contact is maintained.

label: Stealth
summary: The Ability governing hiding and moving unseen; gains large bonuses from invisibility for hiding, contested in opposed rolls to locate invisible characters.

label: Steed of Vengeance
summary: A Muto Animal spell (Level 35) that turns a horse into a ferocious magical mount with a black coat, fiery eyes, fangs, and razor-sharp hooves.

label: Stellapser
summary: A ruin in the West Country near which the region is suitable for magical colonization.

label: Stellasper
summary: Covenant founded by Criamon magi in 1025 in the Scilly Isles southwest of Cornwall; destroyed in a great storm in 1163.

label: Stellatus, the Dragon
summary: An ancient dragon (Might 50, Ignem) able to assume human form, instill loyalty, breathe fire, and control fire; he regards himself as superior to all Hermetic magi and once killed a Tytalus maga.

label: Stench of the Twenty Corpses
summary: A Creo Auram spell (Level 10) that creates a horrible stench of rotting corpses, penalizing and potentially incapacitating those nearby.

label: Stentorius
summary: A powerful older House Tremere Archmagus, leader of Fengheld in the Rhine Tribunal, who holds three-fifths of the Tremere sigils there and commands the House in that Tribunal.

label: Stephen Eruditus
summary: The Jerbiton magus who founded and leads Libellus; trained in the Rhine Tribunal, around seventy but looks mid-thirties, with a reputation for risk-taking.

label: Stephen Langton
summary: The Archbishop of Canterbury (born 1165, archbishop since 1207), a noted Paris theologian who helped draft Magna Carta and seeks to establish the archbishop as the highest ecclesiastical authority in England.

label: Stettin
summary: A small port city on the River Oder overlooked by an old Wendish fortress, the ancestral home of the Pomeranian rulers, with the church of St. Jakob completed in 1187.

label: Steward of the House
summary: The administrator of House Jerbiton between primacies, resident at Valnastium and appointed at the Primus's whim, who organizes elections.

label: Stigmata
summary: Intricate skin markings of Criamon magi representing spiritual development and progress toward enlightenment; they appear and migrate as Enigmatic Wisdom grows and cannot be removed by magic.

label: Stigmatic Catalyst
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character's presence causes symbolic marks to appear on nearby people lacking Magic Resistance; normally found among House Criamon magi.

label: Still Casting
summary: A Mastered Spell special ability allowing a maga to cast a spell without gestures at no penalty.

label: Still the Raging Waters
summary: A Rego Aquam spell (ReAq 15) created by Falke that stills the waves on a small body of water to mirror-smoothness.

label: Stir the Slumbering Tree
summary: A Muto Herbam spell (Level 25) with a Mentem requisite that raises a tree to human-like consciousness, able to see, hear, and rearrange its branches.

label: Stockade Parma Magica
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character cannot suppress his Parma Magica once erected, so friendly spells must penetrate it as if hostile.

label: Stone-Cutting Knife
summary: A Rego Terram 15 enchanted chisel that shapes and forms stone as a stonemason would, usable to carve blocks from a quarry; can boost quarry productivity.

label: Stone of Bacchus
summary: A weathered finger of rock jutting from the Rhine near Baccharach on an island with a Magic aura of 2; locals believe touching it brings luck to the wine harvest, and its festival wine becomes hallucinogenic Muto vis.

label: Stone of the Black Serpent
aliases: the stone in the serpent's tail
summary: A wish-granting stone in the Black Serpent's tail that gives its holder as much gold as desired; Peredur took only this from his victory.

label: Stone Tell of the Mind that Sits
aliases: Stone Tell of the Mind that Sits
summary: A spell that allows a magus to converse with a rock, invoked in debates over whether inanimate objects possess minds.

label: Stone to Falling Dust
summary: A Perdo Terram spell that turns one solid non-living object of base Individual size or smaller into a pile of dust.

label: Stones
summary: A Serious Choleric or Phlegmatic Disease in which coagulated bile or phlegm forms hard stones in the gallbladder, kidney, or bladder.

label: Story Flaw
summary: A category of Flaw that drives stories; factors may uncover a target's Story Flaws of varying obscurity through intrigue.

label: Story Magic
summary: A Major Folk Mystery (Virtue) allowing a maga to influence the story of her own life through story charms that bring about myth-like circumstances.

label: Stouritus
summary: The current Primus of House Verditius and member of the covenant of Ingasia in the Theban Tribunal, who does not live at the domus magna Verdi.

label: Strassburg
summary: A Rhine trade city at the confluence of the Ill and the Rhine, originally the Roman Argentoratum, whose powerful boater's gild controls much of the Upper Rhine trade.

label: Strata Florida
summary: A particularly important Cistercian monastery in Powys, Wales, serving as a repository of history and mausoleum of princely dynasties.

label: Strife
summary: In Criamon cosmology, the force that divides and promotes separation; one of the two great forces of the universe, reflected by the Art of Perdo and the source of magic's power.

label: Strike of the Angered Branch
summary: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 15) that causes a large tree branch to swing at a target repeatedly for +10 damage.

label: Strings of the Unwilling Marionette
summary: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 25) that lets the caster control the physical movements of a conscious person.

label: Strong Angelic Heritage
summary: A Major Supernatural Virtue requiring Blood of the Nephilim; it grants a Divine Might (Corpus) score, Magic Resistance, immunity to Warping, and levels of holy powers invoked by spending Might points.

label: Strong Faith
summary: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue granting a +2 to social rolls with faeries and Common Sense in faerie-related situations.

label: Strong-Willed
summary: A Minor General Virtue giving +3 on any roll requiring strength of will; the character cannot easily be coerced into activities, beliefs, or feelings.

label: Strong Willed
summary: A Virtue gained through Clan Sirnas's Trial of Self Control, alongside Deleterious Circumstances when hungry.

label: Stubnitz Forest
summary: The largest forest on Rugen, on the Jasmund peninsula, deep within which the covenant Crintera lies; also containing the mysterious Hertha Lake.

label: Stuck in Your Ways
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character insists on doing things his old covenant's way, using the lower of an Ability and his current Covenant Lore for certain Stress Rolls.

label: Student of Faerie
summary: A Virtue representing study of faeries; very common among Faerie Doctors.

label: Student of Magic
summary: A Virtue suggested as appropriate for Mercurian characters.

label: Student of Magic Realm
summary: A Mystery Virtue the Titanoi cult can Initiate.

label: Student of (Realm)
summary: A Minor General Virtue giving training in the mystical aspects of one of the four realms of power, with a +2 bonus on uses of the appropriate Lore.

label: Studio
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Virtue: an ornate room outside the lab displays the owner's prized possessions to guests, commonly built by Verditius magi.

label: Study Bonus
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue granting bonuses to study an Art from books or raw vis when in the presence of a sufficient physical manifestation of that Form or Technique.

label: Study Requirement
summary: A Major Hermetic Flaw in which the character cannot study magic from books or vis alone, but must study in the presence of the appropriate Art.

label: Styx
summary: The wife of Pallas, representing the underworld river upon which solemn oaths are sworn; her name means "hatred" and she bore the Daimons Zelos, Kratos, Peitho, Nike, and Bia.

label: Subterranean
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab is underground, lacking natural light and requiring more candles (+1 Upkeep, -1 Health, -1 Aesthetics, +1 Terram).

label: Subtle Form
summary: A power (Corpus) of the angels Nasir and Seferiel that lets them change their appearance to look like any human being without changing their statistics.

label: Subtle Magic
summary: A Hermetic Virtue letting a magus cast spells without gestures, exemplified by the Sorcerous Musician Orlando who can cast while playing or singing.

label: Subtle Taste of Poison and Purity
aliases: Subtle Taste of Poison and Purity
summary: An Intellego Aquam spell (Level 5) that lets the caster taste all properties of any liquid or mixture of liquids tasted.

label: Succubus
summary: An Infernal entity that sometimes poses as a faerie partner, making intercourse with it worse than the mortal sin of faerie bestiality.

label: Suffusio
summary: A Serious Melancholic Disease, a congregation of humor between lens and pupil obstructing sight; treated by 'couching'.

label: Sufi
summary: Muslim mystics organized into tariqas led by shaykhs, seeking union with God; some wield supernatural powers and one Egyptian school uses unreadable texts for meditation.

label: Sula
summary: The autocrat of Durenmar, a wrinkled and gentle woman over ninety who arranges accommodation for visitors with uncanny ease.

label: Suleiman's Wrath on the Oath-Forsaken Jinni
aliases: Suleiman's Wrath on the Oath-Forsaken Jinni
summary: A PeVi spell that weakens and possibly destroys a creature with Magic Might, permanently destroying one reduced to zero Might.

label: Summa
summary: One of the two types of study books in Ars Magica, providing repeatable study of an Art or Ability up to a level; restricting summae limits a covenant's power advancement.

label: Summon Animals
summary: A Major Non-Hermetic Virtue/Supernatural Ability of the Beast Masters allowing them to summon mundane animals over long distances with an audible call, breaking the Limit of Arcane Connection.

label: Summoning
summary: The Major non-Hermetic Virtue of the Witches of Thessaly tradition, described in Realms of Power: The Infernal.

label: Summoning Circle
summary: A laboratory Feature: an elaborate pentagram marked on the floor into which things are summoned, providing Experimentation, Spells, Creo, Rego, Animal, and Vim Specializations.

label: Summoning the Creeping Death
summary: A Cr(Re)An 25 spell that conjures an obedient asp with deadly venom but no Might; sometimes used by School of Sebastian followers but disdained by other Flambeau magi as ignoble.

label: Summoning the Distant Image
summary: An Intellego Imaginem spell that lets the caster see and hear what is happening in a distant place via an Arcane Connection to the location or a person there.

label: Summoning the Spirit of Anger
summary: A ReMe 40 spell that calls a spirit of wrath to the magus's location via an Arcane Connection or its full name, inflicting a Warping Point on the source of the anger.

label: Sundering of Tremere
summary: An event that reduced House Tremere's power, after which Blackthorn's influence in the tribunal was diminished.

label: Superior Construction
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab benefits from distinguished construction techniques or materials (+1 Safety, +1 Aesthetics).

label: Superior Decoration
summary: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is luxuriantly decorated, e.g. with fine tapestries (+1 Upkeep, +2 Aesthetics, +1 Imaginem).

label: Superior Equipment
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab has higher-quality equipment such as Venetian glassware (+1 General Quality, +2 Upkeep, +1 Safety, +1 Vis Extraction).

label: Superior Heating
summary: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab has superior heating facilities so the occupant is never chilly (+1 Upkeep, +1 Health, +1 Aesthetics, +1 Ignem).

label: Superior Lighting
summary: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is very well lit so things are easy to find and books easy to read (+1 Upkeep, +1 Aesthetics, +1 Texts, +1 Imaginem).

label: Superior Tools
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab's tools were produced by master craftsmen (+1 Upkeep, +1 Safety, +1 Items).

label: Supernatural Ability
summary: A non-Hermetic supernatural skill that an apprentice may possess; whether it is retained, converted into a Hermetic Virtue, or lost depends on the master's Intellego Vim Lab Total.

label: Supernatural Beauty
summary: A Major Supernatural Virtue of mystical beauty that calls royal power, folk magic, and heroism to its defense, letting the player request a fortunate coincidence once per story.

label: Supernatural Nuisance
summary: A Major Story Flaw in which supernatural entities interfere in the character's life in minor ways, without long-term plans, whenever he is around them.

label: Supple Iron and Rigid Rope
summary: A Muto Terram spell that makes a flexible object stiff or a stiff object flexible, with appropriate Form requisites.

label: Suppressed Gift
summary: A Major Hermetic Story Flaw in which the character has The Gift but cannot access its power, temporarily unable to perform Hermetic magic, improve Arts, or use Parma Magica.

label: Suppressing the Wizard's Handiwork
summary: A Rego Vim spell that cancels one of the caster's own active spells for as long as concentration is maintained, with effects returning when concentration breaks.

label: Surgical Empiricus
summary: A Minor Social Status Flaw for a chirurgeon trained in only a single aspect of Chirurgy, granting the usual +1 to that surgery but halving Chirurgy for any other application.

label: Sursum
summary: Covenant founded in 875 on the north coast of Cornwall, destroyed during Athelstan's campaigns in 931 amid evidence of Tytalus diabolism.

label: Survival
summary: A General Ability covering finding food, water, shelter, routes, and safety in the wilderness, including building fires and cooking without implements.

label: Susanna
summary: The liberal-minded mater of Petrus Virilis, who researched fertility and the Gift and has since entered Final Twilight.

label: Susceptibility to Faerie Power
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character is especially susceptible to the fay, becoming disoriented in Faerie auras and having Magic Resistance halved against faerie effects.

label: Susceptibility to Infernal Power
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character is especially vulnerable to dark powers, risking illness in Infernal auras and having halved Magic Resistance against infernal effects.

label: Susceptibility to Magic
summary: A Minor Curse (Rego Vim effect) that strips a victim's natural resistance to magic, imposing a -3 to resist spells and supernatural effects.

label: Susceptibility to Sunlight
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which direct bright sunlight causes the character pain and exhaustion, giving -2 to sight rolls in bright environments and Fatigue loss outdoors.

label: Susceptibility to Warping
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character gains an additional Warping Point from each Realm whenever he gains one in a year, without contributing to Twilight.

label: Suspirium
summary: A ninth-century Bjornaer magus, the most recent common ancestor of Stellatus and Lacerta, after whom their sept was renamed.

label: Svantovit
summary: A four-faced Slavic sun- and war-god worshipped at Arkona, whose Faerie aura lingers despite the temple's destruction; opposed to the Queen of Winter, granting Falke's ritual a bonus.

label: Swabia
summary: The duchy surrounding the Black Forest, extending to Bavaria and the Alps, whose recent history is dominated by the rival Zähringen and Hohenstaufen families.

label: Swan Clan
summary: The smallest Crintera clan, comprising crafts-folk and companions with non-shapechanging magical powers; led by Janis, contact with the pagan Forest Brothers of Rügen.

label: Swift Knives, Invisible
summary: A Perdo Animal 40 spell with Rego requisite that reduces a dead animal to its components, such as wool, hide, meat, organs, and skeleton.

label: Swim
summary: A General Ability for propelling oneself through water quickly and efficiently, with specialties in long distances, diving, and underwater maneuvering.

label: Sword from the Unseen Scabbard
summary: A CrTe 15 spell that conjures a steel longsword lasting about two minutes; it must penetrate Magic Resistance to harm magic-resistant opponents.

label: Sword of Bruncvik
summary: The legendary sword that St. Wenceslaus is foretold to take up when he rises from the dead to lead his army.

label: Swordsmiths' Guild
summary: The craftsmen's guild of swordsmiths; Klaus the example craftsman is a master of it.

label: Symbolic Magic
summary: A Major Folk Mystery (Virtue) encompassing laboratory activities with charms and symbols, allowing charms in invested devices and talismans and new Symbol Range, Duration, and Target for ritual spells.

label: Sympathetic Connection
summary: A magical relationship drawn from symbolic correspondences, used in charms and Synthemata Magic; severed and invalidated against a magus by the Secret Name Mystery.

label: Sympathy
summary: A combined natural principle of affinity and similarity through which objects resonate, e.g. a bloodstone resonating with wounds; basis of many Shape and Material bonuses.

label: Synthemata
summary: Signs, symbols, or passwords that link a magician to a supernatural creature, used in theurgic incantations; any being with a Might score has them.

label: Synthemata Magic
summary: A Mystery whose practitioners, knowing a magus's secret name, gain an advantage when casting spells against him.

label: Szarlen
summary: A demon who operates a lead mine for the Polish town of Beuthen in return for services such as appropriating the Church's tithe or requiring worship.

label: Tabanus
summary: A Quaesitor of House Guernicus, trained at Magvillus, sent to police the Rhine; a strict, meddlesome peregrinator who recently occupied a sanctum at Triamore.

label: Tablinum
summary: A storehouse of information and artefacts in the Transylvanian Tribunal under the control of House Tremere, existing across numerous regiones entered only via spells requiring Arcane Connections held by its curator.

label: Tagelyn
summary: A covenant that, with Blackthorn, excavated caves in the Black Mountains over two centuries; its magi were driven out by Blackthorn and founded Ashenrise in Hibernia.

label: Tainted Offspring
summary: A Major Story Tainted Flaw in which the character has a child marked for great but unpleasant things by a powerful demon, requiring struggle against the demon's servants.

label: Tainted Treasure
summary: A Minor General Tainted Virtue: the character has inherited or acquired vast cursed treasure that brings harm and only allows itself to be spent sinfully.

label: Tainted Virtues and Flaws
summary: A category of Virtues and Flaws associated with the Infernal realm, gained through demonic corruption; Supernatural abilities they grant are always Infernal powers.

label: Tainted with Evil
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which an air of corruption surrounds the character, making others ill at ease and making positive Reputation impossible.

label: Taklamakan Desert
summary: A desert where Infernal storm spirits such as the Buran of Yenghissar are likely to be found.

label: Tales of the Ashes
summary: An Intellego Ignem spell (Level 5) that lets the caster see what touched ashes originally were and how and when the object was burned.

label: Talhaearn Tad Awen
summary: One of the five great Welsh poets believed by the Order to have left Daimons behind after death.

label: Taliesin
summary: One of the five great Welsh poets believed by the Order to have left Daimons behind after death.

label: Talion of Flambeau
summary: An ancient Flambeau magus, second oldest in the tribunal, who became praeco after Immanola was disqualified; renowned for mastery of Perdo.

label: Talisman
summary: Falke's talisman, a silver anklet-ring of watery crystal and amber attuned for +5 water effects and +3 Corpus, enchanted with Perceive the Change, Change Size, and Perceive Motives effects.

label: Talons of the Winds
summary: A Muto Auram spell (Level 20) that transforms a wind into an abrasive medium that tears at everything in its path, inflicting +4 damage from cuts; requires an existing breeze.

label: Talos
summary: A bull-headed bronze statue (automaton) made by Hephaestus that guarded Crete.

label: Taltos
summary: Wizards among the Magyar people of Hungary who use herbcraft to boost their physical characteristics and martial skills and to heal; many have Skinchanger; a Pharmocopoeian variant.

label: Tandaline
summary: A Follower of Bonisagus of Trianoma's lineage, a master of Muto and Auram, closest confidante of Murion and a Tenens Occultorum who maintains the House's correspondence.

label: Tangential Magi
summary: Criamon magi who have faded peacefully into Final Twilight and dwell in the Hypostasis outside time, sending visions through the Axis to their mortal successors.

label: Tangle of Wood and Thorns
summary: A Rego Herbam (ReHe 15) indirect spell that immobilizes a magus with wood without touching him, completely effective in bypassing Magic Resistance.

label: Tannhäuser
summary: A young 13th-century knight and poet of legend who discovered Venus's subterranean home, the Venusberg, and later sought absolution from the Pope.

label: Tarantism
summary: A condition that works wholly differently from a disease, stemming from a faerie curse.

label: Tarlan the Wolf
summary: A faerie wolf (Might 20, Animal) that exists to hunt people, marking them as quarry and harrying them to exhaustion; he cannot enter holy ground and never hunts children or the Gifted.

label: Tarnkappe
summary: A magical cloak of darkness taken by Siegfried from the dwarf Alberich, used to render him invisible and substitute for Gunther in the contests with Brünhild.

label: Tasgillia
summary: The fourth Prima of House Tytalus, despised for her selfish nature and puissant in spirit magic; she was executed for diabolism in 961 AD after summoning demons using Guorna's lore.

label: Taste of the Dulled Tongue
summary: A Perdo Imaginem spell (Level 5) that hides the taste of any substance, liquid or solid.

label: Taste of the Spices and Herbs
aliases: Taste of the Spices and Herbs
summary: A Muto Imaginem spell (Level 5) that makes a setting's worth of food or drink taste and smell exactly as the caster designates.

label: Teaching
summary: An Ability that adds to the Source Quality when a character teaches; the maximum number of students equals the teacher's Teaching score times five.

label: Teeth of the Earth Mother
summary: A Muto Terram spell that springs twenty sharp white marble pillars from the ground in a circle, able to cage, wall, or skewer enemies for +25 damage.

label: Tello
summary: The Bishop of Palencia who works with the king to stabilize the university, allowing the masters an advisory council under the chancellor.

label: Telramund
summary: A rebellious vassal of the late duke of Brabant who sought the dukedom and Elsa's hand and was defeated by Lohengrin in single combat.

label: Tempestaria
summary: A tradition of Saxon-associated weather witches within House Ex Miscellanea who summon rain, fog, and especially wind beyond Hermetic capacity, using sympathetic tools.

label: Templar Administrator
summary: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a brother of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon who administers the order's holdings rather than fighting; available only to male characters.

label: Templar Commander
summary: A Major Social Status Virtue for a commander of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon with authority over a province or preceptory, also granting Temporal Influence.

label: Templar Confrere or Consoeur
