summary: A Free Social Status Virtue for an associate member of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon who has taken one or two Templar vows.

label: Templar Office Holder
summary: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a character holding a position in the local hierarchy of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon, such as deputy commander or marshal.

label: Templar Prestige
summary: A Minor General Virtue: a member of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon who enjoys great respect among fellow brothers, starting with a Reputation of level 4 within the Templars.

label: Templar Servant
summary: A Free Social Status Virtue for a servant working at a Templar commandery, supported and protected by the order's papal bull.

label: Templar Specialist
summary: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a skilled employee of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon filling a crucial role such as craftsman or translator.

label: Temple of Isis
summary: An abandoned but well-repaired Roman temple within a magical regio in Florence's Piazza San Firenze, a potential covenant site holding relics of the Cults of Isis and Mercury.

label: Temporal Influence
summary: A minor general Virtue granting influence in mundane government or institutions; raises an agent's Resistance Strength, as with the merchant Godfroi.

label: Tenens Occultorum
summary: A House Bonisagus office held by Tandaline, appointed by Murion, involving keeping written contact across the House.

label: Terious of Flambeau
summary: A magus of House Flambeau who walked the Path of Energy, became a living embodiment of the genius locus, and contributed the spell Replenishing the Fount of the Magus to the Great Library.

label: Terram
summary: Form governing earth and solid inanimate materials.

label: Terschelling (island)
summary: A Friesian island on a deserted coastline that is home to the Waddenzee covenant and thousands of seabirds.

label: Test of Fastness and Fading
summary: An Intellego Aquam 5 spell that confirms the quality of a container of ink, dye, or paint, verifying it will not fade, flake, or eat through parchment.

label: Test of the Flames
summary: A CrIg 15 spell filling a circle with waist-high flames doing +5 damage per round; of ancient Cult of Mithras origin, once used by Flambeau magi as an endurance test alternative to certamen.

label: Tethered Magic
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus pass control of non-Ritual spells to others or tether them to objects, at the cost that all his spells become Arcane Connections to him.

label: Teutonic Knights
summary: A landowning monastic military order suspicious of Lübeck's charter that promotes its own less autonomous charter to Baltic towns and controls a section of Acre.

label: Thamik of Verditius
summary: A young Verditius magus among the members recruited to Nigrasaxa.

label: Thann Chapel
summary: A chapel west of Mulhouse in the southern Vosges, built over a miraculous holy staff containing the ring and thumb of Theobald of Gubbio; has a Divine aura of 3 and is a place of pilgrimage.

label: Thaumaturgical Transformation of Plants to Iron
aliases: Thaumaturgical Transformation of Plants to Iron
summary: A Muto Herbam spell (Level 20) with a Terram requisite that makes any plant as hard as iron, up to the size of a small tree.

label: The Ague
summary: A Major Phlegmatic Disease (Severity 14) caused by bad air around sewage and tanneries, marked by continuous fever with chills.

label: The Alder Prince
summary: The compassionate, secretive faerie ruler of the western Alder Forest among the Courts of the Seasons, strongest in spring, who woos and is repeatedly entrapped by the Willow Maiden.

label: The Ambulatory Laboratory
summary: A Rego Terram 30 spell that transports a chamber's movable contents to another room via Arcane Connection, used by magi to move their labs without mundane effort.

label: The Animal Powers
summary: Ancient mysterious entities that ruled the Stubnitz region before the Bjornaer; revered at Crintera as animal-shaped fetishes said to house primordial spirits of nature.

label: The Antigones
summary: A new generation of interventionist Jerbiton magi ('those like their ancestors'), trained after the fall of Constantinople, who favor political engagement, aggression, and large House covenants.

label: The Apple of the Kyffhauser
summary: A magic spirit (Magic Might 70) manifesting as a withered apple tree at the base of the Kyffhauser, guarded by men-at-arms, that grants victory and lordship to whoever hangs their shield on it.

label: The Apple That Etches
summary: A Creo Herbam 20 ritual that creates 100,000 oak galls used for ink, useful to covenants closed off from the mortal world with abundant Herbam vis.

label: The Archpoet
summary: An anonymous bawdy twelfth-century Latin poet and famed leader of the Goliardic tradition, rumored to have been a magus, whose poems a Bonisagus magus claims encode Mentem lore.

label: The Art of Magic
summary: Bonisagus's epitome concerning Magic Theory, etched by later magi into 36 six-foot clear crystals at the Forest of Shining Stone, Durenmar.

label: The Ash of Nortorf
summary: An infernal entity (Infernal Might 15, potential 60) manifesting as an ash seedling in the churchyard of Nortorf; prophesied to grow into a tree that will bring a king with fell powers if a black horseman defeats the white horseman.

label: The Auberge
summary: A long-forgotten Mercere way station on a river island, accessible only through a Roman ruin's doorway into a Magical regio; its three spirit guardians give departing magi food containing Vim vis.

label: The Avariciousness of the Ptolemies
summary: A Rego Animal 4 ward that prevents those lacking Magic Resistance from removing a book across an inscribed circle or doorway.

label: The Baltic Sea
summary: The sea across which Baltic trade ceases each winter when the Queen of Winter freezes it; a ritual at Arkona must be performed to thaw the ice.

label: The Bears' Cave
summary: A hidden primeval cave in the northern Harz (Magic aura 3) strewn with ancient bear bones that may be harvested for Animal vis; secret vis source of a Bjornaer bear lineage.

label: The Beast Remade
summary: A Muto Animal spell (Level 25) with a Corpus requisite that gives a land beast a human form while retaining its intellect and some animal feature.

label: The Betrayal
summary: The event in 961 AD when Kalliste exposed Tasgillia's diabolism publicly, shaming House Tytalus; Tytali view it as Kalliste betraying the Founder's principle of putting nature before custom.

label: The Black Fir
summary: A sinister magical fir tree near Durenmar's Great Library, key to a faerie revenge plot; it slowly inches toward the Tower of Bonisagus as part of the King of the Black Mountain's scheme.

label: The Black Horse of Busha
summary: A proud black stallion seen as a figure in black shale in the Howgill Fells, said to travel the mundane world under cover of storms with purposes that bode no good.

label: The Blinded Sentry
summary: A Perdo Mentem 5 spell invented by Imanitos Mendax that renders a target insensate for a moment, registering only the initial touch.

label: The Bohemian Forest
summary: A massive forest, safe from man due to harsh climate and peat bogs, haunt of lynx, wolves, deer, and giants; home to Irencillia and (in its south) Fenistal.

label: The Book of Mundane Beasts
summary: A free Atlas Games supplement describing beasts of Mythic Europe, on which the Virtuous Hound, Familiar Cat, and skinchanger's raven form are based.

label: The Book of One Thousand and One Nights
aliases: The Book of One Thousand and One Nights
summary: A collection of stories begun in the ninth century around which the Keepers of the Thousand Tales formed; they believe several of its characters are magi who have passed into Arcadia.

label: The Book of Poisons
summary: A book by Ibn Wahshiya, quoted for a recipe to make a poison from a scorpion-stung mouse, hellebore, and other ingredients.

label: The Bookstand of Hespera
summary: A wooden lectern enchanted (ReHe 15) to follow the magus around the lab, holding a Lab Text and adding two points to a Texts Specialization.

label: The Bountiful Feast
summary: A Creo Herbam ritual (Level 35) cast at noon the day after the winter solstice to ensure crops within its target grow healthy and fruitful.

label: The Box of Unguarded Thoughts
summary: A small silver coffer inlaid with mother-of-pearl that collects nearby stray thoughts and distills them into silver coins containing Mentem vis, potentially serving as Arcane Connections.

label: The Brocken
summary: The highest peak of the Harz and one of Germany's most potent supernatural sites, topped by the Witches' Altar and a focus of Walpurgis Night witchcraft, with a Faerie aura.

label: The Brushstrokes Revealed
summary: An InIm 10 spell that makes species cast by an object within a circle more vivid, revealing tiny details otherwise invisible, used to investigate artworks and creation.

label: The Buran of Yenghissar
summary: An Infernal desert storm spirit and corrupt jinni (Might 25, Auram) that manifests as a vortex of black sand, plaguing the village of Yenghissar and now bound within a sahir's ancestral sword.

label: The Buskam
summary: The largest of Rugen's mysterious findlinge boulders, partially submerged off the Monchgut peninsula and a site of Slavic worship; said to be left by giants from an epic battle.

label: The Cabal of Erigone
summary: A House Tytalus cabal, symbolized by a triangular clavicula, determined to prevent Caecilius of Durenmar from becoming praeco of the Rhine Tribunal.

label: The Cabal of the Broken Ocean
aliases: The Cabal of the Broken Ocean
summary: A House Tytalus cabal, symbolized by a clockwise turbo of four lines, that provides covert support to the pagans of Lithuania against the Teutonic Knights.

label: The Cabal of the Lance
summary: A House Tytalus cabal, symbolized by a helix made from chain, covertly shielding a newly formed covenant from the intrigue of its Tribunal for an unclear purpose.

label: The Cabal of the Shining Eye
aliases: The Cabal of the Shining Eye
summary: A House Tytalus cabal, symbolized by a concha with an eagle at the center, dedicated to maneuvering the Roman Tribunal into colonization of North Africa.

label: The Call to Slumber
summary: A Hermetic spell, cited in Touch/Eye Range versions as a subtle urban spell and as a template for spells that manipulate mental states.

label: The Captive Voice
summary: An Imaginem spell that a magus can vary to collect a poet's spoken poem, the captured words acting as an Arcane Connection to the poet until the spell ends.

label: The Carnal Wolf
summary: An adulteration caged within the Cave of Twisting Shadows, a great wolf with jaws too large to close, embodying the carnal urges of Demetrius; used to teach apprentices about spiritual impurity.

label: The Carpenter's Keen Eye
summary: An InHe 15 spell (Voice, Momentary, Group) by which a magus learns whether wood is suitable for carpentry and what treatment it needs.

label: The Cerne Giant
summary: A blatantly phallic figure carved on a Dorset hillside, said to be the lingering presence of a giant who terrorized the area before being slain; barren women who sleep on the phallus may conceive.

label: The Chirurgeon's Healing Touch
summary: A Creo Corpus spell (CrCo20) that magically closes wounds; under Unnatural Magic, wounds it closes reopen because the magic lasts only a moment.

label: The Church
summary: The dominant religious institution of Mythic Europe, headed by the Pope, the Bishop of Rome, and backed by the Divine. It structures medieval life around the seven sacraments, canon law, and a hierarchy of bishops, priests, monasteries, and parishes.

label: The Clandestine Mask
summary: A MuIm 4 spell that blurs the caster's face and distorts her voice so she cannot be recognized; the disguise's form is determined by the caster's sigil.

label: The Clean Slate
summary: A Perdo Mentem spell that wipes the target's memory clean, removing identity, Academic/Arcane/Martial/Supernatural Abilities, and all Arts.

label: The Cloudless Sky Returned
summary: A Perdo Auram spell (Level 45) that clears the sky within the caster's vision of clouds and meteorological activity short of a hurricane or tornado.

label: The Collegium
summary: A Hermetic societas of about a dozen Platonist magi from different Houses, founded by Xenophon of Bonisagus, dedicated to investigating the nature of magic through experimentation and Philosophiae.

label: The Constant Expression
summary: A Major Hermetic Flaw: the maga perpetually casts non-fatiguing Spontaneous magic effects, losing a permanent long-term Fatigue level and making laboratory work risky.

label: The Courts of the Seasons
summary: Four intrinsically linked faerie woodland courts (Holly, Alder, Oak, Willow) tied to the passage of the seasons, formed when one forest spirit splintered into four and each allied with a faerie lord.

label: The Crintera Schism
summary: A saga concept revolving around the troubles within Crintera: the shapeshifter feud, the Harmonist-Wilderist split, and the Rügen crisis, culminating in the covenant being sundered and warring domus magnae.

label: The Crone
summary: An aged, respected village woman with the Unaging Virtue whose menstrual blood contains Creo vis; though not Gifted, she knows something of magic and serves as a vis source near a covenant.

label: The Crown of Hermes
summary: An elaborate jewel-encrusted golden crown (Cr(In,Mu,Re)Me 50) whose creator is lost to memory; it lets its wearer enter a trance to create and work in an imaginary laboratory, inflicting Warping points.

label: The Crystal Dart
summary: A Muto Terram spell (with Rego requisite) that transforms a stone into a 10-inch crystal dart that flies at a target for +5 damage.

label: The Crystal of a Hundred Candles
aliases: The Crystal of a Hundred Candles
summary: An enchanted crystal embedded in the ceiling of Arliandus's sanctum that blooms into light to illuminate the whole chamber when the door opens.

label: The Cult of Orpheus
summary: A Mystery-Cult-like tradition of magi (magoi) descended from worshippers of Orpheus and Hermes, who practice emotionally-connected magic and revere the legend of Orpheus.

label: The Cult of Vesta
summary: A Merinita cult founded by magae of Brittany who venerate faeries as household gods (lares), adopt Vesta as patron, and take vows of chastity in exchange for faerie powers.

label: The Daughters of Echo
summary: A Jerbiton league interested in magical methods of recording and reproducing events, led by a Merinita maga near Burnfoot in Hibernia.

label: The Dead of Ascalon
summary: The cursed corpses of a Muslim fleet defeated off Ascalon in 1123; their skulls, smuggled aboard rival ships by a merchant house, cause every cursed voyage to end tragically.

label: The Death of Vermin
summary: A Rego Animal 20 enchanted box that fills specific vermin with a desire to enter it, gathering them to be destroyed.

label: The Demand of the Frustrated Scholar Soothed
aliases: The Demand of the Frustrated Scholar Soothed
summary: A Rego Animal 40 spell that teleports a book within 500 paces to the caster's hand via an arcane connection; higher-level versions reach up to seven leagues.

label: The Donar Oak
summary: A divine spirit (Divine Might 40) at Geismar, formerly the focal point of the pagan power of the Hercynian Forest; its acorns are worth Creo vis and can tame animals and forests.

label: The Donatores Requietis Aeternae
summary: A young, secretive necromantic tradition of House Ex Miscellanea with religious backgrounds who ensure the spirits of the dead reach their final rest using the Banishing Ability.

label: The Door of Deimos
summary: An enchanted iron door created by Arliandus and named after the son of Ares, embossed with faces and skulls and invested with effects that recognize and repel intruders.

label: The Dragon of Brünn
summary: A dragon that lived in a cave by the River Svratka near Brünn and devoured townsfolk, until a travelling butcher killed it with a lime-stuffed ox pelt; its stuffed carcass hangs in Brünn's town hall.

label: The Drudenbaum of Harberg
summary: A mythical tree spirit (Magic Might 30) atop the Harberg near Nuremberg where wizards meet; its golden drops are Creo vis and its milk is Vim vis, and it possesses trees to assume its form.

label: The Dumb Waiter
summary: A Rego Terram level 35 enchanted device that instantly transports food and dishes from the kitchen to specified places in the covenant within 50 paces.

label: The Ear for Distant Voices
summary: An Intellego Imaginem spell (Level 20) that lets the caster hear what is happening in a designated place to which they have an Arcane Connection.

label: The Earth's Carbuncle
summary: A Rego Terram spell (with Muto requisite) that turns a 1-pace circle of ground into jagged stone that bursts upward, throwing those standing on it.

label: The Earth Split Asunder
summary: A Rego Terram (ReTe 30) spell opening a chasm; Magic Resistance does not protect against falling in, but does against being crushed when it closes.

label: The Eastern Marches
summary: The wild northeastern reaches of Germany between the Elbe and Oder, roamed by werewolves, witches, and giants, where pagan Slavic beliefs linger; claimed by the Rhine Tribunal.

label: The Edges of the World
summary: Four regiones corresponding to the four elements and humors to which a spirit-traveling Criamon magus is sequentially drawn, and from which he must escape back to his body.

label: The Enchanted Chef
summary: A Rego Herbam (Animal, Aquam, Ignem) 45 enchanted pot that processes and transforms food into a described dish as if cooked, substituting Communication + Finesse for Craft: Cook.

label: The Enchanted Porter
summary: A Rego Terram 15 enchanted glove that lifts and pushes an inanimate object while the user holds and moves it; based on The Unseen Porter.

label: The End of Hatred
summary: A PeCo 50 Orphic spell that instantly slays a target against whom the caster has the Enemies Flaw; used only once in the Cult's history.

label: The Enigma's Gift
summary: A Creo Vim spell that inflicts four Warping Points on a target and forces a Hermetic magus to check for Twilight.

label: The Ever-Watchful Turb
summary: A Perdo Mentem spell that prevents a target group from falling asleep by quelling the inclination to rest.

label: The Exsules
summary: A small band of fewer than a dozen renegade House Merinita wizards based at Fenistal who rejected the Order; they know imperfect Hermetic magic and Parma Magica and prefer to turn nature against their enemies.

label: The Externsteine
summary: An array of thirteen tall sandstone rocks on the southeastern edge of the Teutoburger Forest, a former pagan site now bearing a consecrated chapel with a Divine aura of 4.

label: The Eye of the Sage
summary: An Intellego Corpus spell (Level 30) with an Imaginem requisite that lets you see a specific person and what is within one pace of them, clearly enough to read.

label: The Faithful Made Whole
summary: A sample relic power (4 points, Init +15, Corpus) that cures the recipient of all disease and heals all physical wounds.

label: The Falcon's Hood
summary: A Perdo Animal spell that destroys an animal's vision, with the blindness healing as a Medium Wound; also referenced earlier as PeAn 20.

label: The Fallen Temple of Mercury
summary: A fallen temple of Mercury still containing details of some of the powerful rituals of the Cult of Mercury, referenced as a place/treasure (via the supplement Mythic Locations).

label: The Falling Evil
summary: A Major General Flaw in which the character suffers random convulsions and blackouts, leaving him temporarily Incapacitated, often caused by demonic possession.

label: The Fane of the Founders
summary: A powerful artifact in a hidden Black Forest glade, a twelve-sided stone slab into which the Cult of Mercury bound much of the forest's magical essence; site of the secret seven-yearly rite renewing the Founders' vows.

label: The Far-Speaking Voice
summary: A CrMe 20 spell that delivers two minutes of one-way conversation into the mind of a target to whom the caster holds an Arcane Connection.

label: The Feengrotten
summary: Hidden crystal caves (Magic aura 1) on the eastern edge of the Thuringian Forest whose shifting passages cover explorers in glittering dust that is Imaginem vis for those genuinely lost.

label: The First Furrow Guides the Second
aliases: The First Furrow Guides the Second
The Principal Aide to the Forger's Art
summary: A Creo Imaginem 25 spell with Intellego requisite that lays a book page's image over a blank sheet so a scribe can trace it, creating identical copies and avoiding the scribing penalty.

label: The Flying Castle of Thomae
summary: A flying castle crafted by a follower of Tytalus decades ago that simply vanished from Hermetic knowledge, referenced as a treasure to hunt (via the supplement Legends of Hermes).

label: The Forest Brothers
summary: Three pagan gods of Rugen, Rugevit, Porevit, and Porenitz, representing the Rowan, the Beech, and the Larch, still worshipped by male priests called volkhvy.

label: The Forgiving Earth
summary: A Rego Terram spell that loosens earth in a 15-by-15-pace area to a depth of one foot, making packed dirt as loose as plowed ground.

label: The Forum of Hermes
summary: An enclosed miniature amphitheater at Durenmar, built on a Roman temple and flanked by statues of the Twelve Founders, where Rhine and Grand Tribunals meet.

label: The Gastronomers
summary: A large Jerbiton league whose members take turns hosting annual lavish feasts and who organize the great feasts including the Tribunicals and Seculars.

label: The Genethlialogical Investigation
summary: An Intellego Corpus 15 spell by which the caster learns a target's place and time of birth; casting it on a magus is tantamount to declaring Wizard's War.

label: The Gentle Beast
summary: A Rego Animal spell (Level 25) that calms an animal, making it nearly fearless and tolerant of being ridden or handled.

label: The Gentle Herd
summary: A ReAn 20 spell (Touch, Concentration, Group) that renders a group of animals calm and placid even while unusual events occur, ideal for soothing cattle being magically milked.

label: The Geographica
summary: A lost work by Ptolemy giving exact longitude and latitude for hundreds of legendary sites, many containing vis; House Mercere offers great quantities of vis for a complete copy.

label: The Giant's Grave
summary: A rectangular bed of large stones in the Everstorf Forest north of Schwerin, said to be the grave of a giant trapped and buried by villagers of Naschendorf.

label: The Giant's Ring
summary: The ring of great healing stones standing on a hilltop in Ireland that Merlin transported by his art to become Stonehenge in England.

label: The Giants' Castle
summary: The remains of a primeval Celtic fortress on the edge of the Bohemian Forest, with a Magic aura of 3, where large fractured rocks were originally gathered by giants who may still visit.

label: The Gift
summary: The innate capacity to work Hermetic magic; ordinarily it unsettles mundanes and animals, except for the rare Gentle Gift.

label: The Gift (child story seed)
summary: Not an entity; placeholder removed.

label: The Gift of Reason
summary: A Creo Mentem ritual (Level 35) that permanently increases the target's Intelligence by 1 point, to no higher than 0.

label: The Gift of Vigor
summary: A spell whose variants a magus attempts to use to transfer vital faculty (bodily energy such as fatigue) from a living being into a dead one.

label: The Gift (Virtue)
summary: Referenced as a Virtue covered later in the rules that allows characters to learn Supernatural Abilities and is the most important exception to Ability-use restrictions.

label: The Glade of the Seven Waterfalls
aliases: The Glade of the Seven Waterfalls
summary: A magical glade deep in the Black Forest with Magic Might 80, the remnant of the forest's original genius locus, whose peaceful spirit allows only those who complete Quests to ascend each of its seven waterfalls (regio levels).

label: The God of Law
summary: In the new dualist faith near the Bohemian Forest, the stern god who created and rules the material world but cares not for its inhabitants, falsely worshipped (the faith claims) by the Church.

label: The God of Truth
summary: The creator deity of a new dualist faith in the villages near the Bohemian Forest, said to be immaterial and found only in wild places, opposed to the God of Law; his angels are said to be faeries, and his prophet is Iacob.

label: The Great Play
summary: A tournament hosted every few years by the Shadow-Masters in which a built labyrinth or setting filled with illusions challenges participants; succeeding wins the responsibility to host the next event.

label: The Great Rot
summary: A Perdo Herbam spell (Level 25) that rots and destroys a large amount of dead wood, up to that found in a wooden house or small inn.

label: The Guide for the Perplexed
summary: A great summa on Jewish philosophy and theology written by Maimonides in 1190, infused with Aristotelian ideas, that sparked controversy among Jewish scholars.

label: The Half Shell
aliases: The Large Ship The Half Shell
summary: A large ship serving as the mobile site (an Edifice Boon) of the Swashbuckling covenant.

label: The Harz Mountains
summary: A desolate fifty-mile granite mountain range in northern Germany with gloomy forests, caves, and dwarflike folk; home to many supernatural sites.

label: The Heathen Witch Reborn
summary: A general Perdo Vim spell invented by Philippus Niger that reverses any shapechanging spell or supernatural Ability if the spell level +10 beats the shapechange.

label: The Herbal of Crateuas
summary: Crateuas's catalog of herbs and their powers, written in ancient Greek; a summa for several Abilities and rumored source of Insight into the Root-Cutter Virtue.

label: The Holm Oak of Romowe
summary: A malevolent magic spirit (Magic Might 45, currently 30 due to entrapment) bound within a massive evergreen oak in the sacred grove of Romowe; it can grant the Depression Flaw and possess those who take its branches.

label: The Holy Grail
summary: The sacred relic brought to Gaul by Mary Magdalene and revealed by Clovis to the Frankish kingdom, later lost when the Merovingian dynasty fell from grace.

label: The Horsemen
summary: Ghostly faerie riders of the Wild Hunt (Faerie Might 20) embodying icy winter storms, who can spread fear, control winds, and inflict cold; they can produce spells like Broom of the Winds.

label: The Hounds
summary: Immense insubstantial grey dogs of the Wild Hunt (Faerie Might 10) whose howls are arctic winds and whose bites inflict an effect similar to Talons of the Winds.

label: The Humble Brethren
summary: A Jerbiton league based in Rome that tries to influence the College of Cardinals to prevent an anti-magical Pope; includes mistresses of four Cardinals.

label: The Huntress in the Wood
aliases: Esoteric Mystery Cult of the Huntress in the Wood
summary: A secret society in the Order comprised mainly of followers of Bjornaer dedicated to preserving primal nature-oriented magic; unknowingly a pawn of Fenistal, guided toward seizing the Elder Gild and Irencillia.

label: The Incantation of Lightning
summary: A 6th-magnitude or greater Hermetic spell cited as an example of magic that, cast in a Magic aura, can inflict the final Warping point needed to rarefy an elemental.

label: The Incoherence of the Incoherence
summary: A book by Averroes refuting al-Ghazali's The Incoherence of the Philosophers.

label: The Incoherence of the Philosophers
summary: A book by al-Ghazali rejecting the ideas of Aristotle, Plato, and Socrates as harmful to the faithful.

label: The Incubus's Trick
summary: A spell that turns a male caster into a woman, the counterpart of The Succubus's Trick.

label: The Inexorable Hunter
summary: A magical power of the Virtuous Hound (Animal, 2 points) allowing it to flawlessly follow a creature's scent until it is located, despite the prey's ruses.

label: The Inexorable Search
summary: A spell that uses an arcane connection such as a lock of hair to locate someone; library vouchers act as arcane connections for it, and other library-location spells are based on it.

label: The Invisible Eye Revealed
summary: A spell that allows a magus to magically recognize an Intangible Tunnel and cast spells back through it.

label: The Invisible Glass-worker
summary: A ReTe 4 spell (Touch, Momentary, Individual) that transforms a piece of glass into a finished form as if shaped by a glassworker.

label: The Keepers of the Pearl of Great Price
aliases: The Keepers of the Pearl of Great Price
summary: A Jerbiton league whose members surreptitiously stave off poverty in large cities; leaderless since crusaders sacked their Constantinople headquarters.

label: The Keepers of the Thousand Tales
aliases: The Keepers of the Thousand Tales
summary: A group of Merinita magi and companions formed in the Holy Land to collect, catalog, and spread the greatest stories, believing faerie immortality is ensured through legend; they have covenants in the Levant and Iberian Tribunals.

label: The Key of Theodorus
summary: A ReTe 5 Hermetic spell (R: Touch, D: Mom, T: Part) that magically opens any single lock regardless of complexity, named for Theodorus of Samos.

label: The King's Goblet
summary: A wondrous gold cup that trembles in the holder's hand if a poisoned beverage is poured into it (Craft Level 13).

label: The Kiss of Death
summary: A Perdo Corpus spell (Level 45) by which the person kissed dies suddenly, leaving only the black imprint of the caster's lips; requires no spoken words.

label: The Konigstuhl
summary: A 380-foot chalk cliff on Rugen; legend says whoever climbs it from the sea becomes king of Rugen, as Valdemar I did, and cheaters fail.

label: The Laboratory of Bonisagus
summary: A Creo Terram 45 ritual that furnishes an empty chamber with a fully equipped standard Hermetic laboratory better than normal, granting Flawless Equipment, Flawless Tools, and Spotless.

label: The Leap of Homecoming
summary: A teleportation spell; each Redcap carries an enchanted item casting a higher-level version once per day to return himself and his horse to Mercer House.

label: The Lens of Wisdom
summary: A crystal lens bound in brass that, focusing the summer-solstice noon sun on a blank parchment, burns indecipherable glyphs into the page, each page containing Intellego vis.

label: The Lightning-Bringer
summary: A highly magical device of copper spheres, gold rods, and enchanted glass vessels invented by a Tremere Archimagus; on each new moon it summons a thunderstorm and accumulates its lightning as Auram vis.

label: The Limit of Aging
summary: A lesser limit of Hermetic magic: it cannot halt or reverse natural aging or remove Decrepitude, only slow it.

label: The Limit of Creation
summary: A lesser limit of Hermetic magic: it cannot create anything permanently without raw vis.

label: The Limit of Energy
summary: A lesser limit of Hermetic magic: it cannot restore physical energy (Fatigue levels) or Confidence.

label: The Limit of Experience
summary: A lesser limit of Hermetic magic: it cannot create or transfer skills, knowledge, or Abilities in a person.

label: The Limit of Magic Resistance
summary: A limit noting that non-Hermetic magic (and Faerie powers) cannot grant general Magic Resistance, though Hermetic magic can.

label: The Limit of the Infernal
summary: A lesser limit of Hermetic magic: Intellego magic is almost useless against the Infernal, revealing only what demons want believed.

label: The Limit of the Soul
summary: A lesser limit of Hermetic magic: it cannot create an immortal soul, true human life, or restore the dead to life.

label: The Limit of Time
summary: A lesser limit of Hermetic magic: it cannot alter the passage of time, affect the past, or scry on past or future.

label: The Limit of Vis
summary: A lesser limit of Hermetic magic: it cannot change the Art to which raw vis is attuned.

label: The Limit of Warping
summary: A lesser limit of Hermetic magic: it cannot affect warping changes once they have happened; Wizard's Twilight is one manifestation.

label: The Linden of Neustadt
summary: A protective Forest spirit (Magic Might 30) manifesting as a great lime tree that has adopted the town of Neustadt as its realm and grants victory and virtues to the town's defenders.

label: The Line of Quendalon
summary: The lineage of magi descended from Quendalon who Initiate the three Arcadian Mysteries; many are Seekers devoted to experimental research, sometimes called 'The Last Commission' for Bonisagus's reputed charge.

label: The Lineage of Pralix
summary: An Ex Miscellanea tradition descended from Pralix that inducts hedge wizards into the Order, jointly trains apprentices, and grants the Comprehend Magic virtue.

label: The Long Man of Wilmington
summary: A figure about 240 feet tall picked out by trenches on a Sussex hillside, grasping two staves; said variously to represent St. Paul or the keeper of the gates of dawn who may open them for travelers.

label: The Lotharingians
summary: A faction of northwestern Rhine covenants seeking to secede from the Rhine Tribunal to deal more freely with mundanes, forming the proposed Lotharingian Tribunal.

label: The Luneburg Heath
summary: A wild heathland south of Luneburg where shepherds tend flocks of Heidschnucken, goat-sheep crossbreeds descended from Corsican mouflon.

label: The Lyceum
summary: A Hermetic societas of about eight rationalist magi led by Venatus Trianomae, named after Aristotle's school; they promote the New Aristotle and the seven liberal arts and reject the empiricist Collegium.

label: The Magestones of Verditius
summary: Onyx-pebble enchanted devices crafted by Verditius, each bearing a powerful Creo Vim effect that manifests a Magic aura of 3; three were secretly gifted to Oculus Septentrionalis, the rest guarded by Durenmar, and their technique was never replicated.

label: The Magic Fountain
summary: A spring near the Brocken that grants visions to those who drink from it.

label: The Many-hued Conflagration
summary: A Muto Ignem spell (Level 5) that makes a fire burn brightly in shifting colors, potentially blinding onlookers for a round if they fail a Stamina roll.

label: The Margravate of Brandenburg
summary: The only notable city of the Margravate east of the Elbe, occupying an old Wendish settlement across three islands in the River Havel, with a cathedral and the first bishopric east of the Elbe.

label: The Margravate of Lusatia
summary: A mainly forest-wilderness margravate east of the Elbe bordering Silesia, populated by Sorbs and ruled by the margraves of Meissen.

label: The Margravate of Meissen
summary: The most civilized of the Eastern Marches, a rolling land ruled by the Wettin dynasty since 1089; the last Hermetic covenant here, Sirmium, was destroyed in the 10th century.

label: The Marvelous Hound
summary: A Muto Animal (Corpus, Mentem) 34 enchanted collar that transforms a normal hound into an erect, handed servant with a grog's intellect while retaining hound loyalty.

label: The Master of Naumburg
summary: A young, enigmatic architect and sculptor of German origin who travels Germany working on great churches; some claim his unmatched work is aided by sorcery.

label: The Maze of Singing Mirrors
summary: A repository where copies of all recordings made by the Daughters of Echo are kept and sold to Jerbiton magi unable to attend performances.

label: The Mice of the Mauseturm
summary: Demonic mouse swarms (Infernal Might 10) with fiery teeth, immune to fire, that infest the Mouse Tower island and are spontaneously generated by its Infernal aura.

label: The Milites
summary: A Minor Story Flaw for a House Flambeau character who is a member of the milites, granting brotherhood and 5 House Acclaim points but binding the character to obey the Primus.

label: The Miner's Keen Eye
summary: An Intellego Terram spell that lets the caster see a specified type of mineral through up to 3 paces of intervening material.

label: The Miniature of Immortality
summary: A ritual Creo Herbam spell (Level 20) that creates a painted miniature of a person or scene on a wooden panel within voice range.

label: The Mirror of Dreams
summary: An ornate gold-framed enchanted mirror in Arliandus's sanctum that visualizes a subject's thoughts to aid Mentem lab work, but causes Warping Points and disturbing dreams.

label: The Motivated Plow
summary: A Rego Terram 15 enchanted plow-shaped device that transforms hard-packed earth into well-plowed soil in a circle; based on The Forgiving Earth and doing the work of about three laborers.

label: The Mouse Tower
summary: The Mauseturm, a half-ruined slender tower on a small island at the mouth of the Bingen Hole built by Hatto II, now haunted by his demonic shade and infested with demonic mice (Infernal aura 3).

label: The Mundane
summary: That which is not supernatural; areas not occupied by another realm, having no aura rating, consisting of ordinary people and places.

label: The Mysteries Revised Edition
summary: An Ars Magica supplement detailing Mysteries such as Hermetic Theurgy, Names of Power, Invocation Magic, Hermetic Synthemata, Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes, and the Inscription on the Soul Virtue.

label: The Mystical Carpenter
summary: A ReHe 25 spell (Touch, Momentary, Group) that cuts, splits, carves, and joins a pile of wood into a desired form, substituting Perception + Finesse for Craft: Carpenter.

label: The nameless goblin
summary: A goblin noble who rebelled against the goblin king and was stripped of his name and transformed into a stalactite; the stalagmite he grows beneath himself yields Terram vis when ground to powder.

label: The Nemthengacha
summary: A sect of Ex Miscellanea magi found among Celtic and Scandinavian sorcerers who use the Embitterment power to create animosity and turn people against allies.

label: The New Iconophiles
summary: A Jerbiton league, led ideologically by the Primus, attempting to recover the artistic treasures of Constantinople; based in Valnastium.

label: The Obedient Fire
summary: A ReIg 20 spell that controls the rate and direction a fire spreads, able to make it move as fast as a man walks; the fire's heat is non-magical and bypasses Magic Resistance.

label: The Odenwald
summary: A German forest that comes into bloom earliest and most spectacularly, an ideal site for the Court of the Alder Prince, with bandits lurking on its western edge.

label: The Old Ones
summary: Powerful magical creatures who died or fell asleep millennia ago; finding the resting place of one of them is listed as a possible object of a quest.

label: The Ore Mountains
summary: A bleak, unsettled range covered with evergreen forest adjoining the Spruce Mountains in Franconia, where silver and tin have recently been discovered, giving rise to mining towns like Freiberg.

label: The (Over) Familiar Cat
summary: A magical familiar cat with Magic Might 10 (Imaginem) bonded to a magus, with powers of night-vision and invisible movement and shared-senses bond effects.

label: The Path of Beacons
summary: A Criamon path lacking a clutch that teaches Mysteries allowing each magus to create a sanctuary from the strife of the world; its eldest magus lives in a regio on the Isle of Arran.

label: The Path of Orpheus
summary: A rumored great ritual following Orpheus's trek into the Underworld to restore a beloved to the living world, requiring vast vis and Wizard's Communion.

label: The Path of Seeming
summary: A Criamon path drawing on the insight that the Enigma's secrets are hidden in the distracting details of the world, searching for weak points in the circle of time.

label: The Path of Strife
summary: The Criamon path of worldly magic that transgresses House morality; its servants kill, lie, and destroy demons to prolong the universe, and they cannot enter Final Twilight.

label: The Path of the Body
summary: A Criamon path focusing on the human form as a microcosm of the universe, with stations including the Perfect Tool, Spiritual Nourishment, Perfect Movement, the Microcosm, and Corporeal Repose.

label: The Path of the Mirror
summary: The Criamon path followed only by living Primi under instruction of their predecessors, a series of Initiations for those who choose to serve the worldly House.

label: The Path of Walking Backwards
summary: A newer Criamon path brought by Abdkypris from the Sufi, involving complete surrender to the harmonic force to flee back to the Spharios; uses dancing/spinning meditation.

label: The Phantom Blacksmith
summary: A ReTe 20 spell (Touch, Momentary, Group) that transforms ready iron into a crafted result as if worked by a blacksmith to the magus's instructions.

label: The Phantom Gift
summary: A Creo Vim spell that makes the target appear tainted with magic as most magi are, causing beasts and people to react to him as a magus.

label: The Pharmacopoeians
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus collect magical ingredients to reduce the vis cost of healing Rituals; defining Virtue of the Pharmacopoeians.

label: The Pipers
summary: Two immense standing stones near the Merry Maidens, said to be demons sent to tempt the dancing girls who were unable to flee divine justice and turned to stone.

label: The Pirates' Graveyards
summary: A haunted region in Drenthe near the River Ems where pirates of Friesia bury their dead under standing stones; Lucas von Beck harvests vis and bodies there for necromancy, though its power may not be magical.

label: The Places I've Been - You Wouldn't Believe Me
aliases: The Places I've Been - You Wouldn't Believe Me
summary: A book describing a Greek Isles covenant whose soldiers ride gigantic terrapins into naval battle.

label: The Plunder of Twenty Geese
summary: A Muto Animal 15 spell that transforms up to 100 feathers into goose wing feathers preferred for pens; a Rego variant at level 20 strips and tempers the pens.

label: The Poet's Bust
summary: A Rego Terram spell (Level 5) that changes a block of stone into a carved bust of a person the caster touches.

label: The Ponderers of Weight and Distance
aliases: The Ponderers of Weight and Distance
summary: A Jerbiton league of merchant magi interested in gaining money through mundane trade and manipulating economies, seemingly based in the Rhineland.

label: The Private Speech of Eros and Psyche
aliases: The Private Speech of Eros and Psyche
summary: An In(Cr)Me 60 ritual Orphic spell allowing the magos and a target to speak mentally at will, regardless of distance, for one year.

label: The Prodigious Plant Pot
summary: A large clay pot enchanted (CrHe 30) that grows a seed into a mature plant in a day, adding to a lab's Experimentation and Herbam Specializations; made by Ricardus Caespuus.

label: The Remote Entrance Portal
summary: A Rego Corpus 50 enchanted device acting as a magical transporter activated only from within a covenant, moving seen targets up to 500 paces inside without arcane connections.

label: The Resolute Mind of the Tireless Researcher
aliases: The Resolute Mind of the Tireless Researcher
summary: A Rego Mentem Level 20 spell devised by Andreas of House Bonisagus that fixes a magus's mind on lab work for a day; daily use warps the mind and requires the Addled lab routine.

label: The Rhine Gorge
summary: The narrow, castle-lined stretch of the Rhine between Bingen and Koblenz where nobles enforce tolls; the focus of the saga and supposedly cursed, with all its covenants failing within seven decades.

label: The Rhinefalls
summary: The greatest waterfalls in Europe near the southeastern edge of the Black Forest, with a central rocky island holding a Magic aura and a regio leading to the Rhine spirit's realm.

label: The Riches That are Rightfully Mine(d)
aliases: The Riches That are Rightfully Mine(d)
summary: A CrTe 35 ritual spell (Touch, Momentary, Individual) that fills a chest with up to ten cubic feet of silver pennies, worth about 2000 Mythic Pounds; a copy resides in the Great Library of Durenmar.

label: The Riesenstein
summary: A great stone near Zuschen hurled by the Devil at the village of Neueburg; it bears three red stains that weep bloody tears worth Ignem vis every All Hallow's Eve.

label: The Rooster's Crow
summary: A PeVi Sound-Target spell that strips Might from demons who hear the caster's shout if it penetrates their Magic Resistance.

label: The Rosstrappe
summary: A rock across a ravine from the Hexentanzplatz bearing a giant horse's hoofprint, from the legendary leap of Princess Brunhilde fleeing the knight Bodo.

label: The Rottweiler
summary: A characteristic black-and-tan dog breed of the Black Forest, bred from Roman dogs and wild dark faerie species; some have faerie blood granting longevity and Second Sight, and at least one Rhine magus uses them instead of grogs.

label: The Rumaquelle
summary: A magical green-watered spring in the southern Harz, said to be where Ruma, daughter of the dwarf king, surfaced as a stream to reunite with the giant Romer.

label: The Rusticani
summary: An obscure tradition of folk magicians in House Ex Miscellanea who build spells and enchanted devices from mundane objects and live among common people.

label: The Salernitarian Women
summary: A famous group of women at Salerno studying medicine, renowned as obstetricians and surgeons, legendarily credited with curing the Duke of Normandy.

label: The Sanctuary of Hercules
summary: A hidden cave of magical springs on the western Vosges, with a Magic aura of 3, where the Gauls worshiped Ogmios and the Romans Hercules, ringed with ancient altars.

label: The Schwanenburg
summary: An old castle on a hill overlooking Cleves by the Rhine, named after the Knight of the Swan, Lohengrin.

label: The Scribe's Touch
summary: A Perdo Animal 3 spell that trims the magus's quill with the flick of a finger.

label: The Severed Limb Made Whole
summary: A Creo Corpus ritual (Level 25) that reattaches a detached limb, though decay on the severed limb persists after reattachment.

label: The Shadow-Masters
summary: A troupe of Merinita magi who, using Plato's cave allegory, fashion illusory figures and stories to reinforce belief in the imaginary; they host the Great Play and Initiate Glamour, Animae Magic, and Perpetuity.

label: The Shadow of Human Life
summary: A Creo Imaginem spell (Level 40) with a Mentem requisite that gives a human image (as in Phantasm of the Human Form) limited freedom and simulated intellect, functioning as a stupid independent human.

label: The Shadow of Life Renewed
summary: A Creo Corpus ritual (Level 75) with a Mentem requisite that brings the semblance of life to a corpse; the closest the Order of Hermes has come to raising the dead.

label: The Shrouded Glen
summary: A Mentem spell that conceals a location from discovery; because it affects minds and not animals, a hunted deer could lead hunters to a covenant protected by it.

label: The Silent Ones
summary: A Jerbiton league dedicated to integrating the Silent Magic and Subtle Magic Virtues into standard Hermetic practice, led by a Bonisagus magus.

label: The Silent Vigil
summary: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 45) with a Terram requisite that lets the caster move into and become part of a rock formation at least twice their size.

label: The Singers in Hollow Rooms
summary: An example Jerbiton league that calls up the ghosts of ancient artists; its homages involve constructing or searching for tombs.

label: The Single Ocean
summary: A Jerbiton league exploring the cities of the Levant and North Africa, seeking peaceful relationships with Jewish and Muslim sorcerers, led by Edward the White.

label: The Sorcerer's Fork
summary: A Muto Vim spell that splits another spell into two or more identical spells of reduced power against separate targets.

label: The Source of the Danube
summary: An enchanted spring in the eastern Black Forest, source of the River Danube, with a Faerie aura and a regio whose top level holds a gateway into Arcadia and abundant Aquam vis; presided over by the faerie Danu.

label: The Spell of Wrought Iron
summary: A ReTe 15 spell (Touch, Momentary, Group) that transforms raw pig-iron into plain bars of wrought iron, separating out the slag.

label: The Sphinx
summary: A legendary monument near the Pyramids in Egypt studied by magi who erected an open-desert laboratory beside it.

label: The Spider
summary: A character from The Travels of Fedoso who may assist player characters in a faerie wood; possibly a spirit or faerie said to have predicted the depredations of an evil magus.

label: The Stone of Death
summary: An ancient stone aligned to the winter-solstice sunset; during the third decan of Gemini, daily animal sacrifices made at the rising of Saturn cause Perdo vis to form from the blood.

label: The Stultified Peasant
summary: A Perdo Mentem spell that destroys a target's imagination, removing his ability to think and leaving him standing mouth open.

label: The Subtle Chain
summary: Philippus Niger's enchanted silver chain that forms a 3-pace circle and creates a variety of once-per-day warding effects against demons, spirits, beasts, and faeries.

label: The Succubus's Trick
summary: A MuCo 5 spell that causes a female caster to adopt male physical characteristics; named after gender-changing demons of lust.

label: The Swabian Jura
summary: A series of harsh limestone hills separating the Danube and Neckar valleys, dotted with stalactite grottos such as the Nebelhöhle and Wimsener Höhle.

label: The Teufelskuche
summary: A forgotten stone circle and altar in the Haldensleben Forest near Magdeburg where the pagan god Woden was worshipped; it is the origin of the Wild Hunt.

label: The Teufelsloch
summary: A giant eroded hole in the hills west of Laach Lake with steep treacherous edges and an Infernal aura of 1, named the Devil's Hole by locals.

label: The Teufelsmoor
summary: An extensive swampy peat wasteland northeast of Bremen with an ill reputation, almost always mist-covered and shunned by locals; a possible covenant location.

label: The Teutoburger Forest
summary: A forested hill region in Saxony with powerful tree guardians (Magic Might 50), site of a famous victory over Roman legions, who remain trapped in a regio at its heart.

label: The Three Faerie Cords
summary: Three additional negative cords (leaden, iron, tin) discovered by Farrago Bonisagi that permanently bind a faerie familiar by hindering the maga's mind, body, and spirit to offset cord decay.

label: The Thuringian Forest
summary: One of Germany's largest forests, covering nearly a hundred miles of the Thuringia-Franconia border, the traditional boundary between northern and southern Germany.

label: The Tireless Servant
summary: An animated skeleton automaton (ReCo 25/40) that fetches and holds objects on verbal command, adding to a lab's General Quality and Safety.

label: The Titans
summary: Primordial spirits who, per House Tytalus belief, created the world and man before being imprisoned by the gods of Olympus; Tytalus contacted their shades and employed them against Guorna.

label: The Travels of Fedoso
summary: An epic poem written by the Primus Verderis used by apprentices to learn Latin, claimed by many Criamon to be a prophetic map of the House's future.

label: The Treacherous Spear
summary: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 25) that animates a wooden or wooden-hafted melee weapon in someone else's hand, making it attack its holder until the wielder dies or the weapon is destroyed.

label: The Trier Amphitheater
summary: A large oval Roman amphitheater outside Trier's walls (Magic aura 1-2) on the Hermesstrasse, haunted by three ghostly gladiators who challenge visitors to duels and where Mentem vis can be harvested.

label: The Trumpet of Ghostly Summoning
summary: A small enchanted silver trumpet from Arliandus's sanctum that, when blown, summons forth and reveals ghosts or spirits in the area.

label: The Twice-Gifted Coin
summary: A PeMe 15 spell (Touch, Momentary, Individual) that erases the target's memory of having paid a coin, so he pays again; sometimes enchanted into a toll-gate.

label: The Unbidden Task
summary: A MuMe 25 spell that creates a recurring prospective memory in a target, prompting them to infer and act on a reason for it.

label: The Unnamed Cabal
summary: A House Tytalus cabal, symbolized by a counterclockwise swirl of five lines, whose goal is to keep the other cabals in conflict; supposedly composed of the most powerful Tytalus Archmagi.

label: The Unseen Porter
summary: A Rego Terram spell like Unseen Arm that can carry large inanimate objects with the strength of a very strong person.

label: The Venusberg
summary: A splendid subterranean home of the goddess Venus beneath a mountain in an unknown spot in Germany, discovered by the knight Tannhäuser.

label: The Verminous Infestation
summary: A Rego Animal spell (Req: Perdo, Corpus) that infests a target with fleshworms in his intestines, inflicting the Worms disease immediately.

label: The Virtuous Hound
summary: A magical beast with Magic Might 10 (Animal), an intelligent bloodhound recruited as covenfolk who can flawlessly track prey and speak; based on the bloodhound from The Book of Mundane Beasts.

label: The Vitalizer of Provisions
summary: A Creo Animal (Herbam) 19 enchanted chest that preserves food placed within it, preventing decay while the door remains closed.

label: The Viticulturalists
summary: A Jerbiton league that believes peasant life has virtue and engages in magically assisted manorial agriculture, led by Sabina of the Seine.

label: The Voice of the Bjornaer Magus
aliases: The Voice of the Bjornaer Magus
summary: A Muto Animal 15 spell allowing a Bjornaer caster in animal form to speak with a human voice, cast without words or gestures.

label: The Vosges Mountains
summary: A mountain range bounding Upper Lorraine to the east, once dominated by a secretive fir spirit that was extinguished by the planting of the holy staff at Thann.

label: The Walking Corpse
summary: A spell that animates a corpse into an automaton; such corpses use a revenant's physical statistics but are not supernatural and have no Might score or Magic Resistance.

label: The Wartburg
summary: A great unbreached castle near Eisenach, ancestral home of the landgraves of Thuringia and famed center of literature and music hosting the Sangerkrieg.

label: The Wayfarers
summary: A group of Merinitae who style themselves Arcadian experts, recording earthly gateway locations and guiding travelers into Faerie; they typically Initiate Arcadian Travel and rival House Mercere's Redcaps.

label: The Weightless Transportation of Books
summary: A Perdo Animal 25 spell that makes the books within a chest almost weightless, easing transport or reducing a library's load on covenant floors.

label: The Welcome Addition of False Sunlight
aliases: The Welcome Addition of False Sunlight
summary: A Creo Ignem 15 spell creating a steady, cool, smokeless, non-flickering light; often enchanted into library devices that float, embed in ceilings, or overlook desks.

label: The White Horse of Uffington
summary: A horse figure carved into a Berkshire hillside that can rise and move about the country or Arcadia as a white horse of surpassing beauty, uncontrollable by mortals.

label: The Wild Huntsman
summary: A grim Unseelie faerie lord (Faerie Might 50) on an immense black horse, focus of every Wild Hunt, perhaps once a fragment of Woden, who seeks to maintain winter's hold on the land.

label: The Winding Path
summary: The 'path' of Criamon magi who do not consciously develop themselves spiritually; the widest path of directionlessness, first followed by Juliasta.

label: The Wizard's Bridle
summary: Philippus Niger's feared magical item, a head frame and shackles that trap a victim's tongue and limbs to prevent casting, enchanted with Bind The Gift and Hinder the Gift; used once to restrain a Marched Tytalus magus.

label: The Wizard's Mount
summary: A Creo Animal spell (Level 35) that creates a horse normal in every way except that it is not disturbed by The Gift.

label: The Wound that Weeps
summary: A Perdo Corpus spell (PeCo15) cited to illustrate how the Harmless Magic Flaw makes a wound briefly bleed then close again.

label: The Ziegensteine
summary: A megalithic barrow of stone slabs under a giant oak near Monchgut on Rugen, used as a cemetery by the volkhvy; secretly a faerie-trod gateway through Arcadia to the Novgorod covenant Pripet Major.

label: Theban League
summary: A military alliance formed by magi in the north of the Empire to resist the emperor, the Infernal, and House Tremere; they joined the Order under Jerbiton's nominal leadership and later founded the Tribunal of Thebes.

label: Theban Legion
summary: A legion of early Christians, including St. Victor, said by legend to have died at the Roman colony that became Xanten.

label: Theban Tribunal magus Lucian
summary: Duplicate placeholder removed.

label: Thebes Tribunal
summary: A Tribunal where vis is scarce and magical animals plentiful, where Verditius magi developed the Bind Magical Creatures Mystery.

label: Thelxiope
summary: The founder of the Seirenes, a Greek woman saved by the sirens and taught their magic, who then traveled Europe rescuing and training Gifted girls.

label: Theobald
summary: A bishop of Gubbio in Umbria whose episcopal ring and thumb, carried by his loyal servant, miraculously rooted a staff into the ground in the Vosges, leading to the founding of Thann Chapel.

label: Theocracy
summary: A covenant governance form in which the magi rule as priests through lesser priests, as in the Worshipful covenant.

label: Theoderich of Augsburg
aliases: Theoderich of Augsburg, Follower of Jerbiton
summary: A journeyman of House Jerbiton at Heorot, formerly of Oculus Septentrionalis, a necromancer and historian who raises ghosts to interrogate them about the past.

label: Theodore Lascaris
summary: The Byzantine Emperor living in exile in Nicea, whose agent seeks the magi's help to contact the goddess Hecate and expel the Latin usurpers from Constantinople.

label: Theodorus of Samos
summary: The sixth-century Greek inventor credited with creating the first locks in Mythic Europe; namesake of the spell The Key of Theodorus.

label: Theology
summary: The highest-ranked Academic Ability concerning religious doctrine, with faith-specific variants (Christian, Islamic, Judaic) used for writing books and disputationes against other faiths.

label: Theology: Islam
summary: An Ability a Mamluk character may take even without the Educated Virtue, reflecting his religious education in a military school.

label: Theology: Judaism
summary: An Academic Ability that is the Jewish equivalent of Theology: Christian, drawing on the Torah, Nevi'im, and Kutuvim.

label: Theophilus
summary: The monk credited as author of the craft manual On Divers Arts.

label: Theopholus of House Jerbiton
summary: A magus of House Jerbiton with the Gentle Gift who covertly teaches Magic Theory to university students to find naturally inclined Gifted individuals and recruit covenant members.

label: Thera
summary: A volcanic island, site of Akrotiri, whose ancient people discovered many magical and technological secrets; now infested with vampires.

label: Theriac (cure-all)
summary: A wonderful cure-all for any ailment sold by traveling empirici, often claimed to be from a secret family recipe; real theriacs exist but most sold are pondwater and grass.

label: Theriomorphy
summary: A Minor House Mystery of Bjornaer allowing a magus to apply a Quality or Virtue of his Heartbeast to his human form via partial physical change.

label: Thessalonica
summary: Site of a great fair (the Demetria) rivaling Champagne in size and goods; its proximity to Constantinople makes eastern luxuries readily available.

label: Thetis
summary: A sea nymph who, with Eurynome, rescued and raised the cast-out Hephaestus and built him an underwater forge.

label: Theurgic Spirit Familiar
summary: A Mystery Virtue the Titanoi cult can Initiate.

label: Theurgy
summary: A Hermetic Mystery of summoning and dealing with spirits, including Aspects of Daimons, requiring synthemata and long invocations; ordinary Hermetic magic cannot summon a Daimon's Aspect without it.

label: Thief of Emotions
summary: A new Major Supernatural Virtue granting the Emotion Theft Supernatural Ability to remove an emotion from one person and transfer it to another; the second Fruit of the Arcadian Path.

label: Thief's Slippers
summary: Wondrous shoes that let the wearer move without making a sound (Craft Level 15).

label: Thierry of Chartres
summary: A scholar who taught at the cathedral school of Chartres.

label: Thoroughfare
summary: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: supernatural creatures such as gnomes pass through the lab and cause minor nuisance (-1 Safety).

label: Thoughts Distinctly Burned
summary: A Rego Aquam 15 spell that controls ink so it forms patterns on pages corresponding to the magus's spoken words.

label: Thoughts within Babble
summary: An Intellego Mentem spell (Level 25) that lets the caster understand the speech of those within the target area, including misused language.

label: Through the Aegis
summary: An Ars Magica supplement containing five fully developed covenants, one for each season plus one that returned from Winter to Spring.

label: Thrown Weapon
summary: The missile-combat Ability used for thrown weapons such as the throwing axe, javelin, knife, and sling.

label: Thunor
summary: An old Germanic thunder god worshiped by the German tribes.

label: Thuringia
summary: A landlocked upland region of the Rhine Tribunal bounded by the Kyffhauser Mountains and the Thuringian Forest, quaint rather than bustling.

label: Tie the Threads That Bind
summary: A general-level Rego Vim ritual formulaic spell used uniquely to unite an automaton's magic into a cohesive unit, requiring a level equal to the construct's Magic Might + 15.

label: Tierent
summary: A 12th-century Verditius magus who adapted the Bind Magical Creatures Mystery to affect creatures with Faerie Might.

label: Tillitus of House Bonisagus
summary: A magus of House Bonisagus of the covenant Semita Errabunda who invents Rego Vim warding spells against magical creatures in a spell-invention example.

label: Tincture of Parsley
summary: A Theriac of Level 10, Potency Strong, a herbal infusion that acts as an antidote to any serpent bite when consumed immediately after the bite.

label: Tinderdry
summary: A Level 5 alchemical Reagent, a wool-like substance that when rubbed over damp wood dries it enough to be lit with flint and steel.

label: Tintagel
summary: A near-island stronghold off the coast of Cornwall, the seat of Gorlois and later King Mark, and the site of Arthur's conception; it may be detached from the mundane world, with a chapel of St. Juliot helping keep it from reappearing.

label: Tip of the Tongue
summary: A Perdo Mentem spell (Level 5) that causes the target to forget one word of the caster's choosing for the spell's duration.

label: Titania
summary: A faerie queen who gifted the King of England a hippogriff that fell ill from London's strong Divine aura.

label: Titanoi
summary: A Mystery Cult lineage within House Tytalus, heirs to the goetic and spirit-summoning magical tradition of Guorna and Tytalus; nearly destroyed during the Betrayal and revived after the Schism War.

label: Titanoi Cult Lore
summary: A cult lore Ability taught to magi raised in the Titanoi Mystery Cult of House Tytalus.

label: Tius
summary: The battle god of the Germans, worshiped by Hermann and the Cheruski, whose priests' magic aided the tribes at the Teutoburger Forest.

label: Tobias
summary: An example swineherd whose body Antigone inhabits during a psychodramatic Quest on the Avenue of the Unexpected Pages, charged with delivering a candlestick.

label: Toledo
summary: A Spanish town whose charter requires a man's wife to live permanently in the town for him to gain citizenship, preventing itinerant merchants from claiming multiple citizenships.

label: Tolosa Paratge
summary: An ancient covenant in Toulouse in the Provencal Tribunal, completely split between two factions, the White and the Black, a rivalry that may bring it down.

label: Tom the Cutpurse
summary: An example agent of Carolus, a thief with a Bond of Gratitude who is asked to steal a mayor's signet ring using Dexterity plus Legerdemain.

label: Tonic of Gold
summary: A Theriac of Level 5, Potency Weak, made with minute quantities of gold, that restores a Winded character to a non-fatigued state.

label: Tormenting Master
summary: A Major Story Flaw in which the character's master does not believe he passed the apprentice's gauntlet and periodically troubles him with political moves; applicable to magi.

label: Torture Chair of Zeus
summary: A mechanized chair Hephaestus made that Zeus used to torture Hera; rediscovered by Milo and prize of the first Verditius Contest, won by Gelon.

label: Torven
summary: A reclusive young hedge wizard of Waldheim with Latent Magical Ability who befriends forest creatures and is accompanied by the faerie wolf Red-Hame.

label: Touch of Midas
summary: A ritual Creo Terram spell that creates a roughly spherical lump of gold about six inches across, enough wealth for a peasant family for centuries.

label: Touch of the Goose Feather
summary: A Perdo Corpus spell (Level 5) that causes the target to let out a loud sneeze, disrupting concentration and activities.

label: Touch of the Pearls
summary: An Intellego Aquam spell (Level 5) that tells the caster whether a touched liquid is poisonous, like a pearl, without tasting it.

label: Tough
summary: A Minor Virtue acquirable by a Bjornaer inner heartbeast and suitable for beasts such as the bear, boar, and wolf; stacks with Thick Fur and Tough Hide for Protection.

label: Toul
summary: A venerable city forty miles up the Mosel from Metz, formerly Roman Tullum, surrounded by tall white stone walls and remaining loyal to its duke.

label: Toulouse
summary: A location in the Provencal Tribunal where the covenant of Tolosa Paratge resides.

label: Tower of London
summary: A London fortress whose grounds contain the Royal Menagerie housing exotic animals gifted to the King of England, including the ailing faerie hippogriff.

label: Tower of Notatus
summary: A tower at Durenmar conjured by and named after the first Primus of House Bonisagus; it houses most Bonisagus magi and Murion's sanctum.

label: Tower of Trianoma
summary: The youngest of Durenmar's three towers, named in honor of Trianoma; its basement houses one of the Rhine's official Mercer Houses.

label: Tower of Whirling Water
summary: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 35) that forms a waterspout under the caster's mental direction, damaging and potentially drowning those it hits.

label: Town Magistrate
summary: A Minor Social Status Virtue granting a position of judicial responsibility in a town with a small staff of officials, requiring citizenship and a score of 3 in Civil and Canon Law (or Common Law).

label: Tracing the Trail of Death's Stench
aliases: Tracing the Trail of Death's Stench
summary: A spell used by Donatores to locate the corporeal remains of a spirit from the location of its death or gravesite.

label: Trackless Step
summary: A Rego Terram spell that leaves no tracks in the earth until the caster stops; draws on pre-Hermetic traditions.

label: Tracks of the Faerie Glow
summary: A spell used in a Performance Magic example; its Hunter's variant is cast by Harold using Performance Magic (Hunt) to gain magically enhanced vision while hunting.

label: Tractatus
summary: A short book conveying an author's insights on a subject, studied once for experience; breakthroughs and encyclopedia volumes are disseminated as tractatus.

label: Traditional Ward
summary: A taboo that a faerie may not touch with its glamour; it cannot regenerate Might in the ward's presence and is harmed if forced to touch it.

label: Traditionalists
summary: A philosophical faction within House Guernicus that believes the Code should be preserved as it has been since the Founding.

label: Tragic Life
summary: A Major Story Tainted Flaw in which the character's life has been manipulated by demons so that she will act to her own detriment at a pivotal moment of destiny.

label: Trained Assassin
summary: A Minor General Virtue available only to characters with a Nizari Social Status Virtue, granting 50 experience points in Martial Abilities, Athletics, Guile, or Stealth.

label: Transform to Water
summary: A spell whose constant effect is mimicked by the Water sample elemental form of a Bjornaer chimera or anima heartbeast.

label: Transformation of the Ravenous Beast to the Torpid Toad
aliases: Transformation of the Ravenous Beast to the Torpid Toad
summary: A Muto Animal (MuAn 25) spell known by the Bjornaer template magus that transforms an animal into a toad.

label: Transformation of the Thorny Staff
summary: A Muto Herbam spell (Level 10) that causes a length of wood to grow thick sharp thorns; adds +4 damage if cast on a staff.

label: Transitionalists
summary: A philosophical faction within House Guernicus, started by Simprim, that believes the Code should be revised and seeks greater legal powers for the Quaesitores.

label: Transmission
summary: The process by which a Criamon magus passes learned wisdom on to other members of the House, sometimes encapsulating it perfectly into a place or object upon entering Twilight.

label: Trap of the Entwining Vines
summary: A Creo Herbam (CrHe 15) indirect spell whose vines surround and prevent a maga from moving without completely immobilizing her.

label: Trapping the Fire
summary: A Muto Ignem spell (Level 25) with a Terram requisite that turns the heat and flames of a large campfire into a small hard object such as a gem; breaking the object releases the flame.

label: Treading the Ashen Path
summary: A Perdo Herbam spell (Level 30) that withers and destroys plant material in front of the caster as they walk up to 7 miles; invented by a magus of House Flambeau.

label: Treasure of the Nibelungs
summary: The great treasure Siegfried won from the Nibelungs, later sunk in the Rhine by Hagen and lost forever after the tragedy of the Nibelungenlied.

label: Tree Falling in the Forest
summary: A Pe(Re)He 35 spell that instantly cuts down a tree in a chosen direction; with an aiming roll it can fall on a creature for up to +18 damage and bypasses Magic Resistance.

label: Tremulous Vault of the Torch's Flame
aliases: Tremulous Vault of the Torch's Flame
summary: A Rego Ignem spell (Level 5) that causes a fire to quiver and then leap up to 10 feet in any direction; a Targeting roll is required to hit a specific target.

label: Tres Ex Miscellanea
summary: A rustic magus tried at the Provencal Tribunal of 1214 for interfering with mundanes after declaring Wizard's War and destroying a rival covenant's tower with an army.

label: Trethevy Quoit
summary: A group of standing stones supporting a capstone, believed to be the home of a powerful faerie who does not like to be disturbed.

label: Trevelyan
summary: The first Trevelyan, the only man who escaped the drowning of Lyonesse by riding his white horse ahead of the flood to St. Michael's Mount.

label: Treverorum
summary: A former covenant in the city of Trier dedicated to recovering lost Roman secrets, approved in 1095 AD; abolished in 1172 AD after its magi repeatedly meddled in the affairs of mundanes and the Church.

label: Triamore
summary: A covenant holding a castle and manorial estate by the river Meuse on the edge of the Ardennes at the western fringe of the Rhine Tribunal; led by Daria la Gris and embroiled in mundane politics.

label: Trianoma
summary: The maga and apprentice of Bonisagus who traveled widely to recruit wizards and negotiate the Oath of Hermes, becoming the driving force behind the founding of the Order. She declined to be one of the twelve Founders.

label: Trianoma's third filia
summary: Reference duplicates Irmele.

label: Trianomans
summary: Wandering magi who politically defend certain sites of mystical significance across Mythic Europe.

label: Tribunal Field of Durenmar
summary: The traditional grounds at Durenmar where the Rhine Tribunal gathers, containing the Forum and the ancient seat of Bjornaer; site of the Order's initiation ceremonies.

label: The Greater Alps Tribunal
summary: The Alpine Tribunal of the 'Sanctuary of Ice', a region of mountain covenants and hidden magic.

label: The Hibernian Tribunal
summary: The Tribunal of Ireland, the 'Contested Isle', shaped by its native traditions and tense relations with newcomers.

label: The Loch Leglean Tribunal
summary: The Tribunal of Scotland, the 'Lion of the North', a wild and contested land of Highland magic.

label: The Normandy Tribunal
summary: A competitive, resource-poor Tribunal where covenants vie for vis through the system of redes and fairs.

label: Tribunal of Novgorod
summary: A Hermetic Tribunal whose covenants often take advantage of the great fair of Thessalonica (the Demetria).

label: Tribunal of Transylvania
summary: A Hermetic Tribunal whose covenants frequent the great fair of Thessalonica for its eastern goods.

label: The Provençal Tribunal
summary: The Tribunal of southern France, of 'Faith & Flame', set against the upheaval of the Albigensian Crusade.

label: The Rhine Tribunal
summary: The tradition-bound Tribunal of the Holy Roman Empire's heartlands, the 'Guardians of the Forests'.

label: The Roman Tribunal
summary: The Tribunal centered on Rome and Italy, ancient seat of Hermetic and mundane power.

label: The Stonehenge Tribunal
summary: The Tribunal of England, the 'Heirs to Merlin', rich in ancient magic and Arthurian legacy.

label: Tribunal Summons
summary: A formal summons to a Hermetic tribunal that Redcaps must deliver at least six months before the tribunal takes place; rigorously enforced.

label: The Theban Tribunal
summary: The Tribunal of the Greek-speaking world, governed by Hellenic custom and the 'sundered eagle' of a divided empire.

label: The Transylvanian Tribunal
summary: The eastern Tribunal dominated by House Tremere, organized and hierarchical, standing 'against the dark'.

label: Trier
summary: The oldest German city (Roman Augusta Treverorum), ruled by its archbishop; site of Roman remains, the Porta Nigra, the Cathedral of St. Peter, and the underground former covenant of Treverorum.

label: Trinitarians
summary: An order of monks active since 1198 dedicated to ransoming slaves.

label: Tristan
summary: Hero whose place of birth was the land of Lyonesse.

label: Troche of Colocynth
summary: A Theriac of Level 5, Potency Weak, a compressed pill that causes violent bowel evacuations and can purge retained humors from a patient with a melancholic disease.

label: Trods
summary: Special pathways that lead into and out of Faerie, connecting regio levels to each other and the mundane world and even leading to Arcadia; Arcadian Travel lets Merinitae create them at will.

label: Trolls
summary: Supernatural creatures given as an example of guardians for a magical jewel in a tournament special challenge.

label: Trollsynir
summary: Wizards said to live in Scandinavia and Iceland who claim descent from giants and bear the power to curse their enemies; a Damhadh-Duidsan variant.

label: Trotula of Salerno
summary: A famous recent example of a female physician (medica) practicing medicine in Mythic Europe.

label: Troubadours
summary: A type of minstrel from southern France whose courtly love poetry, inspired by Arabic neighbors, is being destroyed by the Albigensian Crusade.

label: Troupe Upbringing
summary: A Minor General Virtue for a character raised among entertainers, granting +2 to rolls involving abilities in a selected area such as acrobatics or storytelling.

label: Trouvères
summary: A type of minstrel from northern France, concentrating on Arthurian poems, of whom Chrétien of Troyes is the most famous.

label: True Faith
summary: A Divine blessing limited to beings not already part of the Divine Realm; creatures with Divine Might cannot have it, and Baal-Peor's vomit cannot touch those who possess it.

label: True Lineages
summary: One of the three groups of Hermetic Houses (Bonisagus, Guernicus, Mercere, Tremere) made up entirely of those descended in training from a single Founder; cannot be joined later.

label: True Love
summary: A Minor General Virtue: the character has found the one person meant for them, giving +3 to appropriate Personality Trait rolls; the True Love must be another player character with this Virtue.

label: True Merinitae
summary: A cult and House lineage following Mendalus's effort to reconstruct Merinita's nature Mysteries, who claim to learn Nature Lore directly from the Founder via Agnes.

label: True Name
summary: A secret name expressing a being's spiritual essence, serving as an indefinite-duration Arcane Connection; demons, angels, jinn, and Daimons all have one, learned at a cost of 5 experience points.

label: True Rest of the Injured Brute
aliases: True Rest of the Injured Brute
summary: A Creo Animal spell (Level 20) granting an injured animal target a +9 bonus to all Recovery rolls while the spell is in effect.

label: True Sight of the Air
summary: An Intellego Auram spell (Level 15) that lets the caster see clearly through smoke, fog, and dust, even if magical.

label: Trust of Childlike Faith
summary: A Perdo Mentem spell that destroys adult judgment regarding truth and falsity, used as a template for spells diminishing other mental capacities.

label: Trutina the Quaesitor
summary: A beautiful mature maga and quaesitor who joined Burnham in 1195, says little, and instructs an unGifted Redcap to vote with Iudicium; wears the badge of House Guernicus.

label: Tuareg
summary: A North African people with designated religious tribes; the Ineslemen Social Status belongs to one of these tribes.

label: Tuatha de Danu
summary: The fair folk of Ireland, said to be the children of the faerie goddess embodied in the Danube.

label: Tuisto
summary: The earth-born god of Germanic legend whose son Mannus sired the three ancestral fathers of the German tribes.

label: Tulgank
summary: An ugly mountain-spirit faerie melded forever into his cavern floor by the Seelie he loved; his petrified hand still nurtures a rose whose petals yield Herbam vis.

label: Turb Trained
summary: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a character raised at a covenant and trained to fight in the turb, allowed to learn Martial Abilities at character creation.

label: Turnis
summary: The second Primus of House Verditius who developed the ritual allowing other Hermetic magi to join the House and set the rules of the Contest.

label: Twilight
summary: The mysterious altered state magi enter from excess magic; prolonged exposure leads to Final Twilight, removing a magus from the mortal world.

label: Twilight Mastery
summary: A new Major Hermetic Virtue letting a magus choose the effects of Wizard's Twilight and induce Warping in others; the second Fruit of the Path of Warping.

label: Twilight Scar
