summary: A lasting supernatural mark left on a magus by Twilight episodes; Philippus Niger bears many, including one that causes only male children to be born where he lives.

label: Twist of the Tongue
summary: A Perdo Corpus spell that twists the target's tongue into a spiral, destroying the ability to speak; a grave offense to a magus.

label: Twist the Living Tree
summary: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 25) that bends a living tree into unusual positions to form a cage, shelter, or wall while the caster maintains concentration.

label: Twisted Spine
summary: A Minor Curse (Rego Corpus effect) that twists the victim's spine grotesquely, imposing -3 to social rolls.

label: Two-headed Hound
summary: A corrupt beast (Might 10, Animal) appearing as a huge two-headed dog whose heads hate each other; able to spit fire, created by a diabolist as a sanctum guard.

label: Tytalan Ink
summary: A charged item in the form of colorless ink that becomes visible (turns black or another color) upon a command word, used by Tytalan magi for secret writing.

label: Tzadik Nistar
summary: A Major Story Flaw in which the character is one of the Tzadikim Nistarim, the 36 hidden righteous on whom the world's continuation relies, destined to face a moment of moral decision.

label: Ulf
summary: An example Bjornaer magus with a wolf heartbeast who communicates with his Great Beast ancestor and is initiated into the Mystery of the Anima, gaining a shadow-wolf inner heartbeast.

label: Ulm
summary: A city on the northern bank of the upper Danube first settled by Jews in the 9th century, declared a Free Imperial City by Frederick Barbarossa in 1164 and known for linen weaving.

label: Ultima Thule
summary: A far-northern region where the walking dead are prevalent, leading Donatores there to concentrate on Corpus.

label: Ultor
summary: A Summa on Penetration (Level 5, Quality 11) by Elaine, emphasizing penetrating the Parma Magica.

label: Unaffected by The Gift
summary: A Minor General Virtue: the character is not affected by the negative effects of The Gift or Magical Air in others, even a Blatant Gift.

label: Unaging
summary: A Minor Supernatural Virtue: the character does not suffer the effects of age, with aging points only building up Decrepitude points rather than reducing Characteristics.

label: Unbaptized
summary: A Major Story Flaw in which the character is a Christian who has never been baptized, often due to a supernatural background, and does not benefit from the sacraments.

label: Unbearable to (Beings)
summary: A Minor Hermetic or General Flaw in which one of three classes of beings is extremely disturbed by the character, adding -3 to social interactions; only for characters with The Gift or Magical Air.

label: Unbound Tongue
summary: A Minor Supernatural Virtue: when transformed into a non-human form, the character may speak any human languages he knows without impediment, and a magus may still cast spells with his voice.

label: Uncertain Faith
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which doubt stands between the character and the Divine, giving -3 to holy influence rolls and a +1 Personality Trait that demons exploit.

label: Uncontrollable Strength
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character doesn't know his own strength, requiring a stress roll against Ease Factor 6 to avoid overdoing delicate tasks.

label: Undecorated
summary: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab has spartan or absent decoration, making it uninspiring (-1 Upkeep, -1 Aesthetics).

label: Underwater
summary: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab is filled with water instead of air, causing breathing and movement difficulties (+2 Safety, +1 Warping, -2 Aesthetics, +4 Aquam).

label: Underworld
summary: The realm where the gods of the dead imprisoned the titans, the resentful spirits Tytalus sought out and forged pacts with to oppose Guorna.

label: Undoing the Stonemason's Handiwork
summary: A PeTe 15 spell that smashes masonry or pavement into component stones; used by School of Vilano followers to produce loose stones for ammunition or to collapse structures.

label: Unease of the Still Forest
summary: A Mentem power of the bockman faeries that radiates an aura of unease up to 100 paces, silencing birds and instilling growing dread and paranoia in those within.

label: Uneven Floor
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab has a wonky or dangerous floor, e.g. a cave or sand-covered floor (-1 Safety, -1 Health, -1 Aesthetics).

label: Ungulus
summary: A declining 'Winter' covenant in a carved tower in the Lake District, founded by House Flambeau and later home to a productive Verditius line; filled with magical treasures.

label: Unhappily Married
summary: A major Story Flaw where a merchant has married for money rather than love and seeks solace outside the marital bed, hiding affairs from spouse and family.

label: Unicorn
summary: A legendary horned beast whose horn provides Shape and Material bonuses to healing (+8), poison detection (+10), and fertility (+11).

label: Unimaginative Learner
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character has trouble figuring things out, subtracting 3 from rolls when studying from raw vis.

label: Uninspirational
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is bland and boring; Presence and Communication may not exceed 0, and social Abilities used to impress suffer -3.

label: University Dean
summary: A Major Story Flaw in which the character is the head of a university overseeing internal and external affairs; requires the Doctor in (Faculty) Virtue and age 40+.

label: University Grammar Teacher
summary: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a character employed by a university to teach grammar to younger members, able to purchase Latin and Artes Liberales.

label: University of Arezzo
summary: A small student-run Italian university south of Florence, founded in 1215, offering faculties of law, medicine, and the arts.

label: University of Naples
summary: A planted university to be instituted by Frederick II of Naples in 1224, drawing masters from Salerno.

label: University of Palencia
summary: A royal Spanish university founded by King Alfonso VIII of Castile in 1208, with faculties of arts, canon law, and theology, overseen by the Bishop of Palencia.

label: University of Paris
summary: An influential medieval university that in 1220 has banned teaching the New Aristotle under threat of excommunication, with its bans echoing throughout northern Europe.

label: University of Reggio
summary: A small student-run Italian university northwest of Bologna teaching law exclusively, founded by departing Bolognese scholars.

label: University of Salamanca
summary: A royal Spanish university founded by Alfonso IX of León in 1218, notable for offering a music degree and admitting women scholars.

label: University of Vicenza
summary: A short-lived Italian university swarmed from Bologna, lasting from 1204 until scholars returned to Bologna in 1210.

label: Unlucky
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is exceptionally unlucky, getting -1 to -3 on rolls in luck-based situations.

label: Unnatural Magic
summary: A Major Hermetic Flaw in which none of the character's Creo rituals have permanent effect due to the illusory nature of his magic, and he cannot extract vis with Creo.

label: Unpredictable Magic
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character always rolls a stress die when using magic and must always roll at least one botch die, even with Mastered spells.

label: Unraveling
summary: A new Mastery special ability applicable to Perdo Vim spells, adding three times the Mastery score to the spell's effective level for destroying magic.

label: Unraveling the Fabric of (Form)
summary: A Perdo Vim 20 spell enchanted into Philippus Niger's talisman with ten related effects, one for each Hermetic Form; basis for Shattering the Malicious Rune.

label: Unraveling the Fabric of Imaginem
summary: A Perdo Vim (PeVi 20) spell that dispels Imaginem (image) magic.

label: Unravelling
summary: A Mastered Spell special ability for Perdo Vim spells, adding three times Mastery score to the effective level when destroying a targeted magical effect.

label: Unravelling the Fabric of (Form)
summary: A Perdo Vim spell that cancels the effects of one spell of a specified Form; ten Form variants exist plus rarer non-Hermetic variants.

label: Unruly Air
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character's presence subtly pushes others to extreme behavior in social situations; those with Magic Resistance are unaffected.

label: Unseelie
summary: A dark faction of faeries; an Unseelie faerie lord holds a melancholy feast on the last day of winter at which a doomed mortal is danced to death, leaving footprints where destroying angel mushrooms grow.

label: Unseen Arm
summary: A Rego Terram spell (ReTe 5) used to hold an object in the air without concentration; moving the object still requires concentration.

label: Unspecialized
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character does not have any specialties for any of her Abilities.

label: Unstable
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab is prone to movement, e.g. on a ship or earthquake-prone, causing occasional accidents (+1 Upkeep, -1 Safety).

label: Unstructured Caster
summary: A Major Hermetic Flaw in which the character casts all Formulaic spells as Ritual spells (including needing vis) and may not learn Ritual spells, but casts Spontaneous spells normally.

label: Unyielding Earth
summary: A Rego Terram spell that compacts the ground surface in a 15-by-15-pace area, making it more solid.

label: Upper Lorraine
summary: A duchy that came into existence on the division of the Carolingian empire, a moderately populated rolling plain bounded by the Vosges, Rhine, Ardennes, and Argonne; its seat is Nancy.

label: Urgen
summary: An Archmage of House Bjornaer (heartbeast of a bear) holding the Seat of the Bear at Crintera; former Primus (1165-1203), leader of the Hawthorn Gild and the most influential Wilderist.

label: Urgen of Crintera
summary: Leader of the Weissdorngilde (Hawthorn Gild), a follower of House Bjornaer from the covenant of Crintera.

label: Uriel, the Angel of Punishment
summary: An angel known as the Angel of Punishment, whom the chastising angel Kolazonta serves.

label: Ursula Densacer
summary: Clan Chief of Clan Arelie, a wolf-heartbeast maga acclaimed for erudition and poetry, and a friend of Prima Falke.

label: Usama ibn Munqidh
summary: A historical author (d. 1188) quoted from The Book of Learning by Example describing an angelic rescue on a mountain, illustrating the angel Nasir.

label: Usurer
summary: A Minor Social Status Flaw in which the character lends valuables at abusive interest rates, earning about ten pounds of silver yearly but holding a poor reputation at level 4.

label: Uswaurpa
summary: A byname ('reject') for a Bjornaer magus known to have shapeshifted before Initiation, who acquires the scorn of his peers.

label: Uther Pendragon
summary: Brother of King Aurelius who led fifteen thousand knights to Ireland with Merlin to fetch the stones of the Giant's Ring; he later fathered Arthur at Tintagel while magically disguised as Gorlois.

label: Val Negra
summary: A lost covenant of the Provençal Tribunal, one of the first covenants of the Order founded by Flambeau himself, which suffered in the Schism War and whose location is now lost.

label: Val-Negra
summary: The original domus magna of House Flambeau in the Pyrenees, founded by Flambeau against the sahirs; it has since sunk deep into Winter and lost Elaine's library.

label: Valdemar I
summary: The Danish king whose invasion of Rügen in 1168 surprised the Bjornaer covenant of Crintera and triggered its crisis.

label: Valdemar II
summary: The King of Denmark, relatively secure with Schleswig and Holstein under his control, who in the historical timeline grants Kolding a full charter in 1230.

label: Valdus
summary: A magus of House Tytalus charged in 1109 AD by Treverorum for theft of vis from a site outside Trier; fined one pawn of vis and ordered to seek permission before harvesting again.

label: Valkyrie
summary: Faerie minor goddesses of the Norse pantheon (Might 20) who ride wolves above battlefields to select the worthy dead for transformation into einherjar; they also serve as maids in Valhalla.

label: Valnastium
summary: The domus magna of House Jerbiton, a secluded valley covenant in the Greater Alps founded by Iconophiles to store icons and relics; filled with alien ancient art and home to the cats of the Black Lineage.

label: Vanasalus of Criamon
summary: A young, friendly Criamon maga of Semitae who believes magic reflects one's personality and follows Gerfallon to understand the Enigma.

label: Vardian's Tomb
summary: A covenant whose necromancer created the plague that halted Barbarossa's army at the gates of Rome.

label: Variable Power
summary: A Minor Supernatural Virtue: one of the character's magic powers grows more powerful over time based on age, Might, Warping, or an Ability score.

label: Variola
summary: A Serious Choleric Disease from putrid choler accumulating in the skin; highly contagious and disfiguring.

label: Varstus
summary: An Italian Alps wizard skilled in sympathetic magic whom Flambeau confronted with the words 'Join us or die!' in 771 and slew when he fled.

label: Vederis
summary: A famous magus of House Criamon who wrote The Travels of Fedoso, a classic work of esoteric lore.

label: Veil of Invisibility
summary: A Perdo Imaginem spell (Level 20) that makes the target completely undetectable to normal sight regardless of what it does, though it still casts a shadow.

label: Venatus
summary: An eighty-year-post-Gauntlet Collegium-turned-Lyceum magus of Trianoma's lineage who discovered the New Aristotle at Bologna, split from the Collegium to found the Lyceum, and still teaches at a university.

label: Vendetta
summary: A Major Story Flaw in which the magus is engaged in one of House Verditius' vendettas, often inherited from his parens, against another Verditius magus; restricted to Verditius magi.

label: Venditor
summary: A Major Social Status Virtue for a selling-agent who barters the goods of a Verditius maga to mundane parties, gaining bonus experience in social abilities.

label: Venetian Arsenal
summary: The most heavily capitalized manufactory in Europe, located in Venice, capable of outfitting three war galleys per day to assemble a fleet for the Fourth Crusade.

label: Vengeful Powers
summary: A Major Story Tainted Flaw in which the Infernal realm has taken interest in the character's non-Infernal Powers, causing harmful side effects whenever they are used without sin.

label: Venice
summary: The dominant north Italian city-state of Mythic Europe, controlling trade with Constantinople and the Levant and monopolies on alum and potash; its Doge annually weds the sea with a vis-bearing ring.

label: Venus
summary: The goddess who dwells in the subterranean Venusberg, where the knight Tannhäuser worshiped her for a year.

label: Venus' Blessing
summary: A Minor General Virtue giving +3 on Communication and Presence rolls with sexually compatible characters in appropriate situations.

label: Venus's Blessing
summary: A suitable Free Virtue for Jerbiton magi, preferred for characters desiring weaker emotional attachments.

label: Verdan of Ex Miscellanea
summary: A magus of House Ex Miscellanea whose sigil makes all his spells involve the color green, such as turning poisonous liquids faint green.

label: Verderis
summary: The third Primus of House Criamon, author of the epic poem The Travels of Fedoso; his ghost is absent from the Cave of Twisting Shadows and he had the Premonitions Virtue.

label: Verdi
summary: The domus magna of House Verditius on the island of Sardinia, built over the Forge of Hephaestus, consisting of a squat central tower surrounded by six taller towers amid nuraghi.

label: Verditius Cult Lore
summary: Cult Lore texts of House Verditius; Infernal agents may arrange deliveries of these to propel young magi along their hubristic path.

label: Verditius Elder Runes
summary: A Verditius Inner Mystery and set of philosophically-grounded runes, derived from Wayland's rune magic and refined by Boethius's philosophy, carved to add power to enchantments.

label: Verditius' Forge
summary: The laboratory built by the Founder Verditius near the Tower of Bonisagus at Durenmar, traditionally housing the covenant's Artificer.

label: Verditius Magic
summary: The Outer Mystery of House Verditius allowing magi to incorporate craft Abilities into enchantment, add Verditius Runes for bonuses, and reduce vis costs, but requiring casting tools to cast Formulaic and Ritual spells.

label: Verdun
summary: A border city on the River Meuse famous for the Treaty of 843, where spies and assassins can be recruited and Redcaps meet while traveling between the Rhine and Normandy Tribunals.

label: Vernacular Education
summary: A minor general Virtue of secular tutoring for merchant-house scions, allowing purchase of Academic Abilities and granting extra experience points for trade-relevant Abilities.

label: Vernus
summary: A weak, Struggling Spring covenant of six magi consisting of tents around a standing stone in a clearing within a faerie-forest magical regio, contesting its sole vis source with faeries.

label: Vesta
summary: A Roman goddess of hearth and home whose rites were integrated into the cult of Diana and adopted as patron by the Cult of Vesta; treated as a faerie/pagan deity in Mythic Europe.

label: Viaticarus
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character survived after receiving Extreme Unction, leaving him immune to demonic temptation but increasingly corpse-like and unable to cross certain wards.

label: Viator of Mercere
summary: The only Gifted Redcap in the tribunal, retired to Ungulus to develop a magical means of communication between covenants without compromising their defenses.

label: Victor of Mercere
summary: A famous magus of House Mercere from Semita Errabunda; a faerie dell named Victor Valley after him might be inhabited by a faerie sharing his reputed qualities.

label: Viea
summary: Trianoma's jealous twin sister who interpreted her visions, then stole valuable texts and fled; her fate remains unknown.

label: Vilano
summary: A ninth-century Flambeau magus from Istria in the Transylvanian Tribunal who suffered the Flaw Weak Magic but pioneered combat with only indirect spells, famously slaying the Green Dragon of Labin with falling trees.

label: Vile Surroundings
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab sits in an undesirable place such as a swamp or by a filthy hovel (-2 Health, -1 Aesthetics).

label: Vile Water of Sterility
summary: A Muto Aquam Ritual spell that ruins a body of water up to a small lake, making it dark, noxious, and unfit for habitation or consumption.

label: Villard de Honnecourt
summary: The most famous master mason of 1220, who worked on cathedrals at Laon, Chartres, Reims, and Meux and produced tractatus sketchbooks usable to study Craft: Mason.

label: Vim
summary: Form governing raw magical power and vis itself.

label: Vinaria
summary: An archmage and former Prima of House Merinita who stepped down after being outmaneuvered by Handri; she returned after seven years of claimed Faerie Twilight with a new inner strength that frightens Handri, and is strong in the raw elemental arts.

label: Viper's Gaze
summary: A Rego Animal spell (Level 15) that holds an animal rigid as long as the caster maintains eye contact and concentrates.

label: Virgin Mary
summary: By far the most important saint, the mother of God, believed to have particularly strong influence in interceding with God; Margaret of Beverley was rescued by her grace.

label: Virtues and Flaws
summary: Special character features: Virtues grant benefits while Flaws impose disadvantages or story hooks, including supernatural abilities, aptitudes, and personality traits.

label: Vis
summary: Raw magical power in physical form, the currency of magical effort, collected from sources and spent on rituals and study.

label: Vis Extraction
summary: The laboratory activity of distilling raw vis, appearing as a lab Specialization aided by superior equipment, stills, and certain Features.

label: Vis Grant
summary: A covenant Boon representing the annual division of surplus vis among the members.

label: Vis Salary
summary: A covenant Hook in which members must work to earn a share of vis, appropriate when individuals must petition the council for vis.

label: Vision of Heat's Light
summary: An Intellego Ignem spell (Level 20) that lets the caster see the heat of objects of human body temperature or hotter, useful in the dark though not giving true vision.

label: Vision of the Haunting Spirits
summary: A Muto Mentem spell (Level 40) with an Imaginem requisite that makes all spirits within a target area visible, including the spirits of living people.

label: Vision of the Scrying Pool
summary: A Hermetic spell adapted from one of the lost golden-tablet rituals of the Cult of Mercury.

label: Visions
summary: A Flaw that gives the bearer prophetic dreams or visions; Maria has it to predict the volcano, Adranus can grant it, and Valkyries possess it to know where worthy men will die.

label: Visions of the Infernal Terrors
summary: A spell that causes everything the target sees and hears to appear terrifying, potentially scaring them to death.

label: Vitriol
summary: A Level 15 Alteration Reagent that creates strong acid able to dissolve stone, base metal, and wood, inflicting +10 damage if poured on a person; only glass is proof against it.

label: Voice Like a Bard
summary: A common automaton power (base effect 10, Creo Imaginem) letting the automaton masterfully sing a small repertoire of ballads.

label: Voice Like a Nightingale
summary: A common automaton power (base effect 5, Creo Imaginem) letting the automaton sing bird songs through its mouth.

label: Voice of the Lake
summary: An Intellego Aquam spell (Level 25) that lets the caster hold a conversation with a body of water about things in contact with it.

label: Voice of the (Land)
summary: A Minor Supernatural Virtue letting the character speak with any creature whose natural habitat is a particular environment, without being perceived as threat or prey.

label: Volkhvy
summary: Exclusively male pagan priests of Rugen who serve gods such as the Forest Brothers and Svantovit; nearly all have the Ways of the Forest Virtue and can open faerie gates.

label: Voluntas
summary: A vigorous covenant near the village of Wilton, founded by Norman magi, that has led the anti-Blackthorn opposition for over a century and is famed for its library.

label: Vortigern
summary: The usurper king who invited the Saxons under Hengist and Horsa into Britain and consulted Merlin about his collapsing tower.

label: Vow
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw representing a solemn religious obligation, taken by priests for celibacy and by Cathar Perfecti and Mazdean priests for ritual purity.

label: Vow of Service
summary: A Flaw binding a character to a vow of service, taken by the Ghostly Warden.

label: Vulcan
summary: The Roman god of fire and the forge after whom the Cult of Vulcan was renamed; Balento claimed descent from him and his Mysteries emphasized destructive fire.

label: Vulnerable
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab lacks even basic defenses and is easily entered (-1 Aesthetics).

label: Vulnerable Casting
summary: A Hermetic Flaw causing extra Fatigue loss when casting, gained from Ordeals or bad Twilight effects; cannot be started with alongside Withstand Casting.

label: Vulnerable Magic
summary: A Major Hermetic Flaw whereby the character's magic is automatically dispelled in certain uncommon circumstances (e.g. touching iron, crossing running water); often taken as an Ordeal in Glamour Initiation.

label: Vulnerable to Folk Tradition
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw that makes a magus's magic susceptible to folk-remedies, granting aware targets Magic Resistance based on Magic Lore and allowing enchantments to be broken.

label: Vysehrad Rock
summary: A hilltop south of Prague where the Gifted Princess Libuse had her vision foretelling her husband Premysl, founder of Bohemia's ruling dynasty; now site of Prague's second castle.

label: Waddenzee
summary: A Rhine covenant whose piracy thwarts Oculus Septentrionalis's mercantile ambitions; some members are Ash Gild members who exterminate non-Hermetic Norse wizards, and it figures in demon Gymir's plans.

label: Wahhab
summary: An example jinni with Magic Might 15 (Ignem), a fire spirit inhabiting ancient ruins of a fane to a forgotten god in Iberia, with fire and shapeshifting powers.

label: Waiting Spell
summary: A version of Watching Ward with target Room, well known in the Order, which can contain spells up to the level of the Waiting Spell minus 10 and is also a Ritual.

label: Waldgeister
summary: German wood-faeries dwelling in huge numbers in forests, some benevolent and some malicious, including Katzenveit, Gübich, and Rübezahl.

label: Waldheim
summary: A tiny reclusive hamlet in a glade (Magic aura 2) deep in the Westerwald near the former covenant of Oakdell, inhabited by hedge wizards loyal to the Court of Bright Winter.

label: Waldherz
summary: A Black Forest covenant founded as a chapter house of Durenmar by the lineage of Hercynius, dedicated to overcoming Hermetic limits with primal magic; destroyed in the Schism War.

label: Wales
summary: A poorer, more pastoral land west of England, split in 1220 between Anglo-Norman marcher lords in the south and native Welsh princes in the north.

label: Wall of Living Wood
summary: A Creo Herbam spell (Level 25) that creates a straight wall of living oak 20 paces long, growing quickly from nearby trees or fertile earth.

label: Wall of Protecting Stone
summary: A Creo Terram spell that makes a wall of granite up to 25 paces wide, 4 paces high, and 1 pace thick.

label: Wall of Thorns
summary: A Creo Herbam spell (Level 15) that creates a straight wall of resilient thorny bushes up to 20 paces long and 4 paces high.

label: Walpurga
summary: A powerful beneficent faerie lady (Faerie Might 50) of the Seelie Court representing summer and growth, who appears at the Witches' Altar on Walpurgis Night to summon summer.

label: Walpurgis Night
summary: The eve of the 1st of May on which Rhine Tribunal gatherings begin and a procession of witches takes place on the Brocken.

label: Walsingham
summary: A shrine of Our Lady in Norfolk and a pilgrimage site of growing importance; the Virgin of Walsingham is claimed to be especially powerful.

label: Walter de Grey
summary: The Archbishop of York (elected 1215), a royal servant and former chancellor who quarrels with Stephen Langton over the right to bear his cross in the southern province.

label: Walther von der Vogelweide
summary: The most brilliant minnesanger, who bested rivals at the 1204 Wartburg Sangerkrieg and composed poems for rival claimants to the imperial throne.

label: Walther von der Vogelwiede
summary: One of the most famous German minnesingers, living in Vienna at the court of Leopold VI.

label: Wand of Bestial Agony
summary: A lesser enchanted wand belonging to Mari Amwithig that Hephaestion reforges in an example, with a Rego Vim power of effect level 20.

label: Wanderer
summary: A free Social Status Virtue recommended for performance artists and held by Brogo, marking an itinerant performer.

label: Wanderlust
summary: A Major Story Flaw in which the character is compelled to travel and cannot spend more than a season in the same place.

label: Ward Against Beasts of Legend
summary: A Rego Animal 25 warding effect enchanted into Philippus Niger's Subtle Chain.

label: Ward Against Faeries of the Air
aliases: Ward Against Faeries of the Air
summary: A Rego Auram ward spell (General) protecting a magic circle against faeries of the air, who cannot break the circle or affect those within it.

label: Ward against Faeries of the Mountain
aliases: Ward against Faeries of the Mountain
summary: A Rego Terram spell warding against faeries of earth and stone, working like Ward Against Faeries of the Waters.

label: Ward Against Faeries of the Water
aliases: Ward Against Faeries of the Water
Ward Against Faeries of the Waters
summary: A Rego Aquam General ward spell preventing water faeries whose Faerie Might is at or below the spell level from affecting those targeted.

label: Ward Against Faeries of the Wood
aliases: Ward Against Faeries of the Wood
summary: A Rego Herbam ward spell (General) protecting a magic circle against faeries of the wood, modeled on the Aquam version.

label: Ward Against Flame
summary: A Rego Ignem 15 spell creating a circle that mundane fires cannot cross, used around heat sources, grain stores, and sometimes whole laboratories.

label: Ward Against Heat and Flames
summary: A Rego Ignem spell (Level 25) that keeps heat and fire at bay, granting the target a +15 Soak against fire-related damage so weaker fires cannot penetrate the ward.

label: Ward Against Monsters Which Walk As Man
aliases: Ward Against Monsters Which Walk As Man
summary: A Rego Corpus 25 warding effect enchanted into Philippus Niger's Subtle Chain, protecting against Might-bearing creatures affected by Corpus.

label: Ward Against Mundane Intrusions
summary: A Rego Ignem 35 spell with Corpus, Animal, Aquam, and Herbam requisites that conglomerates other wards to hold off flame, light, thieves, pests, moisture, and mildew.

label: Ward Against Rain
summary: A Rego Auram spell (Level 10) ensuring no rain falls on the caster regardless of the weather.

label: Ward against the Beasts of Legend
aliases: Ward against the Beasts of Legend
summary: A Rego Animal General ward spell that prevents any magical beast whose Magic Might is at or below the spell level from affecting those within a circle.

label: Ward Against the Curious Scullion
summary: A Rego Corpus 10 spell creating a circle that humans lacking Magic Resistance cannot cross, used to bar entry to Hermetic sancta.

label: Ward against Wood
summary: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 25) that protects the caster from nonenchanted wood so that none of it can contact his body.

label: Ward the Cruel Touch of Pestilence
aliases: Ward the Cruel Touch of Pestilence
summary: A CrCo 20 spell that grants the target a +9 bonus to Stamina rolls to avoid contracting diseases.

label: Warding
summary: An Accelerated Supernatural Ability of the Columbae for warding away natural things and supernatural beings with Might by inscribing arcane symbols into a circle; predates and was integrated into Hermetic magic.

label: Warped by Magic
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw representing exposure to powerful magical forces, granting Warping Points, a Warping Score of 1, and a related Minor Flaw.

label: Warped Magic
summary: A Hermetic Flaw causing a magus' magic to display an unusual side effect; Balastor's causes his features to take on a savage, feral cast.

label: Warped Senses
summary: A Minor General Flaw making a character overly sensitive to environmental conditions such as light, sound, taste, smell, cold, or heat, with variants like Sensitive (Sense) and Weak (Sense).

label: Warping
summary: The accumulation of Warping Points from exposure to supernatural power; gained from Realms, auras, Longevity Rituals, and miracles, and affected by Susceptibility to Warping and Raised from the Dead.

label: Warrior
summary: A Minor General Virtue: the character is trained to fight, may acquire Martial Abilities at creation, and gains 50 experience points spent on Martial Abilities.

label: Waster of Vis
summary: A Major Hermetic Flaw causing the character to waste a quarter of the raw vis pawns he uses in any application of vis.

label: Watching Ward
summary: A Rego Vim ritual that holds another spell on a target in suspension until triggered by a specified condition; Flambeau and Tytalus magi commonly use it for vengeance spells.

label: Watchtower
summary: A fortified stone building atop the cliffs overlooking Durenmar's valley, occupied by the Protector Philippus Niger and surrounded by blasted ground.

label: Water Elemental
summary: An elemental being of water that can be created via Creo Aquam ritual and whose Might can be reduced or controlled by Aquam spells.

label: Water sprites
summary: Water spirits encountered by Hagen at the River Danube who foretell that all the Burgundians but one priest are doomed to die.

label: Waves of Drowning and Smashing
summary: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 30) that raises a wave five feet high and thirty paces wide capable of submerging swimmers and overturning rowboats.

label: Wayland
summary: An invisible smith dwelling at Wayland's Smithy who will shoe a horse left with a penny overnight; legend credits him with forging magical weapons and armor for great heroes.

label: Wayland's Smithy
summary: A barrow near the White Horse that is the home of the invisible smith Wayland, who shoes horses left with a penny and is said to be able to shoe the White Horse itself.

label: Ways of the Forest
summary: A Virtue common among the exsules and suggested for werewolf companions (as Ways of the Land), reflecting deep attunement to a wilderness area.

label: Ways of the (Local Environment)
summary: A supernatural Virtue possessed by the angel Nasir, tied to a local environment.

label: Ways of the Mountains
summary: A Virtue possessed by Adranus, the spirit of Mount Etna, attuning a being to its mountain environment.

label: Ways of the Swamp
summary: A Virtue granting bonuses in swamp terrain; possessed by the Boglin, who gains combat bonuses from it.

label: Weak Characteristics
summary: A Minor General Flaw giving the character three fewer points to spend buying Characteristics.

label: Weak Enchanter
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the magus's Gift is ill attuned to creating enchanted devices, halving Lab Total for creating or investigating enchanted items.

label: Weak Magic
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which a magus's magic is poor at penetrating Magic Resistance, halving the Penetration Total for all spells.

label: Weak Magic Resistance
summary: A Flaw under which those knowing a magus's secret name need not subtract spell level from Penetration; acquired as a minor Ordeal in the Secret Name Initiation.

label: Weak Parens
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw representing a less powerful or worse-teaching parens, giving fewer experience points and spell levels from apprenticeship.

label: Weak Personality
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character lacks strong feelings, restricting Personality Traits to between +1 and -1.

label: Weak Scholar
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw giving a -6 penalty to Lab Totals when working from the Lab Texts of others, including re-inventing spells.

label: Weak Spontaneous Magic
summary: The Major Hermetic Flaw of the Rusticani; they cannot fatigue themselves to boost spontaneous magic, making them dependent on formulaic spells.

label: Weak-Willed
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character looks to others for guidance rather than himself.

label: Weakness
summary: A Personality Flaw giving a character an irresistible attraction to something (e.g. books or good food); held by the Spying Maid and Lord of the Manor.

label: Wealthy
summary: A Virtue representing greater than average wealth for a trader of a given type; a Wealthy character could declare independence from a company and found a new business.

label: Weaver's Trap of Webs
summary: A Creo Animal (CrAn 35) indirect spell that surrounds and immobilizes a magus with webs without touching him, partly effective without penetrating Magic Resistance.

label: Weaving
summary: The commonest Craft Ability for factors, reflecting skill in producing their main product.

label: Weight of a Thousand Hells
summary: A Creo Mentem spell (Level 25) that makes the victim feel the despair and pain of a thousand sinners in Hell, sapping motivation and imposing penalties on thought and Personality Trait rolls.

label: Weird Magic
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw making a magus's control over magic loose, adding an extra strange botch die on stressed casting rolls.

label: Well Insulated
summary: A Minor laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab is especially shielded from the outside world, suitable for sensitive locations (+1 Safety, +1 Aesthetics).

label: Well-Traveled
summary: A Minor General Virtue: the character has journeyed extensively, gaining 50 bonus experience points for living languages, Area Lores, and social abilities.

label: Well Traveled
summary: A Virtue incompatible with the No Sense of Direction Flaw.

label: Well without Light
summary: A Perdo Ignem spell (Level 25) that removes light from a target structure so that only spells above level 25 can create light there; the light flows into the caster's clenched fist.

label: Welsh druids
summary: Indigenous Welsh magical tradition with which House Díedne had close links, though they did not join the Order; associated with stone circles.

label: West Country
summary: The covenant-free region of Devon and Cornwall, suitable for magical colonization, near the ruins of Sursum and Stellapser and sites associated with Arthur.

label: Western Christendom
summary: A cultural society of Mythic Europe centered on western Europe and including the Crusader States, defining a set of Social Status Virtues and Flaws.

label: Westerwald
summary: A broad hilly forest stretching east from the Rhine north of Koblenz, home to the hamlet of Waldheim, the former covenant of Oakdell, and the faerie Court of Bright Winter.

label: Westminster
summary: The seat of the court of the King's Bench and site of the king's Maundy Thursday ceremony in Westminster Abbey.

label: Whispering Winds
summary: An Intellego Auram unique spell (Level 15) letting the caster hear words spoken by any group within line of sight; an adaptation of an effect known to Bjornaer the Founder.

label: Whispers Through the Black Gate
summary: An Intellego Corpus spell (Level 15) with a Mentem requisite that lets you speak through the barrier between living and dead to one undecayed corpse.

label: Whistle Up The Wind
summary: A Major Supernatural Virtue granting a score of 1 in the Supernatural Ability Whistle Up The Wind, letting the character create winds by whistling.

label: Wiederich
summary: The sole survivor of the Magyar attack on Sirmium in 930, a Flambeau magus who joined the German armies to avenge himself on the Magyars; his vengeful descendants persist.

label: Wielding the Invisible Sling
summary: A Rego Terram spell (ReTe 10) that hurls any nearby throwable object at a target within range, doing up to +5 damage but resisted by Magic Resistance.

label: Wieliczka
summary: A location in Poland named for its salt mines, cited as a Greater mining income example.

label: Wilderists
summary: A philosophy within House Bjornaer favoring the wilderness; the Hawthorn Gild is populated primarily by Bjornaer with a Wilderist philosophy, including Schwall.

label: Wilderness Sense
summary: A Supernatural Ability granting mystical attunement to the wilderness, allowing a roll to determine north, weather, or the presence of natural hazards or resources.

label: Wilding
summary: A Major Nature Mystery letting a maga extract temporary vis from completely natural objects according to her Nature Lore.

label: Wilhelm Weiss
summary: A Gentle-Gifted Jerbiton magus and master of Fengheld at the Rheingasse chapter in Cologne who poses as a wealthy merchant and co-leads the Apple Gild.

label: Wilkis
summary: Most eloquent of Birna's six apprentices, told to 'Nourish,' a wolf from a Prussian tribe, appointed first primus of the House; founder of Clan Wilkis.

label: William de Fors
summary: The count of Aumale who holds the royal castle of Rockingham despite government demands that he surrender it.

label: William de Longespee
summary: Earl of Salisbury since 1198 and a bastard son of Henry II; a close counselor of King John and a ruthless opportunist disputing Lincoln with Nicola de Hay.

label: William Fireheart of Flambeau
summary: Ungulus's most infamous member at the end of the twelfth century, who caused trouble in northern France and lost a Wizard's War to a magus of Fudarus in 1220.

label: William Marshal
summary: The greatest knight in Europe (1147-1219), earl of Pembroke and regent of England after King John's death, who rose from a minor lord's younger son.

label: William Marshal the Younger
summary: The earl of Pembroke who holds Fotheringhay castle against royal orders and is suing Falkes de Bréauté over four disputed manors.

label: William of Conches
summary: A scholar who taught at the cathedral school of Chartres.

label: William of Jerbiton
summary: A Jerbiton magus of Rosalba targeted by Diana of Tremere in the 873 Wizards' War; his death began near-constant skirmishing.

label: William of Newburgh
summary: A medieval chronicler quoted in the Donatores history, author of Historia Rerum Anglicarum, who recorded accounts of cadavers leaving their tombs to wander among the living.

label: William of Thanet
summary: The aging, capable autocrat who has handled the day-to-day operation of Nigrasaxa since its founding.

label: William the Conqueror
summary: Duke of Normandy who conquered England after the Battle of Hastings in 1066, built the Tower of London, and commissioned the Domesday Book.

label: Willigis
summary: A tenth-century archbishop of Mainz from whom onwards the archbishop enjoyed the status of Archchancellor of the Empire.

label: Willow Maiden
summary: The manipulative, uncaring faerie ruler of the eastern Willow Forest among the Courts of the Seasons, whose power waxes in autumn and who entraps the Alder Prince.

label: Wilton
summary: The stone-built village fifteen minutes from Voluntas that serves as part of the covenant, housing covenfolk and providing an inn for guests.

label: Wimpfen
summary: A small fortified city high above the River Neckar with Roman, Frankish, and episcopal history, now a favorite imperial residence.

label: Winchester
summary: A declined but important city, former capital of England, with two castles (the royal castle and Wolvesey Castle of the bishop) and the great St. Giles's Fair.

label: Wind at the Back
summary: A Rego Auram spell (Level 5) that makes an existing breeze follow the caster as they travel, causing phenomena like fog or haze to follow.

label: Wind of Mundane Silence
summary: A Perdo Vim spell that raises a metaphorical breeze canceling the effects of spells in an area, and can dispel Parma Magica if it penetrates strongly enough.

label: Winfrida
summary: A young, timid Follower of Guernicus (age 27) and Quaesitor at Durenmar whom Murion is grooming; one of only two Guernicus magi in the Rhine Tribunal.

label: Wings of the Soaring Wind
summary: A Creo Auram spell (Level 30) with a Rego requisite that generates a gust supporting and propelling the caster through the air at up to 40 mph.

label: Wings of the Soaring Winds
summary: A flight spell that lets a maga move at 40 miles per hour, cited in calculations about flying to the moon.

label: Winter's Icy Grip
summary: A Perdo Ignem 30 spell known by Philippus Niger, mastered for Fast Casting.

label: Winter's Icy Touch
summary: A Perdo Ignem spell (Level 10) that causes the target to feel a chill and lose body heat, costing them a Fatigue level.

label: Wisdom from Ignorance
summary: A Minor Supernatural Virtue used by certain Egyptian Sufis interested in calligraphy, allowing them to use unreadable books as sources of training for spiritual subjects.

label: Wise One
summary: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a member of a broad class of mystics, seers, and healers, well regarded in the community.

label: Witch Marks
summary: A Minor General Tainted Flaw giving the character disfigurements recognized by folk lore as belonging to diabolists.

label: Witches' Altar
summary: A mass of granite blocks atop the Brocken where, every Walpurgis Night, Walpurga summons the spirits of summer to defeat those of winter.

label: Witches of Thessaly
summary: A tradition descended from reclusive Thessalian worshipers of underworld gods who practiced sorcery and necromancy; Trianoma was a member, and some remain in contact with the Daughters of Erictho.

label: Withstand Casting
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus lose fewer Fatigue levels (minimum 1) when casting spells; can be taken multiple times for greater effect.

label: Wizard's Autumn
summary: A Perdo Herbam spell (Level 15) that makes all deciduous leaves on target plants turn brown and fall, affecting a small grove of trees.

label: Wizard's Boost
summary: A Vim spell example that is not eligible for the Rebuttal Mastery special ability because it does not affect a spell used by another being.

label: Wizard's Communion
summary: A Hermetic ritual spell cast cooperatively by between three and twelve magi; a life-sized diagram for it appears in the biggest codex of the Durenmar Library, and it may be led dangerously from a casting tablet.

label: Wizard's Eclipse
summary: A Perdo Ignem ritual (Level 35) that eclipses the sun within a target area, suddenly making it as dark as night.

label: Wizard's Icy Grip
summary: A Perdo Ignem spell (Level 30) that chills a single target for +20 damage, freezing it solid if killed; armor does not add to Soak against it.

label: Wizard's Leap
summary: A ReCo 15 spell that instantly transports the caster up to 50 paces toward a visible destination or Arcane Connection; effective as a fast-cast defense, bringing the caster's Talisman automatically.

label: Wizard's Reach
summary: A Muto Vim spell that increases the range of a targeted spell by one category; ten Form-specific versions exist.

label: Wizard's Sidestep
summary: A Rego Imaginem spell in which the caster's image appears up to a pace from their actual position so attacks miss; once the image is struck the caster gains a +9 bonus to Defense.

label: Wizard's Vigil
summary: A Ritual spell known free by Mercurian Magic magi at a level equal to their highest Ritual spell, enabling collaborative casting that raises effective spell level.

label: Wizard's Well
summary: A site that Merlin is said to have created, according to the legends of the mage.

label: Wizard's March
summary: A Tribunal sentence declaring a magus an outlaw, stripped of the Code's protection so any magus may destroy them.

label: Wizards' Melee
summary: A controversial Flambeau tournament event where teams of one magus and five grogs fight, the goal being to cast a Touch-range spell on the opposing magus.

label: Wizard's War
summary: A formally declared state of war between magi, the one circumstance in which the Code permits a magus to slay another.

label: Woden
summary: The Norse god who oversaw trade and commerce under the title Farmagud (god of cargoes); a fickle god of magic whose symbols are the spear, raven, and wolf.

label: Wolf Clan
summary: One of Crintera's six clans; makes up the bulk of the covenant's warriors and servants, fights with axes, and protects the Prima. Its leader is traditionally a wolf skinchanger and the Prima's personal shield grog.

label: Wolf Mount
summary: A faerie wolf the size of a horse (Might 20) made of the glamour of a Valkyrie, sharing her Might pool, which carries her and passengers through the sky.

label: Wolf of Virtue
summary: A Great Beast Mythic Blood lineage granting the Paralyze a Man at R: Eye feat, a Focus in Wolves, and the Envious flaw.

label: Wolf's Cloak
summary: A wondrous cloak made by a furrier that allows the wearer to change into a wolf until the next sunrise or sunset (Craft Level 17).

label: Wolfram von Eschenbach
summary: A famous German minnesinger and poet at the court of Hermann I of Thuringia, author of Parzival; used as an example of a character with both Profession: Minnesinger and Craft: Poetry.

label: Wolkan
summary: A branded criminal freed by Lord Robert to help collect tolls on Pfalz Island; a skilled thief and boatman with criminal contacts up and down the Rhine.

label: Wondrous Items
summary: The highest quality of crafted goods, minor enchanted items whose Craft Level is 12 plus the magnitude of effect; the goldsmith Banco is renowned for making them.

label: Wookey Hole Caves
summary: A deep, partly flooded cave hung with stalactites, in which something is said to live, though local legends disagree about the details.

label: Words of the Flickering Flame
summary: An Intellego Ignem spell (Level 35) that allows the caster to converse with a fire, which is commonly chaotic and distractible.

label: Words of the Unbroken Silence
summary: A Creo Mentem spell (Level 10) that lets the caster say two words directly to the mind of a target, who recognizes the supernatural origin and the caster's voice.

label: World of Forms
summary: The metaphysical source from which magic draws the details of created things; magi disagree whether it is the realm of Magic, the human mind, or the mind of God.

label: Worms
summary: A famed Rhine city linked to the Nibelungenlied as the Royal Fortress of the Nibelung, ruled by its prince-bishop, with a great cathedral and the largest Jewish settlement in Germany.

label: Wrath of Whirling Winds and Water
aliases: Wrath of Whirling Winds and Water
summary: A Creo Auram Ritual spell (Level 65) that creates an immense hurricane-intensity storm 40 or more miles wide, causing massive damage along shorelines and inland.

label: Wrathful
summary: A Personality Flaw making a character prone to anger; held by the Berserker grog and Flambeau template magus.

label: Wreaths of Foul Smoke
summary: A Creo Auram spell (Level 10) that raises thick yellow sulfurous smoke that blocks sight and causes Fatigue or wound loss to those who breathe it.

label: Wrecked
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is very heavily damaged from a major accident, taking two seasons to repair (-5 General Quality, -2 Safety, -2 Aesthetics).

label: Writ of Reprisal
summary: A court order allowing a wronged merchant to seize goods from any merchant of a fraudster's home town; such a writ against the Order could trigger Quaesitor review of a covenant's representatives.

label: Wurzburg
summary: An influential episcopal city in the middle of Franconia at the center of its largest vineyards; its cathedral houses the shrine of St. Kilian.

label: Xanten
summary: A town on the west bank of the Rhine, formerly the Roman colony Colonia Ulpia Traiana, birthplace of the hero Siegfried and former capital of Nibelungland.

label: Xantippes
summary: A magus of House Jerbiton who helped found Treverorum to recover Roman secrets, later found guilty of meddling with the mundanes of Trier using his own Mentem magics for personal enrichment.

label: Xavier
summary: A Gifted magus of House Mercere, the Rhine Tribunal's only Gifted Mercere and its archivist, who dwells at Durenmar at one of the two official Mercer Houses.

label: Xavier of House Mercere
summary: Archivist of the Rhine Tribunal, attributed as the source of an in-world quotation about the Bingen Hole.

label: Xenophon of Bonisagus
summary: The Bonisagus magus who founded the Platonist Hermetic societas the Collegium, believing the Founder had stripped Hermetic Theory of any inquiry into magic's nature or origin.

label: Xerxes
summary: A hoplite magus who took Uwe as an apprentice and trained him to become Darius, a hunter of evils within the Order; he is now too frail for combat.

label: Y Gododdin
summary: The single famous poem by which the Welsh poet Aneirin is known, praising the war band of Mynyddawg Mwynfawr sent to recapture a Roman stronghold from the Saxons.

label: Yanartas
summary: A site near the Antalya Gulf in Asia Minor, where the mythical Chimera fell and fire leaps from the ground, location of one of Hephaestus's forges.

label: Yenghissar
summary: A small village along the route to Khashgar plagued every seven years by the Infernal storm spirit known as the Buran.

label: Yeshiva
summary: A Jewish school where students learn grammar and Jewish instruction by studying the Talmud and Mishnah from the local rabbi; large ones are in Cordoba and Granada.

label: Ygerna
summary: Gorlois's wife, sought by Uther; she received the disguised Uther into her bed at Tintagel and conceived Arthur.

label: Yonec
summary: The son of a hawk-knight and an imprisoned lady in a Lai of Marie de France; he avenged his father by killing the jealous old lord and took his father's place as king.

label: Yonec's ring and sword
summary: Gifts the dying hawk-knight gave his lover: a ring ensuring her husband would remember nothing, and a sword for their son Yonec to avenge him.

label: York
summary: The largest town of northern England and seat of the second English archbishop, a port on the River Ouse, site of the 1190 massacre of the Jews.

label: Young Henry
summary: The eldest son of Henry II at whose court William Marshal served, leading his mesnie at tournaments; he died of dysentery having taken a crusading vow.

label: Zanzibar
summary: A rich city, reachable by circumnavigating Africa, where gold is traded by equal weight for salt; a potential reward for an insured speculative covenant expedition.

label: Zelos
summary: The Daimon of rivalry, envy, and competition, appearing as a winged Greek youth with a laurel crown; he propagates contention but never helps resolve conflicts.

label: Zephyrus
summary: Air elementals composed of chains of octahedral corpuscles, encompassing wind, cloud, and lightning forms; utterly restless, highly perceptive travelers that crave the dissolution of barriers.

label: Zeus
summary: The god who raised Orpheus's lyre into the stars, taken by the Orphic cult as a sign of Orpheus's apotheosis.

label: Zora
summary: The faeblooded priestess who leads the priesthood of Hertha; she gives Crintera Creo vis yearly and is the lover of Istvan Padas.

label: Zurenzialle
summary: An unremarkable magus of the 1100s who vanished from his covenant in the Greater Alps; his sodales discovered he had never been human but was a faerie being impersonating a magus.

label: Zwergenstimme
summary: A Magic spirit of an echo (Might 15, Imaginem) that lurks in caves and ravines, can mimic sounds, hurl rocks, and collapse cave roofs; its name means 'dwarf voice' in German.

label: Zwin Sea Dragon
summary: A sea dragon that created the storm carving the Zwin channel near Brugge in a secret agreement with Derrick of Alsace, now demanding accumulated tolls via drowned-sailor emissaries.
